He spoke rampaciously about the plan, as if no obstacle mattered. 他談起那個計畫時語氣放任失控，彷彿沒有任何障礙重要。

meaning: 暴力狂亂的一連串行動
sentences: After the match, a rampage outside the stadium damaged several cars. 比賽結束後，球場外的一場暴衝破壞了好幾輛車。
A sudden rampage through the market left stalls overturned and broken. 市集裡突然的橫衝直撞讓攤位東倒西歪、四處破碎。

meaning: 暴力的；失控的；難以約束的
sentences: The rampageous crowd surged toward the stage when the music started. 音樂一響起，那群狂暴失控的人潮就向舞台湧去。
A rampageous storm rattled the windows all night long. 一場狂暴的風暴整晚都在震動窗戶。
The children ran rampageously through the hallway before bedtime. 孩子們睡前在走廊裡狂暴地亂跑。
The wind blew rampageously across the open field. 風在空曠的原野上狂暴地吹襲。
The coach laughed off the team's rampageousness as part of their youth. 教練把球隊的狂暴性笑說成是年輕氣盛的一部分。
There was a strange charm to the rampageousness of the rehearsal. 那場排練的失控狀態帶著一種奇特的魅力。
The headline described the bear as a rampager after it overturned several bins. 標題把那隻熊描述成一名肆虐者，因為牠翻倒了好幾個垃圾桶。
No one wanted to be the one to stop the rampager once he started shouting. 一旦那個橫衝直撞的人開始吼叫，沒人想上前攔他。
The rampagious crowd pushed through the narrow gate. 狂亂的人群擠過狹窄大門。
His rampagious energy made the room feel louder. 他那股暴烈的精力讓房間顯得更吵。
The rampancy of false rumors worried the school principal. 假消息的猖獗狀態讓校長很擔心。
They discussed the rampancy of weeds along the highway. 他們討論了公路旁雜草的氾濫情況。

meaning: 猖獗的；後腿站立、前腿伸展的
sentences: Rumors were rampant after the power outage. 停電後謠言四處流傳。
The shield showed a rampant lion. 盾牌上畫著一隻後腿站立的獅子。
Misinformation spread rampantly after the announcement. 公告發布後，錯誤資訊猖獗地擴散開來。
The roses climbed rampantly over the little gate. 那些玫瑰迅速地攀上了小門。

meaning: 環繞場所的防禦牆或土堤
sentences: We walked along the old rampart and looked down at the harbor. 我們沿著古老的城牆走，俯瞰著港口。
The castle's rampart still stands, though the village below has changed completely. 城堡的城牆依然矗立著，雖然下面的村落早已完全改變。

meaning: increased quickly or was forced along a ramp-like path
sentences: The company ramped production after the first reviews came in. 第一批評論出來後，這家公司就加快了生產。
He ramped the cart onto the truck bed with one careful push. 他用小心的一推把推車推上卡車車斗。
The fisherman found a ramper clinging to the net. 漁夫發現一條七鰓鰻緊貼著漁網。
A ramper can attach itself to other fish. 七鰓鰻能附著在其他魚身上。
The zoo sign placed toucans in the family Ramphastidae. 動物園的標示把巨嘴鳥歸在巨嘴鳥科。
Children usually remember Ramphastidae because of the birds' huge colorful bills. 孩子們通常會因為那些鳥巨大的彩色鳥喙而記住這一科。
The old chart placed toucans under Ramphastides. 舊圖表把巨嘴鳥歸在這個分類群下。
Ramphastides appears in older bird classification. 這個巨嘴鳥舊分類群會出現在早期鳥類分類中。
Ramphastos includes several well-known toucans. 巨嘴鳥屬包含幾種知名巨嘴鳥。
The bright bill made the Ramphastos bird easy to identify. 鮮豔的大喙讓這隻巨嘴鳥屬鳥類很容易辨認。

meaning: 枯死或折斷、頂端外露的樹
sentences: A lone rampick stood on the hill after the wildfire passed. 野火過後，山丘上只剩一棵孤零零的枯損斷樹。
The hikers used the rampick as a landmark when the trail turned muddy. 小徑變泥濘時，健行者就把那棵枯樹當作地標。

meaning: 枯死或折斷的樹，尤其是頂端碎裂而仍直立的
sentences: The forest floor was dotted with rampike trunks left by the storm. 森林地面散落著暴風雨留下的斷頂枯樹樹幹。
She sketched the rampike in charcoal because its shape looked dramatic against the sky. 她用炭筆畫下那棵斷頂枯樹，因為它的輪廓映著天空時格外有戲劇感。

meaning: 沿坡道移動；或快速上升的
sentences: The startup is ramping hiring as demand keeps climbing. 隨著需求持續上升，這家新創公司正在加速招募。
I watched the truck ramping slowly up the loading dock. 我看著卡車慢慢沿著裝卸坡道上行。
She spoke rampingly about the broken plan. 她對那個破掉的計畫語氣猛烈而激動。
The wind blew rampingly across the open field. 風在開闊的原野上狂猛地吹過。

meaning: 一種歐洲風鈴草，根可食
sentences: They gathered rampion leaves for the soup. 他們採集風鈴草葉子來煮湯。
A patch of rampion brightened the stone wall. 一叢風鈴草讓石牆旁多了幾分生氣。
The guards tried to stop the rampire before he crossed the wall. 守衛試圖在那名猛衝者越過牆前攔下他。
In the old tale, a lone rampire scales the fortress at midnight. 在那則古老故事裡，一名攀越者在午夜獨自登上堡壘。
A rampler passed the orchard each evening without ever hurrying. 每天傍晚都有一名閒逛者慢慢走過果園。
The poem follows a rampler wandering from village to village. 那首詩描寫一名漫遊者在村與村之間流連。
The old keeper knew every ramplor who slept near the docks. 那位老看守認得每一個睡在碼頭附近的流浪者。
In the story, the ramplor carries only a flute and a blanket. 在故事裡，那名遊蕩者身上只帶著一支笛子和一條毯子。
The rampsman checked the loading ramp before the truck arrived. 坡道工人在卡車抵達前先檢查了裝貨斜坡。
A skilled rampsman can raise a temporary platform in minutes. 熟練的搭坡工人能在幾分鐘內架好臨時平台。
The crowd surged forward in a sudden ramrace toward the gate. 人群突然朝大門猛衝，形成一陣衝撞。
A ramrace of carts shook the narrow street at dawn. 一陣車輛的猛烈推進在清晨震動了狹窄街道。

meaning: 通槍條；嚴厲而刻板的人
sentences: The soldier pushed the ramrod carefully down the barrel. 士兵小心地把通槍條推進槍管。
Our old coach was a ramrod who expected perfect order at all times. 我們以前的教練是個極其嚴厲刻板的人，隨時都要求絕對秩序。

meaning: 僵硬刻板的；過度嚴厲的
sentences: His ramroddy management style made the office feel tense. 他那種僵硬刻板的管理方式讓辦公室氣氛很緊張。
The ceremony felt too ramroddy to be enjoyable. 那場典禮過於拘謹嚴厲，讓人無法真正享受。
The village was tired of the young ramscallion who kept stealing apples. 村民們受夠了那個老是偷蘋果的小無賴。
In the comedy, the ramscallion causes trouble but somehow wins sympathy. 在那齣喜劇裡，這名小流氓雖然惹事，卻莫名讓人同情。
They switched to ramsch after the regular game ended in a tie. 正常牌局打成平手後，他們改玩拉姆施。
I had never heard of ramsch before visiting that card club. 我在去那家牌會之前從沒聽過這種玩法。
Ramsey left a note on the kitchen table before sunrise. 拉姆齊在日出前在廚房桌上留了一張紙條。
The editor asked Ramsey to review the final chapter one last time. 編輯請拉姆齊再最後審一次終章。
They spent the night in a ramshackle cabin by the river. 他們在河邊一間搖搖欲墜的小木屋裡過夜。
A ramshackle bus wheezed into the dusty station. 一輛破舊不堪的巴士喘著氣駛進塵土飛揚的車站。

meaning: 變得破敗的；東倒西歪的
sentences: The old porch looked even more ramshackled after the winter storms. 冬季暴風過後，那座老門廊看起來更加破敗了。
A row of ramshackled sheds leaned toward the road. 一排東倒西歪的破棚子斜斜地朝著路邊傾去。
The ramshackleness of the farm buildings worried the inspector. 那些農舍建物的破敗狀態讓檢查員很擔心。
Despite its ramshackleness, the shop had a certain charm. 儘管那家店破破爛爛，卻仍有某種獨特魅力。
The fence stood ramshackly along the edge of the field. 那道圍籬東倒西歪地立在田邊。
The old stage was built ramshackly from borrowed boards. 那座舊舞台是用借來的木板七拼八湊搭成的。
The cook gathered fresh ramson from the damp woodland path. 廚師從潮濕的林間小路旁採來新鮮的熊蔥。
A patch of ramson filled the spring air with a sharp garlic scent. 一片野蒜讓春天的空氣中瀰漫著濃烈蒜香。
His ramstam decision nearly ruined the whole plan. 他那個魯莽的決定差點毀了整個計畫。
A ramstam charge across the field left the team exposed. 一次冒失地衝過田地，讓整支隊伍暴露在危險中。
Farmers in the region grow ramtil for its oil-rich seeds. 當地農民種植這種作物，因為它的種子含油量很高。
A small sack of ramtil lay beside the grain jars. 一小袋黑種草籽放在穀物罐旁邊。
The fungus forms fine ramular threads on the leaf surface. 那種真菌會在葉面形成細小的枝狀絲體。
A ramular pattern spread outward from the center of the colony. 一種枝狀圖樣從菌落中心向外擴展。
Each ramule carried a cluster of tiny leaves. 每一條小枝上都長著一簇細小葉片。
The specimen broke into delicate ramules when it dried. 那個標本乾燥後裂成了一條條纖細小枝。
The shrub becomes strongly ramuliferous in wet seasons. 那種灌木在潮濕季節會長出許多小枝。
A ramuliferous stem gave the plant a feathery appearance. 那條生滿細支的莖讓植物看起來有羽毛般的外觀。
The algae show a ramulose structure under the microscope. 那些藻類在顯微鏡下呈現細分枝結構。
A ramulose branch system helps the plant spread light evenly. 細分枝系統有助於植物平均接受光線。
The ramulous coral looked like a tiny underwater forest. 那株枝繁的珊瑚看起來像一座微型海底森林。
Its ramulous growth made the sample hard to pack safely. 它那種多小枝的生長型態讓樣本很難安全打包。
A single ramulus extended from the main branch toward the light. 一條小枝從主枝伸向光線。
The anatomy chart marks each tiny ramulus with a separate label. 那張解剖圖把每一條細小神經支都個別標示出來。
The dentist pointed to the ramus of the jaw on the scan. 牙醫在掃描圖上指出下顎骨的支部。
Each ramus of the antler curved in a slightly different direction. 鹿角的每一個分枝都朝著略有不同的方向彎曲。
The dried moss broke into one tiny ramuscule after another. 那株乾苔蘚一碰就碎成一條條極細小枝。
Under magnification, each ramuscule showed a surprisingly regular pattern. 在放大觀察下，每一條微枝都呈現出令人意外的規整圖樣。
The archive lists Ramusi among the early witnesses to the treaty. 檔案把拉穆西列為該條約的早期見證者之一。
Scholars are still debating whether Ramusi was a personal or tribal name. 學者們仍在爭論拉穆西究竟是人名還是族名。

meaning: 跑；奔跑，為 run 的過去式
sentences: She ran to the station when she realized the train was leaving. 她發現火車快開了，就立刻跑向車站。
The dog ran across the field and disappeared behind the trees. 那隻狗跑過田野，消失在樹後。

meaning: 蘭，北歐神話中的海神女
sentences: In Norse stories, Ran gathers the drowned into her net. 在北歐故事中，海神女蘭會把溺者收進自己的網裡。
The poet invoked Ran while describing the dark winter sea. 詩人在描寫冬日陰沉海面時提到了蘭。
Rana sat near the front row. 拉納坐在前排附近。
The invitation listed Rana as a special guest. 邀請函把拉納列為特別來賓。
The field guide places the common frog in the genus Rana. 那本圖鑑把普通青蛙歸入蛙屬。
Rana signed her name neatly at the bottom of the page. 拉娜把自己的名字工整地簽在頁面底端。
The biologist compared several ranal species from the wetland. 生物學家比較了來自那片濕地的幾種蛙屬物種。
A ranal call echoed from the reeds after sunset. 日落後，一陣與青蛙相關的叫聲從蘆葦叢傳來。
Older botany books often group these plants under Ranales. 較早的植物學書籍常把這些植物歸在 Ranales 之下。
The classification of Ranales has changed considerably over time. 對這一舊類群的分類隨著時間有了很大變化。
The notebook included a ranarian sketch of tiny webbed feet. 那本筆記裡畫了一張與蛙類有關的細小蹼足草圖。
Her ranarian exhibit focused on frogs, toads, and their unusual life cycles. 她的蛙類展覽聚焦於青蛙、蟾蜍以及牠們特別的生命週期。
The museum kept a small ranarium for live specimens. 那間博物館為活體標本保留了一個小型蛙類飼養箱。
After the rain, the children peered into the ranarium and watched the frogs move. 雨後，孩子們探頭看著那個養蛙處，觀察青蛙的動作。

meaning: 水蠍屬；一種長身的水棲昆蟲屬
sentences: The biologist identified the insect as Ranatra from its long sticklike body. 那位生物學家根據牠細長像棍子的身體，辨認出那是水蠍屬的昆蟲。
A single Ranatra drifted through the pond grass like a twig with legs. 一隻水蠍屬昆蟲穿過池邊水草，像帶腿的細枝一樣漂過去。
The butter had turned rance by the time we opened the picnic box. 我們打開野餐盒時，那塊奶油已經酸敗了。
He wrinkled his nose at the rance smell coming from the back of the fridge. 他對著冰箱後方飄出的腐臭味皺起了鼻子。
The rancel appeared in a dusty glossary. 這個罕見的舊詞出現在一本佈滿灰塵的詞彙表裡。
No one in class recognized the rancel at first. 起初班上沒有人認得這個舊詞。
The rancellor was listed among obsolete court titles. 這個舊式職稱被列在過時的宮廷官名之中。
Historians rarely agree on what a rancellor did. 歷史學家很少能一致說明這個職稱原本的職責。

meaning: 舊式職稱中的男子；與 rancel 有關的人
sentences: In the old chronicle, the rancelman was mentioned only once. 那部古老編年史裡，rancelman 只被提到一次。
He sounded like a rancelman from some forgotten village ledger. 他聽起來像是某份被遺忘的村莊帳冊裡記下來的舊式人物。
The manuscript mentioned a rancer in the margin. 古手稿的邊註裡提到了一個罕見的古式名稱。
Nobody knew whether the rancer was a job or a nickname. 沒有人知道這個名稱究竟是職業還是綽號。

meaning: 開始酸敗的；逐漸變質的
sentences: The oil gave off a rancescent odor after sitting in the sun all afternoon. 那瓶油在太陽下放了一下午後，散出逐漸酸敗的氣味。
We tossed the rancescent nuts before they ruined the whole salad. 我們把開始變質的堅果丟掉了，免得整盤沙拉都被毀掉。
He spent his childhood on a large cattle ranch in the state of Texas. 他的童年是在德克薩斯州的一個大型養牛場（大牧場）度過的。
The movie features several beautiful scenes of cowboys working on a ranch. 電影中有幾幕牛仔在牧場工作的優美畫面。

meaning: 牧場；舊式拼法中的 ranch
sentences: The old map marked a ranche near the river bend. 那張舊地圖在河灣附近標了一座牧場。
She spent the summer on a ranche where horses grazed beside the fence. 她整個夏天都待在一座牧場裡，馬匹就在圍欄旁吃草。
The rancher checked the fences before sunrise. 牧場主在日出前先檢查了圍欄。
A rancher nearby raised cattle on dry grassland. 附近一位牧場主在乾燥的草地上飼養牛隻。

meaning: 小型原住民聚落；牧場村落
sentences: The guide explained that the rancheria had grown around a shared water source. 導遊解釋說，那個小型原住民聚落是圍著共同水源發展起來的。
After the storm, the road to the rancheria was muddy but still passable. 暴風雨過後，通往那個牧場村落的道路雖然泥濘，仍然可以通行。

meaning: 牧場主人；牧場工人，尤指西班牙語地區的稱呼
sentences: The ranchero rode out before sunrise to check the cattle. 那位牧場主人在日出前就騎馬出去查看牛群。
Everyone in town knew the ranchero by his wide hat and dusty boots. 鎮上的每個人都因那頂寬帽和滿是塵土的靴子認得那位牧場工人。

meaning: 沒有牧場的；缺乏牧場的
sentences: The family felt ranchless after selling the land to a developer. 這家人在把土地賣給開發商之後，覺得自己再也沒有牧場了。
His ranchless childhood made him dream about open fields and horses. 他沒有牧場的童年，讓他一直夢想著開闊草原和馬匹。
The ranchman checked the water trough before feeding the horses. 那位牧場工人在餵馬之前先檢查了水槽。
A tired ranchman can still recognize a storm by the smell of the wind. 疲憊的牧場主人仍然能從風中的氣味辨認出暴風雨。
The family spent the summer working on a rancho in northern Mexico. 那家人在墨西哥北部的一座大牧場度過了整個夏天。
Visitors rode horses across the wide rancho at sunset. 遊客在日落時騎馬穿過寬廣的大牧場。

meaning: 牧場女主人或牧場女工
sentences: The ranchwoman knew exactly which calf had wandered off at dusk. 那位牧場女工很清楚黃昏時是哪隻小牛走失了。
As a ranchwoman, she could mend a fence and saddle a horse without help. 身為牧場女主人，她不用別人幫忙就能修籬笆、替馬上鞍。
The butter smelled rancid after sitting in the heat all day. 那塊奶油在高溫下放了一整天後聞起來已經酸敗了。
He threw away the rancid oil before anyone used it for cooking. 他在有人拿那瓶油做菜前，就先把已經變質的油丟掉了。

meaning: 酸敗；變質成酸敗狀態的過程
sentences: The lab report described the rancidification of the sample oil over two weeks. 實驗報告描述了樣本油品在兩週內酸敗的過程。
Heat and moisture speed up rancidification in stored nuts and seeds. 熱和濕氣會加速儲存中的堅果與種子酸敗。
If you leave the butter near the window, the sun will rancidify it quickly. 如果你把奶油放在窗邊，太陽很快就會讓它酸敗。
The chef warned that bad storage can rancidify even expensive ingredients. 主廚警告說，保存不當連昂貴的食材也會變質。
A faint rancidity in the oil told us it was no longer fresh. 油裡那股淡淡的酸敗味告訴我們，它已經不新鮮了。
The label helps prevent rancidity by telling shoppers how to store the product. 標籤會提醒消費者如何保存產品，以避免酸敗。

meaning: 以酸敗的方式；令人作嘔地
sentences: The old cooking oil smelled rancidly from the corner of the kitchen. 那桶舊食用油從廚房角落散出令人作嘔的酸敗氣味。
He described the spoiled milk rancidly, which made everyone push the glass away. 他用一種很惡心的方式形容那杯壞掉的牛奶，讓大家都把杯子推遠了。
The rancidness of the leftovers made the whole apartment smell bad. 剩菜的酸敗味讓整間公寓都變得很難聞。
We threw away the sauce as soon as we noticed its rancidness. 我們一發現那醬汁已經有酸敗味，就立刻把它丟掉。
Their long rancor made every discussion tense. 他們長久的怨恨讓每次討論都緊繃起來。
She answered without rancor and ended the dispute. 她沒有帶著怨恨回答，終於化解了爭執。
Their rancorous argument lasted long after the guests had gone home. 賓客都回家後，他們那場充滿怨恨的爭吵還持續了很久。
The editor refused to publish such rancorous comments on the website. 編輯拒絕在網站上刊登那種充滿惡意的評論。
He spoke rancorously about the decision, even though the meeting was over. 會議明明已經結束了，他還是帶著怨恨地談論那個決定。
The two neighbors stared rancorously across the fence and said nothing. 那兩位鄰居隔著圍欄惡狠狠地互看，誰也沒開口。

meaning: 怨恨；惡意；充滿敵意的狀態
sentences: The rancorousness in the room vanished once someone opened the windows. 房間裡的怨恨氣氛在有人打開窗戶後就消失了。
She was tired of the rancorousness that followed every family dinner. 她已經受夠了每次家庭晚餐後都會出現的那種敵意。

meaning: 不易記仇的；不受怨恨影響的
sentences: He had a rancorproof way of answering criticism without losing his temper. 他有一種不易記仇的回應方式，面對批評也不會失控。
A good leader should be almost rancorproof when a project goes wrong. 一位好領導在計畫出錯時，應該幾乎不受怨氣影響。
They camped along the rand of the marsh. 他們在沼澤邊緣紮營。
The old map marked the rand with a thin line. 舊地圖用細線標出邊界。
Rand left his notebook on the desk. 蘭德把筆記本留在桌上。
Everyone remembered Rand because he spoke so clearly. 大家都記住了蘭德，因為他說話很清楚。
Randal arrived early for the meeting. 蘭道爾很早就來開會。
My cousin Randal can fix almost anything. 我表哥蘭道爾幾乎什麼都能修。
Randall signed the form with a steady hand. 蘭德爾用穩定的手勢簽了表格。
The teacher called on Randall to read first. 老師點了蘭德爾先朗讀。
The geologist labeled the thin crystal sample as Randallite. 那位地質學家把那塊薄晶體樣本標記為蘭德爾石。
Randallite is rare enough that collectors treat it with extra care. 蘭德爾石相當稀有，所以收藏家都會格外小心保存。

meaning: 狂歡式的酒宴或喧鬧聚會；舊式舞曲
sentences: The students ended finals week with a noisy randan downtown. 學生們在市中心用一場喧鬧的狂歡結束了期末週。
At the wedding, the randan kept the dancers moving past midnight. 在婚禮上，那段舊式舞曲讓舞者一直跳到午夜之後。
The mineral cabinet included a small piece of randannite. 那個礦物展示櫃裡放著一小塊蘭丹石。
She was thrilled to find randannite listed in the field guide. 她很高興在野外指南裡找到蘭丹石的條目。
Randell arrived early with a notebook full of questions. 藍道提早到了，手裡拿著一本寫滿問題的筆記本。
Everyone trusted Randell to keep the meeting calm and productive. 每個人都相信藍道能讓會議保持冷靜而有效率。
The horse made a wild randem toward the open gate. 那匹馬朝著打開的門口猛衝過去。
One randem from the frightened crowd nearly knocked him over. 驚慌人群的一次猛撞差點把他撞倒。
The villagers feared that a rander might strike the storehouse at night. 村民擔心夜裡會有掠奪者襲擊糧倉。
In the old tale, the rander always vanished before sunrise. 在那則古老傳說中，那名搶奪者總是在日出前消失。

meaning: 蘭迪亞屬，一種植物屬名
sentences: The botanist labeled the shrub as belonging to Randia. 植物學家把這株灌木標記為屬於蘭迪亞屬。
Several tropical species in Randia bear fragrant white flowers. 蘭迪亞屬的幾種熱帶植物會開出帶香氣的白花。
The cobbler replaced the worn randing along the boot sole. 鞋匠換掉了靴底邊緣磨損的鑲邊皮條。
Strong randing helps the shoe keep its shape in wet weather. 牢固的鞋邊鑲條能幫助鞋子在潮濕天氣裡保持形狀。
Randir signed the letter with a short note of thanks. 蘭迪爾在信末加了一小段致謝。
The story presents Randir as a cautious but loyal friend. 故事把蘭迪爾描寫成一位謹慎但忠誠的朋友。
The mineral sample was identified as Randite after laboratory analysis. 那塊礦物樣本在實驗分析後被辨認為藍迪石。
Randite is mostly mentioned in specialized geological catalogs. 藍迪石多半只出現在較專門的地質目錄裡。
The basket held together because the old randle was still strong. 那個籃子之所以沒有散掉，是因為舊支撐橫條還很牢固。
He cut a new randle to repair the broken frame. 他切了一根新的橫桿來修理損壞的框架。
Randolph asked the hardest question at the end of the lecture. 藍道夫在演講最後提出了最難的一個問題。
The letter from Randolph arrived together with the maps. 藍道夫寄來的信和地圖一起送到了。
The winners were chosen by a random selection from all the entries. 獲獎者是從所有參賽作品中隨機選出的。
The data points appeared to be scattered in a random pattern on the graph. 數據點在圖表上似乎呈隨機分佈。

meaning: 隨機存取記憶體；電腦記憶體
sentences: This laptop has sixteen gigabytes of random access memory. 這台筆電有十六 GB 隨機存取記憶體。
Adding random access memory can make an old computer faster. 增加記憶體能讓舊電腦跑得更快。

meaning: 有點隨機的；略顯雜亂的
sentences: The seating pattern looked randomish, but it had a hidden logic. 那個座位安排看起來有點隨機，其實背後有一套邏輯。
He gave a randomish answer because he had not read the report. 因為沒看過報告，他給了一個略顯隨意的回答。
The trial used randomization to avoid hidden bias. 那項試驗利用隨機化來避免隱藏偏差。
Good randomization can make two study groups more comparable. 良好的隨機化能讓兩組研究對象更容易比較。
The software can randomize the order of the questions instantly. 那套軟體能立刻把題目的順序隨機化。
Researchers decided to randomize the samples before testing them. 研究人員決定在檢測前先把樣本隨機分配。
I just randomly remembered this dream from 2 years ago. 我突然想起了兩年前的這個夢。
If someone acts randomly, they do so in a way that is in a random manner. 如果某人隨機行事，他們就會以隨機的方式這樣做。

meaning: 衡量事件缺乏目的、邏輯或客觀性的指標。
sentences: There was no randomness in the teacher's selection of the class representative. 老師選課代表沒有隨意性。
The term randomness refers to A measure of the lack of purpose, logic, or objectivity of an event. 隨機性一詞是指事件缺乏目的、邏輯或客觀性的衡量。
The names were drawn randomwise from a sealed box. 那些名字是從密封盒中隨機抽出的。
The lights seemed to flash randomwise across the stage. 那些燈光看起來在舞台上無規則地閃爍。
The movie used a randy joke that some viewers disliked. 那部電影用了讓部分觀眾不喜歡的好色笑話。
He apologized for the randy comment at dinner. 他為晚餐時那句好色的話道歉。
Randy brought coffee for the whole team before sunrise. 蘭迪在天亮前替整個團隊帶來了咖啡。
Everyone knew Randy as the first person to volunteer for extra work. 每個人都知道蘭迪總是第一個自願多做事的人。
Rane checked the door twice before bed. 拉內睡前把門檢查了兩次。
The program ended with a thank-you to Rane. 活動最後特別向拉內致謝。
The shell was cataloged under Ranella in the museum collection. 那枚貝殼在博物館藏品裡被歸在蛙螺屬之下。
Collectors admire Ranella for its heavy ridges and bold shape. 收藏家欣賞蛙螺屬外殼上厚實的稜紋與鮮明外形。
Ranere sent a careful reply after reading the full proposal. 拉內爾在讀完整份提案後寄來一封謹慎的回信。
The diary mentions Ranere only once, but the note is affectionate. 日記裡只提到拉內爾一次，語氣卻很親切。

meaning: 魁北克省的一長條矩形土地
sentences: The surveyor marked each rang on the map. 測量員在地圖上標出每一條長條土地。
Farmhouses lined the rang beside the road. 農舍沿著道路旁的長條土地排列開來。
The rangatira spoke first, and everyone else listened in silence. 那位毛利領袖先發言，其他人都安靜地聆聽。
A respected rangatira often carried both political and spiritual authority. 受人尊敬的毛利酋長往往同時具有政治與精神上的權威。
The shop sells a wide range of organic fruit and vegetables. 這家店銷售各式各樣的有機水果和蔬菜。
The temperatures can range from ten to thirty degrees Celsius. 氣溫可能在攝氏十度到三十度之間變化。

meaning: 排列好的；成行的；涵蓋範圍廣的
sentences: The chairs were neatly ranged along the wall. 那些椅子整齊地排列在牆邊。
Her interests ranged from music to marine biology. 她的興趣範圍很廣，從音樂到海洋生物學都有。
The poet imagined a rangeless sky above the dark plain. 那位詩人想像黑色平原上方有一片沒有邊界的天空。
In theory, the signal looked almost rangeless. 理論上，那個訊號看起來幾乎沒有明顯界限。

meaning: 牧場管理員；靶場管理員
sentences: The rangeman rode out at dawn to check the cattle fences. 那位牧場管理員在黎明時騎馬外出檢查牛欄圍籬。
A good rangeman knows every water source on the open land. 優秀的牧場管理員熟悉開闊土地上的每一處水源。
A park ranger warned us not to feed the wild animals. 一名國家公園的巡守員提醒我們不要餵食野生動物。
The ranger checked the trail after the storm had passed. 暴風雨過後，那名護林員去檢查步道狀況。
She accepted the rangership of the forest district last spring. 她在去年春天接下了那片森林分區的巡守職位。
The novel treats rangership as a lonely but honorable duty. 那部小說把這份巡守職責寫成孤獨卻光榮的工作。
Years of rangework had made him tough and patient. 多年的牧場工作讓他變得堅韌而有耐性。
The camp provided water, tools, and shelter for summer rangework. 營地為夏季的牧場作業提供水、工具與住宿。

meaning: 修長靈活的；活動範圍大的
sentences: The colt grew into a rangey animal with a long, easy stride. 那匹小馬長成了一隻修長靈活、步伐輕鬆的動物。
A rangey midfielder can cover both wings during a match. 一名活動範圍大的中場球員在比賽中能兼顧左右兩翼。
The museum display grouped reindeer fossils under Rangifer. 博物館展區把馴鹿化石歸在馴鹿屬之下。
Rangifer is important in studies of Arctic animal migration. 馴鹿屬在北極動物遷徙研究中相當重要。

meaning: 馴鹿屬的；與馴鹿有關的
sentences: The paleontologist compared several rangiferine antler patterns. 那位古生物學家比較了幾種與馴鹿有關的鹿角形態。
Rangiferine traits can be seen in the bone structure of the specimen. 那份標本的骨骼結構上可以看出馴鹿屬相關特徵。
The horse's ranginess made it ideal for long distances. 那匹馬修長靈活的體態，使它非常適合長途移動。
Fans admired the ranginess of the young striker. 球迷欣賞那位年輕前鋒活動範圍大又靈活的特質。
Laser ranging gave the team a precise distance to the cliff face. 雷射測距讓團隊能精準算出峭壁距離。
The discussion covered topics ranging from farming to philosophy. 那場討論涵蓋了從農業到哲學等廣泛主題。
The loose metal sheets began to rangle in the wind. 鬆動的鐵片開始在風中發出喧鬧聲。
Years of neglect had let weeds rangle the once neat path. 多年的荒廢讓雜草把原本整齊的小路弄得凌亂不堪。
The rangler spent the afternoon checking the outer fence line. 那名牧場工人花了一整個下午檢查外圍圍欄。
Every experienced rangler knew where the horses liked to rest. 每位有經驗的巡場者都知道馬喜歡在哪裡休息。

meaning: 高瘦而靈活的；延展開的
sentences: The rangy dog crossed the field in a few long leaps. 那隻高瘦靈活的狗用幾個大步就穿過了田野。
He had a rangy frame that made him look taller than he was. 他那種修長的身形讓他看起來比實際更高。
In the story, the young rani ruled with both wisdom and courage. 在那個故事裡，年輕的拉妮以智慧與勇氣治理國家。
The painting shows a rani wearing jewels and silk robes. 那幅畫描繪一位拉妮身穿絲袍並佩戴珠寶。
The ranid leapt into the grass before I could take a photo. 那隻蛙科動物在我來得及拍照前就跳進了草叢。
Scientists often compare ranid frogs when studying wetland habitats. 科學家研究濕地棲地時，常會拿蛙科青蛙來比較。
The guidebook explained that Ranidae includes many common frogs. 那本指南說明，蛙科包含許多常見的青蛙。
Researchers tagged the specimen as part of Ranidae after a careful review. 研究人員經過仔細檢查後，把那個標本標記為蛙科的一員。
The raniferous marsh was full of croaks after sunset. 那片產蛙的沼澤在日落後充滿了蛙鳴。
A raniferous pond can sound louder than a busy street at night. 一個有很多青蛙的池塘，在夜裡聽起來可能比熱鬧的街道還吵。
The artist carved a raniform ornament for the garden fountain. 那位藝術家替花園噴泉刻了一個蛙形裝飾。
Under the lamp, the raniform shadow looked almost alive. 在燈光下，那個蛙形影子看起來幾乎像活的一樣。
Ranina is a genus of crabs. 蛙蟹屬是一個螃蟹屬名。
The student drew a Ranina crab for the marine biology project. 學生為海洋生物作業畫了一隻蛙蟹屬螃蟹。
Raninae belongs within a broader crab family. 蛙蟹亞科屬於更大的螃蟹科群。
The chart placed Raninae below the family name. 圖表把蛙蟹亞科放在科名下面。
The fossil had a ranine outline that made it look froglike. 那塊化石有著蛙狀輪廓，看起來很像青蛙。
A ranine face mask on the costume made the child laugh. 那個服裝上的蛙臉面具把孩子逗笑了。

meaning: 與 Ranina 有關的；蛙蟹類的
sentences: The paper described a raninian specimen collected from shallow water. 那篇論文描述了一個從淺水採集到的蛙蟹類標本。
Its raninian features were enough for the class to identify it quickly. 牠那些與 Ranina 相關的特徵，讓全班很快就能辨認出來。
The field guide noted that the snake was ranivorous. 那本野外指南註明，這條蛇是食蛙的。
A ranivorous bird can help control frog populations in the marsh. 食蛙的鳥類可以幫助控制沼澤中的青蛙數量。
Ranjit greeted us with a warm smile. 蘭吉特帶著溫暖的笑容向我們打招呼。
Everyone listened when Ranjit started to explain the plan. 當蘭吉特開始說明計畫時，大家都安靜聆聽。
He holds a high rank in the military and has a lot of experience. 他在軍中擔任高階職務且擁有豐富經驗。
Taipei is ranked as one of the best cities to live in Asia. 台北被評為亞洲最適合居住的城市之一。
The coach ranked the runners after the race. 教練在比賽後為跑者排定名次。
She ranked the tasks by urgency. 她依緊急程度為任務排了順序。

meaning: 軍隊中的士兵；列兵；下層階級的人
sentences: The ranker stood at attention while the officers reviewed the parade. 軍隊裡的列兵在軍官檢閱隊伍時立正站好。
He was a ranker who earned respect by working harder than anyone expected. 他原本只是個普通士兵，卻靠著比誰都努力而贏得尊重。
Her tennis ranking improved after the tournament. 比賽後，她的網球排名進步了。
The website shows the ranking of the most popular songs. 這個網站顯示最受歡迎歌曲的排名。

meaning: 略帶粗臭味的；有點繁茂而粗野的
sentences: The rankish cheese was too strong for my taste. 那塊略帶粗臭味的起司對我來說味道太重了。
By midsummer, the rankish weeds had taken over the garden path. 到了仲夏，那些有點繁茂又粗野的雜草已經佔滿了花園小徑。
The unfair comment continued to rankle long after the meeting ended. 那句不公平的評論在會議結束後仍然讓人耿耿於懷。
It still rankles him that he was not invited to the ceremony. 他到現在還對自己沒被邀請參加典禮這件事感到不快。

meaning: 沒有等級的；沒有地位的
sentences: The rankless volunteers worked side by side with the staff. 那些沒有等級之分的志工和工作人員並肩工作。
In his rankless early days, he slept wherever there was space. 在他還沒有地位的早期日子裡，有空位他就睡哪裡。

meaning: 令人惱火地；使人耿耿於懷地
sentences: The issue was ranklingly unresolved even after three rounds of talks. 即使經過三輪談判，這件事還是令人惱火地沒有解決。
She ranklingly remembered the promise he had broken. 她總是帶著一股難以釋懷的情緒記起他違背的承諾。
The vines grew rankly along the old stone wall. 那些藤蔓沿著古老的石牆茂盛地生長。
She spoke rankly about the mistakes instead of softening the truth. 她坦率地談論那些錯誤，沒有把真相說得太委婉。

meaning: 粗臭；茂盛而粗野的狀態
sentences: The rankness of the swamp air hit us as soon as we opened the hatch. 我們一打開艙門，就立刻聞到沼澤空氣中的粗臭味。
The rankness of the weeds made the fence line hard to see. 雜草長得太茂盛又粗野，讓圍欄線幾乎看不見。
The ranksman followed the orders without hesitation. 那名列兵毫不猶豫地服從命令。
As a ranksman, he cared more about his unit than about medals. 身為普通士兵，他比起勳章，更在乎自己的單位。
The list was arranged rankwise from the most senior to the newest member. 名單是按等級排列的，從資深者排到最新成員。
Rankwise, she was below the manager but above the rest of the team. 按職等來看，她在經理之下，但高於團隊其他人。

meaning: 鹽沼；鹽漠，尤指印度和巴基斯坦一帶的 Rann
sentences: The caravan crossed the rann under a white, empty sky. 那支商隊在一片蒼白空曠的天空下穿越鹽漠。
During the dry season, the rann looked like a plain of cracked salt. 旱季時，那片鹽沼看起來就像一整片龜裂的鹽地。
A shallow rannel cut across the pasture after the storm. 暴風雨過後，牧場上出現了一條淺淺的細溝。
Water from the spring gathered in the rannel before slipping into the field. 泉水先匯進那條細溝，接著才流入田裡。

meaning: 粗野喧鬧的；吵鬧不安的
sentences: The rannigal crowd kept shouting long after the band had left. 那群吵鬧的人在樂團離開後還一直喧嘩。
Even the patient teacher looked tired of the rannigal behavior in class. 連一向有耐性的老師，也對班上的粗野吵鬧感到疲憊。

meaning: 愛惹事的人；喧鬧的女人
sentences: The neighbors called her a ranny because she argued over everything. 鄰居們叫她 ranny，因為她凡事都要爭辯。
He laughed, but everyone knew the ranny could start a scene in seconds. 他雖然笑了，可大家都知道那個愛惹事的人幾秒內就能鬧起來。

meaning: 阿根廷的倫克爾族；倫克爾人
sentences: The museum exhibit explained how the Ranquel lived on the open plains. 博物館展覽說明了倫克爾人如何在廣闊的草原上生活。
Many Ranquel families still protect their traditions and language today. 許多倫克爾家族至今仍在守護他們的傳統與語言。
Burglars ransacked the apartment and left drawers open everywhere. 竊賊把公寓洗劫一空，抽屜也全都被拉開。
She had to ransack her desk before she found the missing receipt. 她把書桌翻了個底朝天，才找到那張不見的收據。

meaning: 洗劫者；翻找得很徹底的人
sentences: The police identified the ransacker from a blurry security video. 警方根據一段模糊的監視畫面認出了那名洗劫者。
As a child, he was a harmless ransacker of kitchen cabinets and candy jars. 小時候的他只是個會亂翻廚櫃和糖罐的搗蛋鬼。

meaning: 被翻得亂七八糟的；遭洗劫後雜亂的
sentences: The attic looked ransackle after years of careless storage. 經過多年雜亂堆放後，閣樓看起來亂成一團。
We stepped into a ransackle room that had clearly been searched in a hurry. 我們走進一間明顯被匆忙搜過的凌亂房間。
The hiker strapped his ransel on and headed for the ridge. 那名登山客背好背包，便朝山稜出發。
In old paintings, soldiers often carried a ransel over one shoulder. 在古畫裡，士兵常把行軍背囊掛在一側肩上。

meaning: 背著行囊的人；行軍背包兵
sentences: The ranselman moved ahead of the caravan with an easy stride. 那名背行囊的人步伐輕快地走在商隊前面。
Every ranselman in the story looked prepared for a long and dusty road. 故事裡的每個背包兵看起來都已準備好走上一條漫長而塵土飛揚的路。

meaning: 為釋放人質所支付的費用。
sentences: They were held for two million dollars ransom. 他們被扣留，要求 200 萬美元的贖金。
They were held to ransom. 他們被勒索贖金。

meaning: 可被贖回的；可用贖金交換的
sentences: The kidnappers kept saying the hostage was ransomable. 綁匪一直說那名人質是可以用贖金交換的。
In the old tale, even the jewel was treated as ransomable treasure. 在那個古老故事裡，連寶石都被當作可以贖回的珍寶。
The ransomer arrived with a locked case of cash before dawn. 那名付贖金者在黎明前帶著一只上鎖的現金箱趕到。
In the old story, the ransomer rescues the prisoner without drawing a sword. 在那個古老故事裡，贖回者沒有拔劍就救回了囚犯。

meaning: 無須贖金的；免費贖回的
sentences: The treaty allowed ransomfree release of wounded captives. 那項條約允許受傷俘虜無須贖金即可獲釋。
The child was returned ransomfree after the mistake was discovered. 真相大白後，那個孩子被無償送了回來。

meaning: 未被贖回的；無贖金可付的
sentences: The ransomless prisoners remained in the fortress through winter. 那些無人付贖金的囚犯整個冬天都被關在堡壘裡。
A ransomless hostage had little hope in those brutal times. 在那個殘酷的年代，無人贖回的人質幾乎沒有希望。
Smoke rose quietly from the ranstead at the edge of the moor. 荒原邊那處農舍場院靜靜升起炊煙。
They spent the night in a lonely ranstead far from the road. 他們在一處遠離道路的偏僻鄉間住地過夜。
His rant filled the room with frustration. 他那段長篇怒罵讓整個房間都充滿挫折感。
After the rant, she took a breath and apologized. 那番咆哮過後，她深吸一口氣並道歉。
The alley was full of the rantan of pans, voices, and barking dogs. 巷子裡充滿鍋盆敲擊聲、叫喊聲與狗吠交雜的喧鬧。
We heard the rantan of carts long before we saw the market. 我們還沒看見市場，就先聽到車輛鏗鏘作響的雜聲。
The old mechanic was skilled but notoriously rantankerous. 那位老技師技術很好，但脾氣暴躁得出了名。
A rantankerous guest can ruin the mood of an entire dinner. 一位愛爭吵的客人足以破壞整場晚餐的氣氛。
The novel's young hero begins as a reckless rantepole. 那部小說的年輕主角一開始就是個魯莽放蕩的傢伙。
Her aunt still called him a rantepole even after he became a lawyer. 即使他後來成了律師，他姨媽還是叫他頑皮鬼。

meaning: 咆哮演說者；狂熱叫喊者
sentences: The crowd listened politely until the ranter lost control of his temper. 人群原本還算客氣地聽著，直到那名咆哮演說者失控發火。
He sounded less like a reformer and more like a ranter on the stage. 他站在台上時，比起改革者更像一個只會怒吼的人。

meaning: 狂喊派思想；激進咆哮式主張
sentences: The pamphlet warns against the excesses of Ranterism. 那本小冊子警告人們提防狂喊派思想的極端傾向。
Historians treat Ranterism as a small but noisy current in religious debate. 歷史學家把狂喊派看成宗教爭論中規模不大卻十分喧鬧的一支。
His late-night ranting kept the whole building awake. 他深夜的咆哮叫罵讓整棟樓的人都睡不著。
The speech slipped from criticism into pure ranting. 那場演說從批評慢慢滑向毫無節制的怒吼。
He spoke rantingly for fifteen minutes without taking a breath. 他連珠炮似地咆哮了十五分鐘，幾乎沒換氣。
The caller complained rantingly about a problem nobody could verify. 那通電話裡的人用憤怒大叫的方式抱怨一個誰都無法證實的問題。

meaning: 胡鬧的人；放蕩的年輕人
sentences: Her grandfather still remembered being called a rantipole in his youth. 她的祖父仍記得年輕時常被人叫作胡鬧鬼。
The play presents the prince as a rantipole before he matures. 那齣戲把王子描寫成一個在成熟前愛胡鬧的年輕人。
One hard rantock on the rope nearly tore the knot loose. 那條繩子被猛力一扯，結差點就鬆開了。
We heard the rantock of chains from the dark shed. 我們聽見黑暗棚屋裡傳來鐵鍊被粗暴扯動的聲音。

meaning: 愛咆哮的；動不動就怒罵的
sentences: The review called the film clever but a bit ranty in tone. 那篇影評說這部片很聰明，只是語氣有點太咆哮了。
He gets ranty whenever the topic turns to politics. 只要話題轉到政治，他就會變得愛怒罵。
The dentist recognized the swelling as a ranula beneath the tongue. 牙醫辨認出舌頭下方的腫脹其實是舌下囊腫。
A large ranula can interfere with speech and swallowing. 較大的舌下囊腫可能影響說話和吞嚥。

meaning: 舌下囊腫的；似小囊泡的
sentences: The surgeon described the mass as ranular in appearance. 外科醫師把那個腫塊描述為帶有舌下囊腫樣外觀。
A ranular swelling usually needs careful examination before treatment. 類似舌下囊腫的腫脹通常需要在治療前仔細檢查。
Ranunculaceae includes buttercups, anemones, and many poisonous plants. 毛茛科包括毛茛、銀蓮花與許多有毒植物。
The field guide grouped the specimen under Ranunculaceae after flowering. 那本野外圖鑑在植物開花後把標本歸入毛茛科。
The botanist noted several ranunculaceous traits in the leaves and flowers. 植物學家注意到這株植物的葉與花具有多項毛茛科特徵。
Some ranunculaceous species are beautiful but highly toxic. 有些毛茛科植物雖然美麗，卻毒性很強。
The professor placed the family within Ranunculales on the phylogenetic chart. 教授在系統發育圖上把這個科放進毛茛目。
Older classifications treated Ranunculales somewhat differently from modern systems. 較舊的分類法對毛茛目的處理方式和現代系統不太相同。

meaning: 毛茛屬植物；毛茛的複數
sentences: Yellow ranunculi brightened the wet meadow in spring. 春天時，黃色的毛茛花點亮了潮濕的草地。
The gardener planted several ranunculi along the stone border. 園丁沿著石頭邊界種了好幾株毛茛。
The species was cataloged under Ranunculus after close study. 經過仔細研究後，這個物種被歸入毛茛屬。
Many gardeners know Ranunculus for its bright layered blooms. 許多園藝愛好者因那層層鮮豔花瓣而認識毛茛屬植物。
Marine biologists identified the specimen as belonging to Ranzania. 海洋生物學家把那個標本辨認為翻車魨屬成員。
Ranzania is mentioned far less often than larger sunfish genera. 和較大型的翻車魚屬相比，翻車魨屬較少被提及。
The alpine garden included several mats of Raoulia between the rocks. 那座高山花園在岩石之間種了幾叢勞利亞屬植物。
Raoulia is prized for its compact silver cushions in cold climates. 勞利亞屬植物因在寒冷氣候中形成緊密的銀色墊狀外觀而受到珍視。
He enjoys listening to rap music and wants to become a professional rapper. 他喜歡聽饒舌音樂，並想成為一名專業饒舌歌手。
She rapped on the wooden door several times, but nobody answered her. 她在木門上敲了幾下，但沒人應門。
Older natural history books grouped hawks and eagles under Rapaces. 較早的自然史書籍把鷹與雕一類鳥統稱為猛禽類。
The guide explained that Rapaces is an older grouping rather than a modern order. 圖鑑說明猛禽類這個名稱比較像舊式分群，而不是現代正式的目級分類。
The sculptor gave the creature a rapaceus profile with a hooked beak. 雕塑家把那生物塑造成帶有猛禽般輪廓與鉤喙的樣子。
His rapaceus style of negotiation made everyone uneasy. 他那種掠奪性的談判方式讓所有人都感到不安。
The company was accused of rapacious pricing after the shortage. 缺貨之後，那家公司被指控採取了貪婪掠奪式的定價。
A rapacious landlord can drain an already poor neighborhood. 一位貪婪的房東可能把本已貧困的社區榨得更乾。
The investors moved rapaciously to buy every available lot. 投資人們貪婪地搶購每一塊可得的土地。
The animal fed rapaciously before the others could approach. 那隻動物在其他同伴靠近前就貪婪地進食。
The novel portrays the rapaciousness of a city consumed by greed. 那部小說描寫了一座被貪欲吞噬的城市及其掠奪性。
His rapaciousness ruined partnerships that might have lasted for years. 他的貪婪毀掉了本來可能維持多年的合作關係。
The judge condemned the rapacity behind the fraud scheme. 法官譴責了那場詐騙計畫背後的貪婪本質。
Unchecked rapacity can turn a public service into a private racket. 不受節制的貪婪可能把公共服務變成私人牟利工具。

meaning: 球粒花崗岩；拉帕基維花崗岩
sentences: The quarry is famous for a coarse pink rapakivi used in monuments. 那座採石場以出產用於紀念建築的粉紅色球粒花崗岩聞名。
Geology students examined the texture of rapakivi under the hand lens. 地質系學生用放大鏡觀察了球粒花崗岩的紋理。

meaning: 義大利利古里亞海岸的拉帕洛；拉帕洛條約
sentences: We spent a quiet afternoon in Rapallo, watching boats move along the harbor. 我們在拉帕洛度過安靜的午後，看著船隻穿過港灣。
History students still discuss the Treaty of Rapallo for its political impact. 歷史學生至今仍會談論《拉帕洛條約》的政治影響。

meaning: 紫金牛屬植物；一屬常綠灌木或小喬木
sentences: The guide pointed out a Rapanea tree growing at the edge of the trail. 向導指著步道邊緣的一棵紫金牛屬樹木。
Some Rapanea species are valued for their glossy leaves and dense shape. 有些紫金牛屬植物因葉片油亮、樹形茂密而受重視。

meaning: 拉帕特科；一類熱帶開花植物科
sentences: Botanists added the plant to Rapateaceae after studying its flowers. 植物學家研究它的花朵後，把它歸入拉帕特科。
Rapateaceae is a small family, but its species can be quite distinctive. 拉帕特科雖然是個小科，但其中物種的特色相當鮮明。

meaning: 拉帕特科的；屬於拉帕特科的
sentences: The rapateaceous specimen surprised the students with its unusual flower head. 那株拉帕特科植物以不尋常的花序讓學生們驚訝。
Her notes described a rapateaceous plant collected from the wet tropical forest. 她的筆記記錄了一株採自潮濕熱帶森林的拉帕特科植物。
The report described the rape case in detail. 報告詳細描述了那起強姦案件。
The court treated the rape charge as a serious crime. 法院把這項強姦指控視為重罪。

meaning: 帶有暴力掠奪意味的；殘虐貪婪的
sentences: The poem warned against rapeful men who ruined whole villages. 那首詩警告人們要提防會摧毀整個村落的暴虐之徒。
His rapeful ambition left no room for mercy or restraint. 他那種帶有掠奪性的野心，完全沒有寬容或節制的空間。
The court treated the raper's testimony with extreme caution. 法院對這名強姦犯的證詞採取了極度謹慎的態度。
The novel never excuses the raper, even when it explores his past. 那部小說即使探索他的過去，也從未替這名施暴者開脫。
Farmers harvested rapeseed in late spring and sent it to the mill. 農夫在晚春收割油菜籽，再送往榨油廠。
Rapeseed oil has a mild flavor, so it works well in everyday cooking. 芥花油味道溫和，因此很適合日常烹調。

meaning: 拉斐爾；義大利文藝復興畫家與天使名
sentences: Raphael painted scenes that still feel calm and balanced centuries later. 拉斐爾所畫的場景，幾個世紀後仍然顯得平靜而均衡。
The name Raphael can refer to both the artist and the archangel. Raphael 這個名字既可以指這位畫家，也可以指大天使。

meaning: 拉斐爾風格的；優雅和諧的
sentences: The portrait had a Raphaelesque calm that softened every line. 那幅肖像帶著拉斐爾式的安詳，連每一道線條都顯得柔和。
Her teacher praised the Raphaelesque balance of color and composition. 她的老師稱讚那幅作品在色彩與構圖上有拉斐爾式的平衡感。

meaning: 拉斐爾式的；理想化美感的
sentences: The chapel ceiling had a Raphaelic grace that drew every visitor upward. 禮拜堂天花板帶著拉斐爾式的優雅，讓每位訪客都忍不住抬頭。
She described the painting as Raphaelic because of its serene faces. 她把那幅畫形容為拉斐爾式的，因為人物的表情十分安寧。

meaning: 拉斐爾風格；對拉斐爾藝術原則的推崇
sentences: The professor explained Raphaelism as a love of harmony, clarity, and ideal beauty. 教授把拉斐爾主義解釋為對和諧、清晰與理想美的熱愛。
Raphaelism influenced several painters who wanted order instead of drama. 拉斐爾主義影響了幾位更偏好秩序而非戲劇效果的畫家。

meaning: 拉斐爾派的；拉斐爾風格追隨者
sentences: He called himself a Raphaelite and admired classical proportions. 他自稱是拉斐爾派，崇尚古典比例。
The gallery featured work by a Raphaelite who painted with remarkable restraint. 畫廊展出了一位拉斐爾派畫家的作品，筆觸克制卻相當出色。

meaning: 拉斐爾主義；崇尚拉斐爾風格的傾向
sentences: The critic said the school showed too much Raphaelitism and not enough risk. 那位評論家說，這個畫派太過崇尚拉斐爾風格，缺少冒險精神。
Raphaelitism can sound old-fashioned, yet many artists still admire it. 拉斐爾主義聽起來或許有些老派，但許多藝術家仍然欣賞它。

meaning: 芥菜類中毒；因野生蘿蔔等植物引起的中毒症狀
sentences: The doctor suspected raphania after hearing what the child had eaten. 醫生聽完孩子吃了什麼之後，懷疑是芥菜類中毒。
Old medical texts described raphania as a painful and confusing illness. 古老醫書把 raphania 描述成一種疼痛又令人混亂的疾病。

meaning: 蘿蔔屬；一類十字花科植物
sentences: Raphanus includes the familiar radish that appears in many salads. Raphanus 包含了我們常見、會出現在沙拉裡的蘿蔔。
The botanist labeled the specimen Raphanus after checking its seed pod. 植物學家檢查種莢後，將那株標為蘿蔔屬。
The report linked the outbreak to raphany caused by contaminated seeds. 報告把這次疫情與受污染種子引起的蘿蔔中毒連結起來。
Although rare, raphany can make an ordinary meal suddenly dangerous. 雖然很少見，raphany 仍可能讓一頓平常的餐點突然變得危險。

meaning: 縫線；脊線；兩部分融合形成的中線
sentences: The surgeon traced the raphe before making a careful incision. 外科醫師沿著縫線仔細比劃，才下刀切開。
In botany, the raphe can appear as a thin ridge on a seed. 在植物學裡，raphe 可能會呈現為種子上的細小脊線。

meaning: 拉菲亞棕櫚屬；可提供纖維的棕櫚
sentences: Raphia palms grow tall and dramatic near wetlands. 拉菲亞棕櫚常在濕地附近長得高大而醒目。
The basket was woven from fibers taken from a Raphia leaf. 那個籃子是用拉菲亞棕櫚葉的纖維編成的。

meaning: 針晶；植物細胞中的針狀結晶
sentences: Under the microscope, a single raphide looked like a tiny needle. 在顯微鏡下，一個針晶看起來就像細小的針。
Some plants use raphide to discourage animals from eating them. 有些植物利用針晶來讓動物不敢吃它們。

meaning: 針晶複數；植物中的針狀結晶群
sentences: The leaf cells were packed with raphides that sparkled under the slide. 葉片細胞裡充滿針晶，在玻片下閃閃發亮。
Botany students learned that raphides often help defend the plant. 植物學學生學到，針晶常常是植物的防禦方式之一。

meaning: 含針晶的；能產生針狀結晶的
sentences: The raphidiferous tissue made the plant unpleasant to chew. 那種含針晶的組織讓這株植物嚼起來很不舒服。
A raphidiferous species may protect itself with microscopic crystals. 含針晶的物種有時會靠微小結晶保護自己。

meaning: 蛇蛉科昆蟲；蛇蛉科成員
sentences: The raphidiid rested on the window screen with its long body stretched out. 那隻蛇蛉科昆蟲伸展著細長身體，停在紗窗上。
He was surprised to learn that a raphidiid is a harmless predator of small insects. 他很驚訝地發現，蛇蛉科昆蟲其實是捕食小型昆蟲的無害獵手。
Raphidiidae includes insects with delicate wings and elongated necks. 蛇蛉科包含翅膀纖細、頸部細長的昆蟲。
The textbook placed the specimen in Raphidiidae after a close examination. 教科書在仔細檢查後，把那個標本歸入蛇蛉科。
Raphidodea is a term used in older classifications of snakeflies. Raphidodea 是舊分類系統中使用的蛇蛉類群名稱。
The researcher compared fossils that might belong to Raphidodea. 研究人員比較了可能屬於蛇蛉目的化石。

meaning: 蛇蛉總科；蛇蛉相關的昆蟲總科
sentences: The guidebook listed Raphidoidea among the more ancient insect groups. 那本導覽書把蛇蛉總科列為較古老的昆蟲類群之一。
Students were asked to compare Raphidoidea with other winged orders. 老師要求學生把蛇蛉總科和其他有翅目做比較。

meaning: 石斑木屬；常見園藝灌木屬
sentences: Raphiolepis is popular in gardens because it stays neat all year. 石斑木屬植物因為四季都保持整齊，常被種在庭園裡。
The shrub outside the cafe was a Raphiolepis with thick, shiny leaves. 咖啡館外的灌木是一株葉片厚實油亮的石斑木。
A visible raphis ran down the shell like a pale seam. 一條清楚的縫線像淡色接縫一樣沿著貝殼延伸下來。

sentences: The workers planted rasamala along the slope. 工人們在坡地上種植拉薩馬拉樹。
A tall rasamala cast cool shade over the path. 一棵高大的拉薩馬拉樹在小路上投下涼蔭。
The old manual recommends rasant fire along the wall to stop an advance. 那本舊手冊建議沿牆施以掠掃射擊，阻止對方推進。
In military drawings, a rasant line is kept low to skim the ground. 在軍事圖示裡，rasant 線會被畫得很低，讓火力貼地掠過。

meaning: 花鮋；一種有棘刺的鮋魚
sentences: The divers spotted a rascacio resting motionless on the reef. 潛水員看見一條 rascacio 靜靜伏在礁石上。
Its spines made the rascacio easy to mistake for part of the rock. 它身上的棘刺讓那條鮋魚很容易被誤認成岩石的一部分。

meaning: 厚臉皮的人或生物；一個麻煩製造者。
sentences: That little rascal bit me! 那個小流氓咬我了！
If you have deer in the area, you may have to put a fence around your garden to keep the rascals out. 如果您所在地區有鹿，您可能需要在花園周圍設置柵欄以防止流氓進入。

meaning: 無賴之徒的整體；一群惡棍；無賴行徑
sentences: The reformer claimed the city hall was ruled by rascaldom. 那位改革者聲稱市政廳已被一群無賴之徒把持。
He wrote a comic essay exposing the small rascaldom of office politics. 他寫了一篇諷刺散文，揭露辦公室政治裡那些小小的無賴勾當。
The aunt in the story is a lovable rascaless who cheats only at card games. 故事裡的那位阿姨是個討喜的女淘氣鬼，只在打牌時耍點小詐。
She called herself a rascaless with a grin and tucked the stolen cookie behind her back. 她笑著自稱是個女小搗蛋鬼，還把偷來的餅乾藏到身後。

meaning: 無賴；流氓；rapscallion 的古寫法
sentences: The judge refused to be charmed by the young rascalion's manners. 法官沒有被那個年輕無賴表面上的禮貌打動。
In the old novel, every tavern seems to shelter a rascalion or two. 在那本老小說裡，每家酒館似乎都藏著一兩個流氓無賴。
His cheerful smile could not hide the rascalism of the scheme. 他笑得再開朗，也掩不住那個計畫裡的狡詐與無賴行徑。
The memoir remembers schoolboy rascalism with more affection than shame. 那本回憶錄回想起學生時代種種頑劣作怪時，懷念多過羞愧。

meaning: 無賴性；惡作劇般的狡黠；無賴行為
sentences: The prank looked harmless at first, but its rascality became obvious when the locks were changed. 那場惡作劇一開始看似無害，但當門鎖都被換掉時，裡頭的無賴行徑就很明顯了。
Her favorite uncle had a streak of rascality that kept every dinner lively. 她最喜歡的叔叔帶著一股淘氣狡黠，讓每頓晚餐都格外熱鬧。

meaning: 使變成無賴；使沾染流氣
sentences: The novel shows how neglect can rascalize a clever boy over time. 那部小說寫出長期忽視如何把一個聰明男孩慢慢逼成小無賴。
The gang tried to rascalize every newcomer with easy money and cruel jokes. 那個幫派用輕鬆來錢與殘酷玩笑，試圖把每個新來的人都帶壞。
The puppy had a rascallike sparkle in its eyes before it stole the sock. 那隻小狗偷走襪子前，眼裡閃著一種淘氣又狡黠的神情。
She gave him a rascallike grin and slipped out before anyone could stop her. 她對他露出一抹帶點無賴氣的壞笑，隨後趁大家來不及阻止就溜走了。
The innkeeper chased the young rascallion away from the doorway with a broom. 旅店老闆拿著掃帚，把那個年輕小無賴從門口趕走。
In the comedy, the rascallion lies, flatters, and survives by nerve alone. 在那齣喜劇裡，那個無賴靠說謊、奉承和一股膽量活下去。
His rascally charm made people laugh before they remembered to be angry. 他那股無賴式的魅力總讓人先笑出來，之後才想起自己本該生氣。
The children invented a rascally plan to ring the bell and run. 孩子們想出一個淘氣的計畫，按完門鈴就拔腿跑。
The court record lists fraud, theft, and every sort of rascalry. 法庭紀錄列出了詐欺、偷竊以及各式各樣的無賴行徑。
He was tired of the petty rascalry that passed for business in the port. 他受夠了那座港口裡被當成生意手段的各種小人伎倆。
Even his friends grew weary of his constant rascalship. 連朋友們都漸漸厭倦了他層出不窮的無賴作風。
The memoir treats youthful rascalship with humor rather than pride. 那本回憶錄用幽默而不是自豪的口吻，談起年少時的胡鬧惡行。
The merchant claimed the veil was made of rasceta imported from the south. 商人聲稱那條面紗是用南方進口的細薄布料裁成的。
In old household accounts, rasceta appears beside silk and lace. 在舊式家用帳冊裡，這種細薄布常和絲綢及蕾絲並列記錄。
Her wedding cuffs were trimmed with rascette instead of expensive satin. 她婚禮袖口用的是一種輕薄織物的滾邊，而不是昂貴的緞面。
The tailor preferred rascette for light decorative panels. 那位裁縫偏愛用這種輕薄布料做裝飾性的拼片。
The fire did not merely damage the barn; it rased it to the ground. 那場火不只是燒壞穀倉，而是把它整個夷為平地。
The old wall had been rased long before the new road was built. 那道老牆早在新道路興建之前就已被拆平。
The hotel brochure promised a broad rasen behind the house for summer games. 旅館簡介提到屋後有一大片草坪可供夏日遊戲使用。
They spread lunch on the rasen and listened to the band in the park. 他們把午餐鋪在草地上，一邊聽公園裡的樂隊演奏。

meaning: 拉森納；伊特魯里亞人的自稱
sentences: Some historians say the Etruscans called themselves Rasenna. 有些歷史學家說伊特魯里亞人自稱拉森納。
The class learned about Rasenna before studying Rome. 班上在學羅馬之前先認識拉森納。
The raser of the old theater claimed the structure was beyond repair. 拆除那座老戲院的人聲稱，那棟建築早已無法修復。
In the chronicle, the king is remembered as a raser of monasteries. 在那部編年史裡，國王被記成一位夷平修道院的人。
Her guitar solo opened with a sharp rasgado that woke the whole room. 她的吉他獨奏以一串俐落的刷弦開場，整個房間瞬間被喚醒。
The teacher slowed the rasgado down so beginners could hear each stroke. 老師把刷弦奏法放慢，好讓初學者聽清每一下撥動。
The baby developed a red rash on his skin due to an allergic reaction. 寶寶因過敏反應皮膚上長了紅疹。
It would be rash to make a decision before we have all the facts. 在我們掌握所有事實之前做決定是魯莽的。
He fried a rasher of bacon and laid it beside the eggs. 他煎了一片培根，放在蛋旁邊。
One rasher was enough to make the whole kitchen smell savory. 只要一片薄培根，就足以讓整個廚房香味四溢。
It was rashful of him to sign the paper without reading the last page. 他連最後一頁都沒看就簽字，實在太輕率了。
A rashful promise made in anger can take years to mend. 氣頭上做出的輕率承諾，往往要花很多年才能彌補。
The accident was caused less by malice than by sheer rashing. 那場意外與其說出於惡意，不如說是因為一時魯莽。
Good judgment disappears when rashing takes the place of patience. 一旦魯莽取代耐心，判斷力往往也跟著消失。
The doctor examined the rashlike marks on the child's arm. 醫師檢查了孩子手臂上那些像皮疹的斑點。
A rashlike redness spread across her neck after the lotion was applied. 乳液擦上後，她的脖子泛起一片皮疹般的紅色。
He rashly accepted the challenge without checking the risk. 他魯莽地接受挑戰，完全沒有先查看風險。
They rashly changed the plan at the last minute. 他們在最後一刻輕率地更改了計畫。
His rashness in traffic frightened everyone in the car. 他開車時的魯莽讓車上每個人都心驚膽跳。
The general regretted the rashness of attacking before dawn. 那位將軍後悔自己過於輕率，竟在黎明前就下令進攻。

meaning: 拉施提，古代文獻中的女性名
sentences: In the old tale, Rashti is mentioned only briefly, yet her name lingers in memory. 在那則古老故事裡，拉施提雖只被短暫提及，名字卻令人難忘。
The historian treats Rashti as a court figure from a dimly preserved tradition. 歷史學家把拉施提視為一位只在殘缺傳說中留下痕跡的宮廷人物。
Years of rasion had blurred the inscription on the stone step. 多年磨蝕讓石階上的刻字變得模糊不清。
The conservator measured the rasion on the bronze surface before cleaning it. 修復師在清理前先測量了青銅表面的磨損程度。
A Raskolnik family lived at the edge of the village. 一戶俄國舊禮派家庭住在村邊。
The novel describes a Raskolnik community under pressure. 這部小說描寫一個承受壓力的舊禮派社群。

meaning: 掘地鳥類；雞形鳥類的舊分類名
sentences: Older textbooks placed chickens, pheasants, and their kin among the Rasores. 較早期的教科書把雞、雉與近親鳥類都歸入這一類群。
The term Rasores now sounds dated, but it once appeared often in zoology. 這個名稱如今帶有舊式色彩，但過去在動物學中十分常見。

meaning: 善於扒地覓食的；雞形鳥類的
sentences: Turkeys and quails are often described as rasorial birds because they scratch for food. 火雞和鵪鶉常被形容為善於扒地覓食的鳥類。
The specimen had short wings and a distinctly rasorial foot structure. 那件標本翅膀較短，足部構造明顯適合扒地覓食。
He took a rasp to the rough edge of the wooden shelf. 他拿銼刀修整木架邊緣的粗糙處。
There was a dry rasp in her voice after hours of shouting. 她喊了幾個小時後，嗓音裡帶著乾啞刺耳的沙沙聲。
The surgeon set the raspatorium beside the forceps before the procedure. 外科醫師把刮骨器放在鑷子旁邊，準備開始手術。
In the museum case, the brass raspatorium looked more alarming than elegant. 展櫃裡那把黃銅刮削器看起來比精緻更令人發怵。
The dental tray included a small raspatory for lifting tissue gently. 牙科器械盤裡有一把小型剝離刮器，可用來輕柔分離組織。
Antique medical catalogs list the raspatory among standard surgical tools. 古董醫療型錄把這種刮剝器列為標準外科工具之一。

meaning: 覆盆子飲料；覆盆子汽飲
sentences: They cooled the guests with glasses of raspberriade on the shaded porch. 他們在陰涼的門廊上用一杯杯覆盆子飲料招待客人。
A bottle of homemade raspberriade sat in the stream to stay cold. 一瓶自製的覆盆子汽飲放在溪水裡保冷。
She topped the cake with fresh raspberries and cream. 她在蛋糕上鋪了新鮮覆盆子和鮮奶油。
The jam has a sweet raspberry flavor. 這罐果醬帶有香甜的覆盆子風味。

meaning: 像覆盆子的；帶覆盆子風味的
sentences: The candy had a bright raspberrylike scent without using real fruit. 那顆糖帶著明亮的覆盆子般香氣，卻沒有使用真正果實。
She chose a lipstick with a soft raspberrylike tint. 她選了一支帶有柔和覆盆子色調的口紅。

meaning: 沙啞刺喉的；被銼磨過的
sentences: After the speech, his throat felt rasped and raw. 演說結束後，他的喉嚨覺得又乾又磨。
The metal looked rasped where someone had forced the latch. 有人硬撬門閂後，金屬表面留下明顯被銼磨過的痕跡。
The old carpenter reached for a rasper to smooth the curved edge. 老木匠伸手去拿一把粗銼，好把弧形邊修順。
His laugh had the sound of a rasper running across tin. 他的笑聲像粗銼刮過鐵皮一樣刺耳。

meaning: 刺耳粗啞的；令人難受地沙啞的
sentences: His rasping voice filled the tiny room before anyone saw him. 還沒有人看見他之前，他那刺耳沙啞的嗓音就先充滿了整個小房間。
The metal door made a rasping sound as it slid across the track. 那扇金屬門沿著滑軌移動時發出一陣刺耳的摩擦聲。
She laughed raspingly after speaking for hours in the cold wind. 她在冷風中講了好幾個小時後，笑聲變得沙啞而刺耳。
The old speaker raspingly warned us not to waste the last bucket of water. 那位老人用粗嘎的聲音提醒我們別浪費最後一桶水。

meaning: 刺耳粗啞；磨耳的不適感
sentences: What bothered me was not the volume but the raspingness of his tone. 真正讓我受不了的不是音量，而是他語氣裡那種刺耳的粗啞感。
The recording captured the raspingness of the saw better than the video did. 那段錄音比影片更清楚地捕捉到鋸子的刺耳摩擦感。
Fine wood raspings covered the bench after the sculptor finished shaping the mask. 雕刻師把面具修整完後，工作檯上鋪滿了細細的木屑刮屑。
The cook saved a few lemon raspings to brighten the sauce. 廚師留了一些檸檬刨屑，準備替醬汁提味。

meaning: 粗礪刺耳的；語氣帶刺的
sentences: He has a raspish way of answering questions when he is tired. 他累的時候回答問題總帶著一種刺刺的口氣。
The singer kept the song intimate even with a slightly raspish tone. 那位歌手即使嗓音略帶粗啞，仍把那首歌唱得很有親近感。

meaning: 拉斯皮特礦；一種鉛鎢酸鹽礦物
sentences: The geologist identified the yellow crystal as raspite. 地質學家把那塊黃色晶體辨認為拉斯皮特礦。
A tiny raspite specimen sat under the lab lamp. 一小塊拉斯皮特標本放在實驗室燈下。
After the concert, her voice turned pleasantly raspy. 音樂會結束後，她的聲音帶著一點好聽的沙啞。
A raspy cough echoed down the hallway in the middle of the night. 半夜裡，一陣粗啞的咳嗽聲在走廊間回盪。
The guide claimed he once saw a rasse slip through the trees at dusk. 導遊說他曾在黃昏時看過一隻靈貓穿過樹林。
Older natural history books sometimes use rasse for a civetlike animal of Asia. 較早期的博物學書籍有時會用 rasse 指亞洲一種像靈貓的動物。

meaning: 《拉塞拉斯》；亦指書中主角拉塞拉斯
sentences: She wrote her thesis on Rasselas and the search for happiness. 她的論文寫的是《拉塞拉斯》以及其中對幸福的追尋。
In the story, Rasselas leaves the sheltered valley to understand the world. 在那個故事裡，拉塞拉斯離開受保護的山谷，去理解世界。
The boys used to rassle on the grass until their shirts were covered in dirt. 那些男孩以前常在草地上扭打到襯衫全是泥土。
We spent half an hour trying to rassle the heavy net back onto the boat. 我們花了半個小時，才把那張沉重的網拖扯回船上。

meaning: 天棓四；天龍座的一顆恆星
sentences: On a clear autumn night, Rastaban appears near the winding line of Draco. 在晴朗的秋夜裡，天棓四會出現在天龍座蜿蜒的星列附近。
The astronomy club used Rastaban as a reference point while learning the northern sky. 天文社在認識北天星空時，把天棓四當成定位參考點。
If you enlarge a low-resolution raster, the edges start to look blocky. 如果把低解析度的點陣圖放大，邊緣就會開始出現明顯鋸齒方塊。
The designer exported the map as a raster for quick web use. 設計師把地圖輸出成點陣格式，好讓它能快速用在網頁上。

meaning: 防蝕樹脂；金屬版保護漆
sentences: Before etching the brass plate, the artisan spread a thin layer of rastik over the surface. 在蝕刻黃銅板之前，工匠先在表面塗上一層薄薄的防蝕樹脂。
The old workshop still smelled faintly of oil, smoke, and rastik. 那間老工坊裡仍飄著油料、煙氣與保護漆混合的淡淡氣味。

meaning: 沙沙作響地翻動；窸窣移動
sentences: Dry leaves rastled under our boots as we crossed the yard. 我們穿過院子時，乾葉在靴底下窸窣作響。
Something small rastled in the hedge and then disappeared. 有個小東西在樹籬裡沙沙翻動了一下，隨後就不見了。
The grandfather in the novel is called Rastus and rarely leaves his porch. 那本小說裡的祖父名叫拉斯特斯，很少離開自家門廊。
On the old team roster, Rastus appears between two brothers from Georgia. 在那份老舊球隊名單上，拉斯特斯的名字夾在兩位來自喬治亞州的兄弟中間。
The editor spotted a faint rasure where a name had been scraped off the parchment. 編輯注意到羊皮紙上有一道淡淡的刮除痕，像是有人把名字刮掉了。
Under magnification, the rasure revealed an earlier version of the date. 放大來看，那處擦除痕露出了更早版本的日期。
The cat caught a large rat in the backyard yesterday afternoon. 貓昨天下午在後院抓到了一隻大老鼠。
We need to find a way to get rid of the rats in the basement. 我們需要找到一種方法來除掉地下室的老鼠。
The old index listed rata without explanation. 舊索引裡只列出拉塔，沒有解釋。
No one in the room could explain what rata meant. 房間裡沒有人能說清楚拉塔是什麼。

meaning: 可評稅性；可按比例分攤性
sentences: The appeal focused on the ratability of the vacant property. 那場申訴的焦點在於那塊閒置不動產是否具有可評稅性。
Lawyers argued over the ratability of shared maintenance costs in the complex. 律師們爭論那個社區共同維護費是否可以按比例分攤。

meaning: 可評稅的；可按比例分攤的
sentences: Only the ratable portion of the land was included in the annual bill. 年度帳單裡只列入了那塊土地中可評稅的部分。
The committee agreed that the expense was ratable among all members. 委員會同意那筆費用應由所有成員按比例分攤。
The surveyor's report addressed the ratableness of several outbuildings. 測量師的報告談到了幾棟附屬建物的可評稅狀態。
They questioned the ratableness of charging tenants for roof repairs. 他們質疑把屋頂修繕費分攤給房客是否合理。

meaning: 按比例地；依評稅標準地
sentences: The funds were distributed ratably according to each district's population. 那筆資金依各區人口比例分配出去。
Maintenance costs should be shared ratably rather than paid by one owner alone. 維護成本應該按比例分擔，而不是只由單一屋主支付。
The hostess poured a small glass of ratafee after dessert. 女主人在甜點之後倒了一小杯香甜酒。
An old recipe book suggested serving ratafee with almond cakes. 一本老食譜建議把 ratafee 和杏仁蛋糕一起上桌。

meaning: 拉塔菲亞酒；果仁或果核風味甜酒
sentences: They ended the meal with chilled ratafia and candied orange peel. 他們以冰鎮拉塔菲亞甜酒和糖漬橙皮作為餐末收尾。
The baker brushed the sponge with ratafia to deepen its aroma. 麵包師在海綿蛋糕上刷了些拉塔菲亞酒，讓香氣更濃。
The merchant sold spices by the ratal in the old market. 那位商人在老市場裡按拉特爾這種舊制單位賣香料。
A note in the margin explained that one ratal varied from place to place. 頁邊的註記說明，一個拉特爾在不同地區的重量並不完全相同。

meaning: 拉坦尼亞；其根常作收斂藥用
sentences: The herbal manual recommended ratanhia for its strong astringent qualities. 那本草藥手冊推薦 ratanhia，因為它具有很強的收斂性。
Bundles of dried ratanhia root hung from the ceiling of the apothecary shop. 一束束乾燥的拉坦尼亞根掛在藥鋪的天花板下。
A rataplan from the street drum announced the parade before we saw it. 我們還沒看見遊行，街上的答答鼓聲就先傳了過來。

meaning: 使合理化；為自己找理由
sentences: It is easy to rationalize a bad habit when it brings short-term comfort. 一個壞習慣若能帶來短暫安慰，人就很容易替它找理由。
The manager tried to rationalize the delay, but the clients wanted concrete answers. 經理試圖為延誤找說法，但客戶要的是具體答案。

meaning: 合理化者；愛找藉口的人
sentences: He is such a skilled rationalizer that every failure becomes someone else's fault in his story. 他很會自我合理化，在他的說法裡每次失敗都會變成別人的錯。
A rationalizer can sound persuasive until you compare the excuse with the facts. 一個善於找藉口的人聽起來可能很有說服力，但只要把說法和事實一比就露餡了。
She breathed deeply and responded rationally instead of escalating the argument. 她深呼吸後理性地回應，沒有讓爭執進一步升高。
Markets do not always behave rationally when fear spreads faster than facts. 當恐懼傳播得比事實更快時，市場未必會理性運作。
The rationalness of her plan became obvious once the numbers were reviewed. 一旦把數字重新檢查過，她那套計畫的合理性就變得很明顯。
In a crisis, people often admire calm rationalness more than bold promises. 在危機中，人們往往更欣賞冷靜的理性，而不是大膽的承諾。
During the drought, the town had to rationate water to protect the reservoir. 乾旱期間，鎮上不得不對用水實施配給以保住水庫存量。
The camp rationated medicine first to the children and the elderly. 那個營地先把藥品定量分配給孩童和老人。
After the convoy was delayed, several families spent a rationless night at the shelter. 車隊延誤後，幾個家庭在避難所度過了一個沒有口糧的夜晚。
The rationless soldiers learned to stretch every scrap of food they could find. 沒有配給可領的士兵只好盡量把找到的每一點食物都撐久一點。
Fuel rationment changed daily life more than people had expected. 燃料配給對日常生活造成的改變，比人們原先預料的還大。
The old poster explained wartime rationment in simple, direct language. 那張老海報用簡單直接的語言說明了戰時配給制度。
The zoology chart groups ostriches and emus under Ratitae. 動物學圖表把鴕鳥和鴯鶓歸在平胸類鳥之下。
Ratitae includes large birds that cannot fly. 平胸類鳥包含無法飛行的大型鳥類。
An ostrich is a ratite, which means it belongs to a group of mostly flightless birds. 鴕鳥是一種平胸類鳥，也就是大多數不會飛的一群鳥類之一。
The museum displayed a ratite egg that was larger than a child's head. 博物館展示了一顆平胸類鳥的蛋，尺寸比小孩的頭還大。

meaning: 平胸類鳥的；似平胸類鳥的
sentences: Its long legs and heavy body gave the bird a distinctly ratitous look. 牠修長的腿和厚重的身軀，讓那隻鳥看起來很有平胸類鳥的特徵。
The illustrator exaggerated the creature's ratitous posture for comic effect. 插畫家刻意誇大那生物像平胸類鳥般的姿態，來製造喜劇效果。
The small animal had a ratlike face but a much softer tail. 那隻小動物有一張像老鼠的臉，但尾巴柔軟得多。
In the dim alley, his quick, ratlike movements made everyone uneasy. 在昏暗的小巷裡，他那種像老鼠般迅速的動作讓每個人都覺得不安。
The sailor climbed the ratline to reach the upper rigging. 那名水手沿著攀索橫繩爬上高處索具。
A broken ratline can make work on the mast dangerous. 一條斷掉的桅索踏繩會讓桅杆上的工作變得危險。
The young ratliner spent the morning repairing the worn rigging. 那位年輕水手花了一整個上午修補磨損的索具。
An experienced ratliner could work high above the deck without fear. 有經驗的裝索水手能在甲板高處從容工作。
The farmer left the cane roots in place to produce a ratoon crop. 那位農夫把甘蔗根留在地裡，好讓它長出再生作物。
A healthy ratoon can save both time and labor in the next season. 健康的再生芽能在下一季節省不少時間與人力。
The ratooner checked the field for fresh shoots after the harvest. 那位再生作物種植者在收成後查看田裡的新芽。
A skilled ratooner knows when the old roots are still worth keeping. 熟練的再生作物栽培者知道什麼時候舊根還值得保留。
They stored the grain in a ratproof metal bin. 他們把穀物存放在防鼠的金屬桶裡。
A ratproof design matters most in old warehouses near the river. 在靠河的老倉庫裡，防鼠設計格外重要。
The caretaker set out ratsbane in the corners of the cellar. 管理員把滅鼠藥放在地下室的角落。
Children should never be allowed near open ratsbane. 絕不能讓孩子靠近未收好的滅鼠藥。

meaning: 地下酒館；市政廳地下餐館
sentences: We ate supper in a warm old ratskeller beneath the town hall. 我們在市政廳地下那間溫暖的老酒館裡吃晚餐。
The ratskeller was famous for dark beer and slow music. 那間地下酒館以黑啤酒和舒緩音樂聞名。
The rattage of loose boards kept everyone awake. 鬆動木板發出的嘎嘎聲讓所有人都睡不著。
Street rattage rose sharply when the carts rolled past. 當手推車經過時，街上的喧鬧聲一下子大了起來。

meaning: 細長尾；鼠尾魚；鼠尾狀物
sentences: The deep-sea net brought up a strange rattail from the dark water. 深海拖網從黑暗海水裡撈上一條奇特的鼠尾魚。
Her braid hung down her back like a rattail. 她的辮子垂在背後，像一條細細的鼠尾。
The chair was woven from pale rattan and felt surprisingly light. 那張椅子是用淺色藤材編成的，拿起來意外地輕。
A basket maker can shape damp rattan into strong curves. 籃匠能把濕潤的藤材塑成結實的彎曲形狀。
The tailor used ratteen for a warm winter coat. 裁縫用厚斜紋絨布做了一件保暖冬衣。
A bolt of ratteen lay folded on the cutting table. 一匹厚斜紋絨布摺好放在裁布桌上。

meaning: 工會式破壞；以恐嚇手段騷擾
sentences: The old report accuses the group of ratten during the strike. 那份舊報告指控該團體在罷工期間從事破壞與恐嚇。
Stories of ratten spread fear among small workshop owners. 關於這種騷擾破壞的傳聞在小工坊主之間引起恐懼。
The watchman caught the rattener tampering with the mill tools. 守夜人逮到那個破壞者正在動磨坊工具的手腳。
A child had become the secret rattener of every loose window in the house. 有個孩子成了家裡每扇鬆動窗戶背後偷偷弄出聲音的人。
The farmer kept a terrier as a skilled ratter in the barn. 農夫在穀倉裡養了一隻善於捕鼠的㹴犬。
They never forgave him after calling him a ratter in public. 在公開場合把他罵成變節者之後，大家就再也沒有原諒他。
The alley behind the market had turned into a filthy rattery. 市場後方那條巷子已經變成骯髒的鼠窩。
The scientist kept a small rattery for controlled breeding studies. 那位科學家設置了一間小型養鼠室，用於受控繁殖研究。

meaning: 拉蒂，印度傳統重量單位
sentences: The jeweler weighed the gem in ratti before quoting a price. 那位珠寶商先用拉蒂這個傳統單位為寶石秤重，再開價。
Old trade manuals sometimes list pearl weights in ratti. 舊式貿易手冊有時會用拉蒂來記錄珍珠重量。
She chose rattinet for a coat lining that needed to feel soft. 她選用細斜紋絨布來做外套內裡，因為手感較柔軟。
The fabric merchant unfolded a roll of dark blue rattinet. 布商攤開了一卷深藍色細斜紋絨布。
His rattish face peered out from behind the curtain. 他那張像老鼠般的臉從窗簾後方探了出來。
The detective distrusted the witness because of his rattish manner. 偵探因那名證人鬼鬼祟祟的樣子而不信任他。
The old car began to rattle as it drove down the bumpy country road. 舊車在崎嶇的山路上行駛時開始發出嘎嘎聲。
Don't let the criticism rattle you; stay focused on your own work and goals. 不要讓批評使你驚惶失措；專注於自己的工作和目標。

meaning: 喋喋不休的人；會發響聲的袋子
sentences: Everyone at the office knew him as a cheerful rattlebag. 辦公室裡每個人都知道他是個愛說個不停的人。
The child shook the old rattlebag just to hear the seeds inside. 那孩子搖著那個會發出聲響的舊袋子，只為聽裡面種子的聲音。

meaning: 瘦骨嶙峋的人；骨頭咯咯作響的人
sentences: The village children laughed and called the scarecrow rattlebones. 村裡的孩子笑著把那個稻草人叫作瘦骨嶙峋的傢伙。
He was all elbows and knees, a true rattlebones after the long winter. 漫長冬天過後，他瘦得只剩手肘和膝蓋，活像個瘦骨如柴的人。

meaning: 會發響聲的盒子；聒噪的人
sentences: The baby smiled whenever the bright rattlebox was shaken. 每當彩色的響盒被搖動時，嬰兒就會笑起來。
In the neighborhood, she had a reputation as a harmless rattlebox. 在鄰里之間，她以愛說話卻無害著稱。
Do not trust that rattlebrain with the cash box. 別把現金盒交給那個輕率愚蠢的人。
He acted like a rattlebrain whenever he had an audience. 只要有人圍觀，他就表現得像個沒頭腦的傢伙。
Her rattlebrained plan nearly cost the team a month's work. 她那個輕率無腦的計畫，差點讓團隊白費一個月的努力。
He was charming but hopelessly rattlebrained under pressure. 他雖然討喜，但一有壓力就顯得非常沒頭腦。

meaning: 響豆灌木；一種果莢會作響的植物
sentences: A dry rattlebush shook noisily in the hot wind. 一叢乾燥的響豆灌木在熱風中發出沙沙作響的聲音。
The children picked a pod from the rattlebush and used it as a toy. 孩子們從那株果莢會響的植物上摘下一個豆莢，拿來當玩具。
She looked rattled after the unexpected question from the judge. 法官突然發問後，她看起來有些慌亂。
Even the veteran pilot sounded rattled on the radio. 就連經驗豐富的飛行員在無線電裡都顯得有些受驚。
Only a complete rattlehead would drive that fast in the rain. 只有十足沒頭腦的人才會在雨中開那麼快。
The captain scolded the young rattlehead for ignoring the map. 船長責罵那個魯莽的年輕人，因為他完全不看地圖。
It was a rattleheaded decision made in pure excitement. 那是個一時興奮下做出的魯莽決定。
His rattleheaded confidence vanished when the real work began. 真正工作開始後，他那種沒頭腦的自信很快就消失了。

meaning: 老舊嘎響的車；聒噪的人
sentences: The farmer still drove the same rattlejack he had used for twenty years. 那位農夫仍開著那輛用了二十年的嘎嘎作響老車。
We could hear the rattlejack coming up the lane long before we saw it. 我們還沒看見那輛車，就先聽見它沿著小路嘎嘎作響地開來。

meaning: 會發出細碎聲響的小鼠；鼩鼱類小動物
sentences: A rattlemouse darted through the dry leaves at dusk. 黃昏時，一隻小小的會發出沙沙聲的鼠類從枯葉間竄過。
The cat sat still, listening for the rattlemouse beneath the floorboards. 那隻貓靜靜坐著，聽地板下那隻小鼠發出的細碎聲響。

meaning: 響子果；會發出聲響的果莢或種子
sentences: The dried rattlenut made a sharp sound when shaken. 那顆乾掉的響子果一搖就會發出清脆聲響。
Children collected rattlenut pods and strung them into toys. 孩子們把會響的果莢收集起來，串成玩具。

meaning: 糊塗又多話的人；輕浮空心的人
sentences: Everyone laughed when the village rattlepate forgot his own speech and started telling jokes. 大家都笑了，因為村裡那個冒失多話的人忘了自己的講稿，反而開始講笑話。
She called herself a rattlepate after misplacing the keys for the third time that week. 她那週第三次弄丟鑰匙後，便自嘲自己是個糊塗鬼。

meaning: 糊塗輕浮的；沒頭沒腦的
sentences: His rattlepated plan involved quitting his job before he had even checked the contract. 他那個糊裡糊塗的計畫竟然是在還沒看合約前就先辭職。
The novel's hero is charming but hopelessly rattlepated in matters of money. 小說主角很迷人，但一碰到金錢問題就糊塗得沒救。

meaning: 響莢植物；乾燥豆莢會發聲的豆科植物
sentences: The children shook a dried rattlepod and listened to the seeds clicking inside. 孩子們搖著乾掉的響莢植物，聽著裡頭種子喀喀作響。
Rattlepod can spread quickly along roadsides if the seed pods are left undisturbed. 如果讓種莢自然留著，響莢植物很快就會沿著路邊蔓延。
We added rubber washers to make the metal cover more rattleproof on rough roads. 我們加了橡膠墊圈，讓金屬蓋在顛簸路面上更不會發出碰撞聲。
The designer wanted a rattleproof case because the recorder would be carried in a backpack all day. 設計師想做一個防晃不作響的外殼，因為那台錄音機整天都要放在背包裡。

meaning: 響尾蛇；會嘎嘎作響的東西
sentences: The hiker froze when he realized the coil beside the rock was a rattler. 登山客一發現岩石旁蜷著的是一條響尾蛇，立刻僵住了。
In old Western stories, a rattler often appears before the hero notices the danger. 在老西部故事裡，響尾蛇常在主角察覺危險前先出現。
The cook simmered rattleran until it became tender. 廚師慢燉牛胸腹肉，直到它變軟。
Rattleran works well in a rich stew. 牛胸腹肉很適合做濃郁燉菜。

meaning: 乾根會作響的植物；響根草
sentences: The guide pointed out a patch of rattleroot near the fence and warned us not to pull it up. 導覽員指著圍籬旁一叢響根草，提醒我們不要隨便拔起來。
Traditional herb books sometimes mention rattleroot as a plant with a dry, noisy root. 傳統草藥書有時會提到 rattleroot，說它的乾根會發出沙沙聲。

meaning: 果莢會作響的樹；響莢樹
sentences: When the pods dried in late summer, the rattlertree sounded alive in the wind. 夏末果莢乾掉後，那棵響莢樹一吹風就像活過來似地作響。
The gardener kept the rattlertree for its odd music as much as for its shade. 園丁留下那棵響莢樹，不只是為了樹蔭，也為了它奇特的聲響。
The old bus gave a chorus of rattles every time it crossed the bridge. 那台舊巴士每次過橋都會發出一連串嘎啦聲。
Silver rattles were once given as keepsakes for newborns in some families. 在一些家庭裡，銀製搖鈴曾經是送給新生兒的紀念禮物。
Only a rattleskull would bet his rent money on a rumor from the bar. 只有冒失又愚笨的人，才會把房租拿去押在酒吧裡聽來的流言上。
Her uncle was affectionate but such a rattleskull that nobody trusted him with directions. 她叔叔雖然和氣，但實在太冒失，沒人敢相信他指路。
The committee rejected the rattleskulled proposal after two minutes of discussion. 委員會討論兩分鐘後就否決了那個輕率無腦的提案。
He made a rattleskulled remark and spent the rest of dinner trying to fix the damage. 他說了一句不經大腦的話，結果整場晚餐都在努力補救。
A rattlesnake shook its tail in the dry grass before sliding away. 一條響尾蛇在乾草裡甩動尾巴發出警告後才滑走。
The ranger taught us how to back away calmly if we ever met a rattlesnake on the trail. 巡山員教我們，如果在山徑上遇到響尾蛇，該如何冷靜後退。

meaning: 喀啦作響的；吵鬧惱人的
sentences: The loose window frame grew more rattlesome whenever the north wind picked up. 北風一強，鬆動的窗框就變得更喀啦作響。
His rattlesome cough kept the whole carriage awake through the night. 他那陣惱人的咳嗽吵得整節車廂整晚都睡不好。

meaning: 破舊又吵的東西；老爺車
sentences: They arrived in a blue rattletrap that sounded as if every bolt were loose. 他們開著一輛藍色破車來，聽起來像每顆螺絲都鬆了。
The theater troupe hauled its costumes across the county in a stubborn old rattletrap. 那個劇團開著一輛頑固的老爺車，把戲服一路載遍整個郡。

meaning: 響草；廣義指某些乾果會作響的植物
sentences: The field was dotted with rattleweed, and the dry pods clicked under our boots. 田裡零星長著響草，我們一踩過去，乾莢就在腳邊喀喀作響。
Farmers pulled the rattleweed before it crowded out the young beans. 農夫在響草擠掉幼豆之前就先把它清掉了。
A note in the herbarium identified the specimen as rattlewort from the coastal plain. 標本館裡的一張註記把這份植物標本標為來自海岸平原的響果草。
Rattlewort was easy to recognize once the pods dried and began to shake. 一旦莢果乾掉開始作響，響果草就很容易辨認。

meaning: 喀啦作響的；飛快有勁的；極好的
sentences: We heard a rattling noise from the heater before it stopped working altogether. 暖氣在徹底壞掉前，先傳出一陣喀啦作響的聲音。
She set a rattling pace on the climb, and nobody could keep up with her. 她上坡時走得飛快，沒有人跟得上。
The cart rolled rattlingly over the stones and woke the dogs in every yard. 那輛手推車喀啦作響地碾過石路，把每個院子裡的狗都吵醒了。
For an old-fashioned phrase, the reviewer called the new detective novel rattlingly good. 用一種老派說法，那位評論者稱這本新偵探小說好看得不得了。

meaning: 喀啦作響或充滿勁道的特質
sentences: What annoyed him was not the volume of the engine but its constant rattlingness at low speed. 讓他受不了的不是引擎多大聲，而是它低速時持續不斷的喀啦感。
The coach loved the rattlingness of the team's start, saying it showed real urgency. 教練很欣賞球隊開局那股猛勁，說那顯示出真正的企圖心。

meaning: 喀啦作響的；鬆鬆垮垮有雜聲的
sentences: This old fan still works, but it has become so rattly that I only use it in emergencies. 這台舊電扇還能用，但已經吵到喀啦作響，我只在緊急時才會開。
The drawer felt rattly because one of the side rails had come loose. 抽屜摸起來鬆鬆響響的，因為旁邊一條滑軌鬆了。
A ratton chewed a hole in the grain sack. 一隻老鼠把穀袋咬出洞。
The farmer set a trap after seeing a ratton in the barn. 農夫在穀倉看到老鼠後設了陷阱。
The town once hired a rattoner to keep the market stores free of vermin. 那個鎮以前會雇一名捕鼠人，避免市場倉庫鼠患成災。
In the archive, a rattoner was paid less than the lamplighter but more than the sweep. 在檔案紀錄裡，捕鼠人的薪水比點燈人低，卻比清掃工高。
He set a rattrap behind the pantry after hearing scratching in the wall. 他聽見牆裡有抓刮聲後，就在儲藏室後方放了一個捕鼠器。
The museum displayed an iron rattrap that looked more brutal than clever. 博物館展出一個鐵製捕鼠器，看起來殘酷多於巧妙。
Rattus includes several common rat species. 鼠屬包含數種常見的鼠類。
Researchers compared Rattus with other rodent genera. 研究人員把鼠屬和其他囓齒類屬做比較。
He showed up in a ratty sweater with paint on both sleeves. 他穿著一件破舊毛衣來，兩邊袖子都沾了油漆。
I get ratty when meetings drift on without a clear decision. 會議拖著卻沒有明確結論時，我就會變得很煩躁。
At dawn we saw a ratwa slip through the undergrowth and vanish almost at once. 天剛亮時，我們看見一隻麂穿過灌叢，轉眼就消失了。
The guide said the ratwa is easier to hear than to see because it barks from cover. 嚮導說，ratwa 躲在掩蔽物裡會像狗一樣叫，所以通常先聽到聲音才看得到。

meaning: 一種加勒比海常綠灌木
sentences: The botanist collected leaves from the ratwood. 植物學家從這種灌木採集了葉片。
Ratwood grows in warm coastal habitats. 這種灌木生長在溫暖的海岸棲地。
After three nights of singing, his voice turned dry and raucid. 連唱三晚後，他的嗓音變得乾澀而嘶啞。
The speaker's raucid laugh filled the narrow room before anyone saw him enter. 那名講者還沒進門，粗啞的笑聲就先充滿了狹小房間。
Years of shouting over factory noise had left a permanent raucidity in her voice. 多年在工廠噪音中大喊，讓她的聲音留下了永久的粗啞感。
The actor used a touch of raucidity to make the old sailor sound convincing. 那位演員在聲音裡加上一點沙啞粗糙感，讓老水手這個角色更可信。
The trumpet's raucity cut through the parade like a blade. 小號那種刺耳的粗啞聲像刀一樣劃過遊行隊伍。
What the recording lacked in polish, it made up for in raw raucity. 那段錄音雖然不夠精緻，卻以原始粗獷的刺耳感彌補了不足。
At night, raucous ruckus took place in the swamp. 夜裡，沼澤地傳來喧鬧的聲音。
The report describes the result as raucous. 報告將結果描述為喧鬧。
The crows cried raucously above the empty parking lot. 烏鴉在空蕩的停車場上方發出沙啞刺耳的叫聲。
He laughed raucously after hearing the last joke. 他聽完最後一個笑話後放聲大笑，聲音又粗又響。
The raucousness of the crowd made the speaker pause. 人群喧鬧刺耳的聲浪讓講者停頓了一下。
Her voice had gained a rough raucousness after the long concert. 經過那場長時間演唱會後，她的聲音多了一股粗啞感。
The letter was at last raught from the back of the shelf. 那封信終於從書架深處被取了出來。
A raught branch lay across the path after the storm. 暴風雨後，一截被拉扯下來的樹枝橫在小路上。
The farmer used a raugrave to break the hard clods after plowing. 農夫在犁地後用粗齒耙打碎硬土塊。
A heavy raugrave leaned against the barn wall beside the spades. 一把沉重的耙子靠在穀倉牆邊，旁邊放著幾把鏟子。
Tourists walked down to the shore to photograph the rauk at sunset. 遊客們走下海岸，在日落時拍攝那座海蝕石柱。
The rauk stood alone against the gray sea and wind. 那座孤立岩柱獨自立在灰色海面與風中。
An old sailor began to raukle commands through the fog. 一名老水手開始用沙啞的聲音在霧中喊出指令。
The actor raukled the final line to make it sound more desperate. 那位演員把最後一句台詞說得又粗又啞，讓它聽起來更絕望。
Raul arrived early and set out the chairs before the guests came. 勞爾提早到了，在客人來之前先把椅子排好。
The note from Raul was brief but full of warmth. 勞爾寫來的便條雖然簡短，卻充滿溫度。
The carpenter chose rauli for the warm tone of its wood. 木匠因為那種木材色調溫暖而選用了勞利樹木。
A stand of rauli covered the hillside above the river. 河流上方的山坡長滿了一片智利山毛櫸。
The old house still showed a dark raun across the ceiling. 那棟老房子的天花板上仍可看見一根深色橫梁。
A cracked raun had to be replaced before the roof could be repaired. 在修屋頂之前，那根裂開的木樑必須先換掉。
He continued to raunge about the delay all the way home. 他一路回家都還在碎念抱怨那場延誤。
The old man liked to raunge at the weather whenever it changed. 那位老人每逢天氣一變就愛嘀咕責罵。
The edges of the wetland were thick with raupo. 濕地邊緣長滿了香蒲。
In some old settlements, raupo was used as a building material. 在一些早期聚落裡，香蒲曾被用作建材。
His rauque voice gave the speech an air of urgency. 他沙啞的聲音讓那場演講帶上一種急迫感。
A rauque cry echoed from the dark trees near the road. 一聲刺耳的叫喊從路邊黑暗的樹林裡傳來。

meaning: 勞拉奇人，古代高盧部族
sentences: The historian linked the settlement to the ancient Rauraci. 歷史學家把那處聚落和古代勞拉奇人聯繫起來。
Artifacts from the Rauraci were displayed beside Roman coins. 勞拉奇人的文物被陳列在羅馬錢幣旁邊。

meaning: 勞里奇人，古代部族名稱
sentences: Some older maps use Raurici where newer books prefer another form. 有些舊地圖使用勞里奇人這個名稱，而較新的書則採用其他拼法。
The lecture noted that the Raurici lived near the upper Rhine. 那場講座提到勞里奇人居住在萊茵河上游附近。
The botanist pointed out Rauwolfia in the medicinal plant garden. 植物學家在藥用植物園裡指出了蘿芙木屬植物。
Several species of Rauwolfia have been studied for alkaloids. 蘿芙木屬中的幾個物種曾因生物鹼而被研究。
The wildfire continued to ravage the dry valley for three days. 那場野火連續三天肆虐乾燥的山谷。
Years of war had ravaged the once-busy town. 多年的戰爭摧毀了這座曾經繁忙的小鎮。
The ravagement of the forest was visible from the hill. 從山上可以看見森林遭到嚴重破壞。
The town slowly recovered after years of ravagement. 多年破壞後，小鎮慢慢恢復。
The army was remembered as the great ravager of the region. 那支軍隊被記為這個地區的大破壞者。
The sea can be a ravager when storms strike the coast. 暴風襲擊海岸時，大海也可能成為無情的摧毀者。

meaning: 以過度的熱情、熱情或興奮的語氣說話。
sentences: He raved about her beauty. 他對她的美麗讚不絕口。
To rave means to talk with excessive enthusiasm, passion or excitement. 狂歡意味著以過度的熱情、激情或興奮來交談。
The worker used a ravehook to pull the heavy sack closer. 那名工人用彎鉤工具把沉重的麻袋勾近一些。
A rusty ravehook hung on the wall beside the rope coils. 一把生鏽的鉤具掛在牆上，旁邊是盤好的繩索。
The rain carved a raveinelike channel through the loose soil. 雨水在鬆軟的土壤上沖出一道像小峽谷般的溝槽。
A raveinelike cut split the hillside after the storm. 暴風雨過後，山坡上裂出一道像沖溝般的深痕。
Do not ravel the thread before I finish the pattern. 在我完成圖樣前，不要把線拆散。
The mystery slowly began to ravel as new documents appeared. 隨著新文件出現，那個謎團開始逐漸解開。
He was known as a raveler of knots and old arguments alike. 他以能解開繩結和陳年爭議而聞名。
The child acted as a tiny raveler, pulling at every loose thread. 那個孩子像個小小拆解者，拉扯著每一根鬆掉的線。

meaning: 三角堡外堡；稜堡前方的防禦工事
sentences: The guide explained how the ravelin protected the gate from direct attack. 導覽員解釋了那座外堡如何保護城門免受正面攻擊。
Only part of the old ravelin remains beside the dry moat. 乾涸壕溝旁只剩下一部分古老外堡。
The raveling of the sweater began at one loose stitch. 那件毛衣的鬆脫是從一針鬆線開始的。
She watched the slow raveling of the rope in her hands. 她看著手中的繩子一點點散開。
The cloth felt soft but slightly ravelly at the edges. 那塊布摸起來很柔軟，但邊緣有點容易鬆散。
Her hair turned ravelly in the sea wind. 她的頭髮在海風裡變得糾結散亂。
The legal case had become a ravelment of half-finished claims. 那宗法律案件已經變成一團未竟主張交纏的亂局。
She patiently sorted the ravelment of ribbons in the drawer. 她耐心整理抽屜裡那團纏在一起的絲帶。
The tailor chose a ravelproof fabric for the school uniform. 裁縫為校服選用了一種不易散邊的布料。
A ravelproof edge keeps the cloth neat after repeated washing. 不易鬆散的包邊能讓布料在多次清洗後仍保持整齊。

meaning: 尤其是頭髮：烏鴉羽毛的烏黑且通常有光澤的顏色（字源 1，名詞意義 1）。
sentences: raven curls raven darkness 烏鴉捲髮烏鴉黑暗
She was a tall, sophisticated, raven-haired beauty. 她是一位身材高挑、精緻、黑髮的美女。
A tall Ravenala spread its fan-shaped leaves over the path. 一株高大的旅人蕉屬植物把扇形葉片展開在小徑上方。
The garden label identified the plant as Ravenala rather than a true palm. 花園標牌說明這株植物屬於旅人蕉屬，而不是真正的棕櫚。
At dusk the field seemed to belong entirely to ravendom. 黃昏時，那片田野彷彿完全屬於烏鴉群。
The poet used ravendom as a dark image for winter silence. 詩人把 ravendom 當成冬日寂靜的陰暗意象。
A ravenduck drifted just beyond the line of breaking waves. 一隻黑色海鴨漂浮在碎浪外側。
Birders were excited to spot a ravenduck among the winter flocks. 賞鳥者很興奮能在冬季鳥群中看到這種深色海鴨。
The botanist identified the leaf spots as being caused by Ravenelia. 植物學家辨認出那些葉斑是由銹菌屬真菌引起的。
Ravenelia often appears in technical papers on plant disease. 銹菌屬這個名稱常出現在植物病害的專業論文中。
The villagers feared the ravener that struck at night and vanished by dawn. 村民們害怕那個夜裡掠奪、天亮就消失的劫掠者。
In the poem, war itself is described as a blind ravener. 在那首詩裡，戰爭本身被描寫成一個盲目的吞噬者。
The bird's bold theft showed a touch of ravenhood. 那隻鳥大膽偷食，展現出一點烏鴉般的習性。
The story uses ravenhood to suggest hunger and cleverness. 這個故事用烏鴉習性暗示飢餓與狡猾。
A ravening pack moved through the hills after sunset. 一群貪婪掠食的野獸在日落後穿過山丘。
The novel paints famine as a ravening force that strips a village bare. 那部小說把饑荒寫成一股吞噬一切的力量，讓村莊一無所有。

meaning: 像烏鴉的；貪食的；烏黑的
sentences: His ravenish hair made him easy to spot in the crowd. 他那頭烏黑的頭髮讓他在人群裡很容易被認出。
The child's ravenish appetite surprised the whole family. 那孩子狼吞虎嚥般的食慾讓全家都很驚訝。
The figure had a ravenlike profile against the winter sky. 那個人影在冬日天空下顯得有種烏鴉般的側影。
A ravenlike cry echoed across the empty field. 一聲像烏鴉般的叫聲回蕩在空曠的田野上。

meaning: 飢餓難耐的；狼吞虎嚥的
sentences: After the long hike, we were all ravenous by noon. 長途健行後，我們中午時全都餓得發慌。
The puppies were ravenous and finished the bowl in seconds. 那幾隻小狗餓壞了，幾秒內就把整碗食物吃光。
He ate ravenously after working in the sun all day. 他在烈日下工作了一整天後，狼吞虎嚥地吃了起來。
The stray dog watched the bread ravenously from the doorway. 那隻流浪狗從門口帶著極度飢餓的眼神盯著那塊麵包。
The ravenousness of the children made the picnic disappear quickly. 孩子們的飢餓程度，讓野餐食物很快就被吃光。
His sudden ravenousness worried the doctor more than the fever did. 他突如其來的極度飢餓，比發燒本身更讓醫生擔心。
A noisy ravenry gathered on the old church roof at dusk. 一群吵鬧的烏鴉在黃昏時聚到舊教堂屋頂上。
The warlord was followed by a ravenry of thieves and scouts. 那名軍閥身後跟著一群像烏鴉般的盜匪與斥候。
Two ravens circled above the cliff in the cold wind. 兩隻烏鴉在寒風中盤旋於懸崖上方。
The old legend says ravens carry messages between worlds. 古老傳說說烏鴉會在不同世界之間傳遞訊息。
The label identified the aromatic tree as Ravensara. 標籤把那棵芳香樹木標示為拉文薩拉屬。
Researchers discussed Ravensara in a paper on island flora. 研究人員在一篇島嶼植物群論文中討論了拉文薩拉屬。

meaning: 拉文薩拉，一種芳香植物或其精油
sentences: The shop sold ravensara oil beside lavender and cedar. 那家店把拉文薩拉精油和薰衣草、雪松精油擺在一起販售。
Some herbal guides mention ravensara for its strong scent. 有些草藥指南會提到拉文薩拉，因為它氣味很濃。
The monument was carved from a dark block of ravenstone. 那座紀念碑是用一大塊烏黑石材雕成的。
Children in the village believed ravenstone could ward off bad luck. 村裡的孩子相信烏鴉石可以驅走壞運氣。
The bird tilted its head ravenwise before stealing the bread. 那隻鳥像烏鴉似地歪著頭，然後叼走了麵包。
He watched the glittering coin ravenwise from the wall. 他像隻烏鴉般從牆上盯著那枚發亮的硬幣。
The last raver left the warehouse just after sunrise. 最後一名狂歡者在日出後不久離開了倉庫。
In debates, he sounds less like a critic and more like a raver. 在辯論中，他聽起來比較像情緒激動的狂熱發言者，而不是評論者。
Ravi arrived early and quietly helped arrange the chairs. 拉維提早到場，安靜地幫忙排好椅子。
The map showed the Ravi winding through the northern plains. 地圖顯示拉維河蜿蜒流過北方平原。

meaning: 法式香草酸味醬；使恢復精神之物
sentences: The chef served cold fish with a bright green ravigote. 主廚用一份鮮綠的法式香草酸味醬搭配冷魚料理。
A hot shower and strong coffee were the perfect ravigote after the trip. 洗個熱水澡再喝杯濃咖啡，簡直是旅途後最好的提神方式。
The horses had to pick their way around a steep ravin. 馬匹不得不小心繞過一道陡峭的沖溝。
After years of rain, a narrow ravin cut through the hillside. 多年雨水沖刷後，山坡上形成了一道狹窄的小峽谷。
Heavy runoff can ravinate a hillside within a few seasons. 強烈的逕流可能在幾個季節內就把山坡沖蝕成溝。
The storm began to ravinate the soft earth near the road. 暴風雨開始把道路附近的鬆軟土壤沖出溝痕。
Ravindran checked the figures twice before approving the report. 拉文德蘭在核准報告前把數字確認了兩次。
The article quotes Ravindran on the need for patient reform. 那篇文章引用了拉文德蘭對漸進改革必要性的看法。
Ravindranath is remembered for a voice both gentle and firm. 拉文德拉納特以溫和而堅定的聲音為人所記得。
The letter was signed simply, "Ravindranath." 那封信只簡單地署名「拉文德拉納特」。
We crossed the ravine by a narrow bridge. 我們走過一座狹窄的橋跨越峽谷。
Water had carved a deep ravine in the hillside. 水流在山坡上切出一道深峽谷。

meaning: 多溝谷的；被沖蝕成峽谷的
sentences: The travelers crossed a ravined landscape before reaching the coast. 旅人們穿越一片滿是溝谷的地形後才抵達海岸。
A ravined slope can be dangerous after heavy rain. 被沖蝕出深溝的山坡在豪雨後可能很危險。
Years of ravinement had left the valley walls jagged and bare. 多年的沖蝕成溝作用讓谷壁變得鋸齒狀而裸露。
The map shows clear ravinement along the old drainage line. 地圖顯示舊排水線上有明顯的溝谷化痕跡。
The raviney country made travel slow and exhausting. 多溝谷的地形讓旅程緩慢而疲憊。
A raviney hillside can hide streams and sudden drops. 多峽谷的山坡可能藏著溪流和突然下陷的地勢。

meaning: 引起興奮或瘋狂的讚美。
sentences: She was not considered a raving beauty. 她並不被認為是一位絕色美女。
The report describes the result as raving. 報告稱這一結果令人驚嘆。
The fans spoke ravingly about the singer's new album. 粉絲們極度熱烈地談論那位歌手的新專輯。
He paced ravingly through the room after hearing the accusation. 他聽到指控後在房裡狂亂地來回踱步。
We ordered mushroom ravioli with brown butter sauce. 我們點了蘑菇義大利餛飩，搭配褐奶油醬。
Homemade ravioli takes patience but rewards careful hands. 自製義式方餃很費工，但對細心的人來說很值得。
The singer's voice can ravish an audience. 那位歌手的嗓音能讓觀眾陶醉。
Older legal writing used ravish in a much harsher sense. 較早的法律文字中，這個動詞有更嚴厲的意思。
She listened ravishedly as the violin rose into the final phrase. 她陶醉地聆聽著小提琴進入最後一句旋律。
The child stared ravishedly at the lanterns floating into the sky. 那孩子欣喜若狂地望著一盞盞燈籠飄向天空。

meaning: 使人著迷者；強奪者（舊用）
sentences: The poem calls spring a ravisher of tired hearts. 詩中把春天稱為使疲憊心靈著迷的存在。
In the old tale, the ravisher was punished by the king. 在那則古老故事裡，強奪者受到國王懲罰。

meaning: 非常迷人的；令人陶醉的
sentences: She wore a ravishing blue dress to the concert. 她穿著一件非常迷人的藍色洋裝去聽音樂會。
The sunset over the harbor was so ravishing that everyone fell silent. 港口上的夕陽美得令人陶醉，大家都安靜了下來。

meaning: 非常迷人地；極其美麗地
sentences: The room was ravishingly decorated with flowers and warm lights. 房間用鮮花和溫暖的燈光布置得極其迷人。
She smiled ravishingly, and the whole table noticed. 她笑得非常動人，整桌的人都注意到了。
He spoke about the violin with almost religious ravishment. 他談起小提琴時，幾乎帶著一種近乎虔誠的陶醉。
In the legal history book, ravishment referred to abduction and assault. 在那本法律史書裡，ravishment 指的是綁架與強行侵犯。
The old tale says the invaders carried off gold, cattle, and other ravison. 那個古老傳說說，入侵者帶走了黃金、牲畜和其他掠奪物。
He treated every bargain like ravison, as if winning meant taking. 他把每次交易都當成掠奪，彷彿贏了就等於搶到手。
The little cafe had a ravissant charm that made people linger. 那間小咖啡館有種迷人的氣質，讓人捨不得離開。
Her ravissant manners won over the skeptical guests. 她那討人喜歡的舉止讓原本懷疑的賓客也被打動了。
I prefer to eat my vegetables raw in a fresh garden salad. 我比較喜歡在新鮮的花園沙拉裡生吃蔬菜。
The company imports raw materials from various foreign countries. 公司從各個外國進口原材料。
The rawboned horse looked tougher than it did graceful. 那匹瘦骨嶙峋的馬看起來比起優雅更像是結實。
He was tall and rawboned, with elbows like door hinges. 他又高又瘦骨嶙峋，手肘像門鉸鏈一樣突出。

meaning: 瘦骨嶙峋的人；骨感的人
sentences: The new recruit was a rawbones until the winter training filled him out. 那名新兵一直瘦骨嶙峋，直到冬訓才長得結實些。
In the sketch, the detective looked like a rawbones who had skipped too many meals. 那幅素描裡，偵探看起來就像個長期沒好好吃飯的瘦骨嶙峋之人。
