He reached for a reamer when the drill left the hole slightly uneven. 鑽頭留下的孔有點不整齊時，他拿起了鉸刀。
The reamer sat in a foam-lined drawer beside the other precision tools. 那把擴孔器放在鋪著泡棉的抽屜裡，旁邊還有其他精密工具。
As the shop's most careful reamerer, he checked each opening twice before finishing. 身為店裡最細心的擴孔工，他每個孔都會在收工前再檢查兩次。
The old manual called the reamerer a craftsman who valued accuracy over speed. 那本老式手冊把擴孔工描述成重視準確勝過速度的匠人。

meaning: 奶油般的濃稠感；柔滑感
sentences: The soup had a gentle reaminess that made it feel rich without being heavy. 那碗湯帶著柔滑的奶油感，濃郁卻不會太膩。
She liked the reaminess of the lotion because it spread evenly and vanished into the skin. 她喜歡那乳霜般的柔滑感，因為它很好推開，也很快被皮膚吸收。

meaning: 再次截肢；重做截肢手術
sentences: The doctors discussed a reamputation only after the infection spread farther than expected. 醫師是在感染擴散得比預期更遠之後，才討論是否要再次截肢。
A reamputation is never the easy option, but sometimes it is the safest one. 再次截肢從來不是容易的選擇，但有時卻是最安全的。
His silly doodles were enough to reamuse the children after lunch. 午飯後，他那些傻氣的塗鴉就足以再次逗樂孩子們。
Nothing seemed to reamuse her until the cat jumped into the laundry basket. 直到那隻貓跳進洗衣籃，她才又被逗笑。
The sauce turned reamy after the butter melted into it. 奶油融進去之後，醬汁就變得滑順濃稠。
She described the texture as reamy, almost like soft custard. 她形容那口感很奶油般，幾乎像柔軟的卡士達。
A reanalysis of the survey data changed the conclusion entirely. 對調查資料重新分析後，結論整個改變了。
The historian's reanalysis gave the old event a more nuanced explanation. 那位歷史學家重新分析後，讓那起舊事件有了更細緻的解釋。
Please reanalyze the results before we brief the client. 在我們向客戶簡報前，請先把結果重新分析一次。
When the pattern looked suspicious, she decided to reanalyze every file from scratch. 當那個模式看起來有問題時，她決定把每個檔案從頭再分析。
They had to reanchor the tent after the wind shifted overnight. 夜裡風向一變，他們只好把帳篷重新固定好。
Moving abroad forced him to reanchor his daily life around new routines. 搬到國外後，他被迫圍繞新的作息重新安頓生活。

meaning: 使再度動物化；重新賦予動物特徵
sentences: The artist tried to reanimalize the figure with rough lines and a wild stare. 那位藝術家試著用粗線條和野性眼神，讓人物重新帶上動物感。
In the myth, a curse could reanimalize anyone who ignored the forest spirits. 在那則神話裡，任何無視森林精靈的人都可能被詛咒而再度獸化。
Fresh music seemed to reanimate the sleepy crowd within minutes. 新音樂似乎在幾分鐘內就讓昏昏欲睡的人群恢復了活力。
The doctor worked quickly to reanimate the patient after the heartbeat stopped. 心跳停住後，醫師迅速進行急救，試圖讓病人恢復生命跡象。
The reanimation of the garden came after a week of rain and careful pruning. 經過一週的雨水和細心修剪，花園又恢復了生氣。
In the film, the reanimation scene was eerie but strangely beautiful. 在那部電影裡，復甦的場景既詭異又帶點美感。
The technician had to reanneal the glass to relieve the stress inside it. 技術員必須把玻璃重新退火，才能釋放裡面的應力。
If the metal warps, you may need to reanneal it before the next stage. 如果金屬變形了，你可能得先重新退火再進行下一道工序。
The empire tried to reannex the territory, but local resistance was immediate. 帝國試圖重新併入那片領土，但當地人的抵抗立刻出現。
No country can simply reannex an area without provoking major conflict. 沒有任何國家能不引發重大衝突就直接再度吞併一個地區。
The reannexation of the province became the central issue in the debate. 重新併入那個省份，成了辯論的核心議題。
Historians still disagree about whether the reannexation was inevitable or avoidable. 歷史學家至今仍對那次重新併入究竟是不可避免還是可以避免看法不一。
She had to reannotate the manuscript after the editor changed the chapter order. 編輯更動章節順序後，她得把手稿重新註解一遍。
Researchers often reannotate images when a new label system becomes available. 當新的標記系統上線時，研究人員常常會把圖片重新標註。
The airline had to reannounce the gate change because many passengers missed the first notice. 因為很多乘客沒注意到第一次通知，航空公司只好重新公告登機門變更。
At noon, the school will reannounce the results over the loudspeaker. 中午時，學校會用廣播再宣布一次結果。
The reannouncement cleared up the confusion about the meeting time. 這次重新公告釐清了會議時間的混亂。
A reannouncement was necessary after the original message went out with the wrong date. 原始訊息把日期發錯了，所以有必要再次公告。
The buzzing fly managed to reannoy everyone in the room. 那隻嗡嗡飛來飛去的蒼蠅又把房間裡的人惹煩了。
He did not mean to reannoy her, but the repeated apologies had the opposite effect. 他本來不想再惹她煩，結果一再道歉反而適得其反。
The reannoyance came when the printer jammed for the third time that morning. 那天早上印表機第三次卡紙時，煩躁感又回來了。
She spoke with calm, but there was a clear reannoyance in her voice. 她說話雖然平靜，語氣裡卻明顯帶著又一次被惹惱的情緒。

meaning: to anoint again, especially for a ceremony or ritual
sentences: The priest reanointed the icon before the midnight service. 神父在午夜禮拜前再次為聖像塗上聖油。
After the ceremony, they gently reanointed the wound with healing oil. 典禮結束後，他們輕輕地再用藥油為傷口上藥。

meaning: to answer again, usually after a follow-up question or correction
sentences: She had to reanswer the question because the first reply was too vague. 她得重新回答那個問題，因為第一次的答覆太模糊了。
Please reanswer the form if any of your details have changed. 如果你的資料有變動，請重新填寫那份表單。

meaning: to shape or hammer again on an anvil
sentences: The blacksmith had to reanvil the strip of metal before it would hold its curve. 鐵匠得先把那條金屬條重新放上鐵砧敲打，才能讓它固定成弧形。
He reanviled the blade edge after noticing a small warp in the steel. 他發現鋼刃有些變形後，又重新在鐵砧上鍛打了一次。
A wave of reanxiety hit her when the phone rang late at night. 深夜電話響起時，她又湧上了一陣焦慮感。
He tried to breathe slowly and let the reanxiety pass before the meeting. 他試著慢慢呼吸，讓那股重新浮現的焦慮在會議前過去。
Farmers work hard to reap the wheat field before the heavy rain starts. 農民們在大雨開始前努力收割麥田。
You will reap the benefits of your hard work and dedication eventually. 你的努力和奉獻最終會讓你獲得（收穫）回報。

meaning: able to be harvested, gathered, or obtained again
sentences: The field was finally reapable after several weeks of dry weather. 經過好幾週乾燥的天氣後，那片田終於可以收割了。
Not every opportunity is reapable, so they moved quickly when the chance appeared. 不是每個機會都能再收穫一次，所以機會一出現他們就立刻行動。

meaning: a second allowance, share, or portion given again
sentences: The old story described a reapdole that was handed out after the harvest. 那個古老故事提到，收成後又分發了一次補給份額。
They treated the bonus as a reapdole for workers who stayed through the storm. 他們把那筆獎金當成留在風暴中的員工所得到的第二份補助。
The reaper moved slowly through the wheat field. 收割者緩慢地穿過麥田。
In the story, the reaper worked from dawn to dusk. 在故事裡，收割者從清晨忙到黃昏。
He called to reapologize after realizing how rude he had sounded. 他意識到自己剛才的語氣很失禮後，打電話再次道歉。
You do not need to reapologize for something that was never your fault. 有些事本來就不是你的錯，你不必一再道歉。
Her reapology arrived in a handwritten note the next morning. 她隔天早上用手寫便條再次表達歉意。
The manager accepted the reapology and moved the conversation on. 經理接受了那份再次道歉，並把話題帶向別處。

meaning: to dress again or outfit again
sentences: The museum staff reapparelled the mannequin in winter clothing for the new exhibit. 博物館員工為了新展覽，重新替假人穿上冬裝。
After the play, the crew had to reapparel the actors for the final curtain call. 演出結束後，工作人員還得重新幫演員換裝，準備最後謝幕。

meaning: a ghostly or striking appearance again
sentences: The old castle was said to have a sudden reapparition in the moonlight. 傳說那座古堡會在月光下突然出現幽影般的再現。
For the villagers, the reapparition of the missing bell felt almost supernatural. 對村民來說，那口失蹤的鐘再次出現，幾乎像是超自然現象。

meaning: to appeal again or make a renewed plea
sentences: The family decided to reappeal the decision after finding new evidence. 這家人找到新證據後，決定再次提出上訴。
She reappealed to the community for help when the first fundraiser fell short. 第一輪募款不夠後，她又向社區再次求助。

meaning: to appear again after being absent
sentences: The cat vanished under the porch and then reappeared ten minutes later. 那隻貓鑽到門廊底下後，十分鐘後又出現了。
When the clouds cleared, the mountain seemed to reappear out of nowhere. 雲一散開，那座山彷彿從空中重新浮現。
His reappearance at the reunion surprised everyone in the room. 他在同學會上的再次現身讓在場每個人都很驚訝。
The reappearance of sunlight made the whole harbor look warmer. 陽光再次出現後，整座港口都顯得溫暖了些。

meaning: to calm, satisfy, or soothe again
sentences: She offered tea to reappease the nervous guests after the alarm. 警報響過後，她端茶來再次安撫那些緊張的客人。
Nothing he said could reappease the crowd once the rumor spread. 一旦謠言傳開，他說什麼都無法再安撫群眾了。
The audience reapplauded when the singer returned for an encore. 當歌手回來安可時，觀眾再次鼓掌。
We all reapplauded the team after they saved the last-minute match. 球隊在最後一刻守住比賽後，我們全都又鼓掌了一次。

meaning: renewed applause or a second round of clapping
sentences: A wave of reapplause rolled through the theater after the final line. 最後一句台詞說完後，劇院裡再次響起一陣掌聲。
The teacher smiled at the reapplause that followed the student performance. 學生表演結束後再次響起的掌聲，讓老師露出了笑容。

meaning: a device or appliance brought back into use, or used again
sentences: They kept the old machine as a reappliance for backup power. 他們把那台舊機器留著，當作備用電力設備再次使用。
The repair shop offered a reappliance that could replace the broken heater. 維修店提供了一台可替代壞掉暖氣機的再用電器。

meaning: someone who applies again, especially for a job, school, or program
sentences: As a reapplicant, she knew exactly how to strengthen her interview answers. 身為再次申請的人，她很清楚該怎麼強化自己的面試回答。
The office welcomed each reapplicant with the same review process. 這個辦公室對每位重新申請者都採用相同的審查流程。
Her reapplication was approved after she added the missing documents. 她補上缺少的文件後，重新申請就通過了。
The scholarship allows reapplication in the following year if needed. 如果有需要，這項獎學金允許隔年再申請。

meaning: someone or something that applies again
sentences: The reapplier spent the weekend polishing her resume and portfolio. 那位重新申請者整個週末都在打磨履歷和作品集。
In this office, a reapplier must submit every form from the beginning. 在這個辦公室裡，重新申請的人必須從頭提交所有表格。

meaning: to apply again for something or to put on again
sentences: If the cream dries too fast, reapply a thin layer after ten minutes. 如果乳霜乾得太快，十分鐘後再薄擦一層。
He decided to reapply for the grant after improving his proposal. 他在改善提案後，決定再次申請那筆補助金。

meaning: to appoint again to the same position
sentences: The board chose to reappoint her as treasurer for another term. 董事會決定再任命她擔任下一任期的財務長。
They will reappoint the judge only if her record stays strong. 只有在她的表現持續穩定時，他們才會再次任命那位法官。

meaning: the act of appointing someone again
sentences: Her reappointment was announced during the annual meeting. 她的續任任命在年度會議上宣布了。
The committee discussed his reappointment before the vote. 委員會在投票前討論了他是否續任。

meaning: to divide and assign again, often in a different way
sentences: The city had to reapportion the budget after the storm damaged several roads. 風暴損壞了幾條道路後，市政府不得不重新分配預算。
After the census, lawmakers moved to reapportion the seats more fairly. 人口普查後，立法者著手更公平地重新分配席次。

meaning: the process of dividing or assigning again
sentences: The reapportionment of resources became the main topic at the meeting. 資源的重新分配成了會議的主要議題。
Population changes forced a reapportionment of the district boundaries. 人口變化迫使行政區邊界重新調整分配。

meaning: a new or repeated position, placement, or arrangement
sentences: The reapposition of the chairs opened a wider path through the room. 椅子重新擺位後，房間中間騰出了更寬的通道。
He studied the reapposition of the statue after the gallery redesign. 在畫廊重新設計後，他仔細研究了雕像的新擺位。
The artist welcomed the reappraisal of her early work. 這位藝術家很歡迎外界對她早期作品的重新評價。
A careful reappraisal of the evidence changed the detective's theory. 對證據的仔細重新評估，改變了那位偵探的推論。
The museum asked experts to reappraise the painting's value. 博物館請專家重新評估那幅畫的價值。
When the market changed, the company had to reappraise its strategy. 當市場變化時，公司不得不重新審視自己的策略。

meaning: the act of reappraising or a formal reassessment
sentences: The reappraisement of the house took longer than expected. 那棟房子的重新估價比預期花了更久。
He requested a reappraisement after the initial review seemed too low. 他覺得初步審查的估值太低，因此要求重新評估。

meaning: to appreciate again or value anew
sentences: After the long trip home, she began to reappreciate the comfort of her own bed. 在長途旅行回家後，她開始重新珍惜自己床鋪的舒適。
It took a quiet winter evening to reappreciate how much the city had changed. 直到一個安靜的冬夜，他才重新體會到這座城市變了多少。
After the documentary, there was a fresh reappreciation of the painter's early sketches. 看完紀錄片後，大家重新欣賞起那位畫家早年的速寫。
Her reappreciation of quiet mornings made the whole trip feel slower and sweeter. 她再次體會到安靜早晨的美好，讓整趟旅程都變得更從容。
Police moved in to reapprehend the suspect after he slipped out of custody. 嫌疑人脫離羈押後，警方立刻再次將他拘捕。
The officers had to reapprehend the runaway cat before it vanished into the alley. 警員得先把那隻跑掉的貓抓回來，免得牠鑽進巷子裡不見了。
His reapprehension at the border ended the long manhunt. 他在邊境再次被逮捕，結束了漫長的追捕。
The reapprehension of the escaped dog took only a few minutes. 那隻跑走的狗很快就又被抓回來了。
She decided to reapproach the client with a calmer proposal. 她決定用更平和的提案再次接觸那位客戶。
After a long silence, he finally reapproached the topic from another angle. 沉默許久後，他終於換個角度重新切入這個話題。
The student looked for reapprobation from a mentor he trusted. 那名學生希望得到一位信任的導師的認可。
Her speech received polite reapprobation from the committee. 她的演說得到了委員會禮貌性的稱許。
The city chose to reappropriate the empty warehouse for public art. 市政府決定把那座空倉庫重新挪作公共藝術用途。
Engineers reappropriated the old cables to keep the backup system alive. 工程師重新調用舊電纜，讓備援系統維持運作。
The reappropriation of the old station turned it into a library. 舊車站經重新挪用後，變成了一座圖書館。
People debated the reappropriation of the budget for flood repair. 人們討論把預算重新分配給防洪修繕的做法。
The app needs reapproval before the new version can launch. 這個應用程式在新版本上線前還需要再次核准。
She waited for reapproval of the travel request before booking the flight. 她先等差旅申請重新核准，才去訂機票。
The board will reapprove the policy if the revision looks safer. 如果修訂版更安全，董事會就會重新批准這項政策。
I had to reapprove every expense after the accountant found missing receipts. 會計發現少了收據後，我只好把每筆支出重新核准一次。
The car was damaged at the rear when another vehicle hit it from behind. 汽車後部被另一輛從後面撞上的車撞壞了。
She spent many years rearing her four children in a small wooden cottage. 她花了很多年在一座小木屋裡撫養（養育）她的四個孩子。
The truck almost rear-ended the taxi at the light. 那輛卡車差點在紅綠燈前追撞計程車。
Drive slowly in the rain so you do not rear-end another car. 下雨天開慢一點，才不會追撞前車。
She checked the rear-view mirror before changing lanes. 她變換車道前看了一下後視鏡。
The driver hung a small charm from the rear-view mirror. 司機在後視鏡上掛了一個小吊飾。
When the first ruling failed, they agreed to rearbitrate the dispute. 第一輪裁決失效後，他們同意重新仲裁這場爭議。
The union asked a neutral panel to rearbitrate the contract issue. 工會請一個中立小組再次仲裁合約爭議。
The rearbitration took place after both sides rejected the outcome. 由於雙方都不接受結果，於是進行了再次仲裁。
The case was sent back for rearbitration with clearer evidence. 這起案件被退回，要求在證據更明確後重新仲裁。
As a goat rearer, he knows how to handle new calves gently. 身為山羊飼養者，他很懂得溫柔照顧新生小羊。
The village relied on a bird rearer to nurse injured chicks. 村裡仰賴一位鳥類飼養者來照顧受傷的小雛鳥。
We should not reargue the same point unless new evidence appears. 除非有新證據，否則我們不該把同一個論點再爭論一遍。
They started to reargue the budget after dinner, which nobody enjoyed. 晚飯後他們又開始重提預算爭論，沒人喜歡這樣。
The judge allowed a reargument after the lawyers found a missing clause. 律師找到漏掉的條款後，法官准許重新辯論。
His reargument of the case was shorter, but it was much sharper. 他對這個案件的重辯更短，卻更有力。
The rearhorse kept the wagon steady on the steep road. 後方那匹馬讓馬車在陡坡上保持穩定。
In the old manual, the rearhorse was described as the animal that stayed behind the lead team. 在那本舊手冊裡，rearhorse 被描述為跟在領頭馬隊後方的馬。
The rearisal of hope after the storm surprised everyone in town. 暴風雨過後希望再次升起，讓鎮上每個人都很意外。
The rearisal of the curtain matched the music perfectly. 幕布重新升起的時機和音樂配合得剛剛好。
When morale sank, the coach tried to rearise the team's confidence. 士氣低落時，教練試著重新振起全隊的信心。
After a short pause, the question rearised in the meeting. 短暫沉默後，這個問題又在會議上重新浮現。

meaning: 由人撫養長大的幼獸；人工飼養的幼體
sentences: The rearling followed the caretaker everywhere like a shadow. 這隻由人撫養長大的幼獸像影子一樣跟著照顧者。
Because the rearling had been hand-raised, it trusted people more than the others. 由於這隻幼獸是人工撫養長大的，所以比其他同伴更信任人類。
After months of peace, the country began to rearm its border units. 經過幾個月的和平後，那個國家開始替邊防部隊重新武裝。
We rearmed the kitchen printer with fresh paper before the lunch rush. 午餐尖峰前，我們替廚房印表機補上了新的紙張。
The treaty was meant to slow the region's rearmament. 這項條約原本是為了減緩該地區的重新軍備。
Critics warned that rapid rearmament would make talks harder, not easier. 批評者警告，快速的軍備重整只會讓談判更難，而不是更容易。

meaning: 具有回響感的；帶有共鳴效果的
sentences: The hall had a reboantic quality that made every whisper easy to hear. 那個大廳有種回響感，連耳語都聽得一清二楚。
She liked the reboantic tone of the drum in the recording. 她很喜歡錄音裡那種帶共鳴感的鼓聲。

meaning: 重新登上；再登機或回到車上
sentences: Passengers were told to reboard after the plane's safety check. 飛機完成安全檢查後，乘客被通知重新登機。
We had to reboard the bus after the driver changed the route. 公車改道後，我們只好再回車上。
He began to reboast about the fish he caught last summer. 他又開始吹噓起去年夏天釣到的大魚。
Nobody wanted to hear him reboast, so the room fell quiet fast. 沒有人想再聽他自誇，房間很快就安靜下來。

meaning: 重新輕彈；再把某物短促地彈起
sentences: The child tried to rebob the ball against the wall and catch it on the return. 孩子想把球再輕彈到牆上，然後接住彈回來的球。
He rebobbed the lever once, then waited for the machine to restart. 他先把拉桿再扳動一次，然後等機器重新啟動。

meaning: 重新煮沸；再加熱至沸騰
sentences: She had to reboil the tea because it went cold during the meeting. 茶在會議中放涼了，所以她只好重新煮沸。
If you reboil the broth, the flavor becomes stronger and saltier. 如果你把高湯重新煮沸，味道會更濃，也更鹹。

meaning: 再沸器；讓液體再次沸騰的裝置
sentences: The plant uses a reboiler to keep the distillation column working properly. 那座工廠靠再沸器維持蒸餾塔正常運作。
An engineer checked the reboiler before the next production run. 工程師在下一輪生產前檢查了再沸器。
After the fire, volunteers came back to reboise the hillside. 大火過後，志工們回來替山坡重新造林。
The village decided to reboise the land instead of expanding the parking lot. 村子決定把那片土地重新種回樹木，而不是擴建停車場。

meaning: 重新造林；補植樹木的行動
sentences: The report praised the reboisement of the burned valley. 報告稱讚了那片燒毀山谷的重新造林工作。
Reboisement can help a dry slope hold water again. 重新造林可以幫助乾燥的坡地再次保住水分。

meaning: 重新變得大膽；再次鼓起勇氣
sentences: She had to rebold herself before walking back into the interview room. 她得先讓自己重新鼓起勇氣，才走回面試室。
The singer rebolded her performance after the first song went poorly. 第一首歌表現不佳後，那位歌手重新振作，變得更有膽量。

meaning: 重新上螺栓；再用螺栓固定
sentences: We had to rebolt the shelf after it started wobbling. 那個架子開始晃動後，我們只好重新上螺栓固定。
The mechanic rebolted the panel and tested it twice. 機械師把面板重新鎖上螺栓，還測試了兩次。
The chef did not try to rebone the chicken; he bought it already cleaned. 這位廚師沒有自己去處理去骨雞肉，而是直接買了整理好的。
In the workshop, they rebone old carvings with strips of wood and glue. 在工作坊裡，他們用木條和膠水替舊雕刻重新補骨。

meaning: 重新預訂；改訂新的時間
sentences: I had to rebook the flight after the conference moved by a week. 會議延後一週後，我只好重新訂機票。
They rebooked the hotel because the first room had no windows. 他們重新訂了飯店，因為第一間房沒有窗戶。

meaning: 再跳一段俏皮的舞；重新輕快跳動
sentences: The toddler started to rebop to the music as soon as the drums kicked in. 鼓聲一響，幼兒就開始跟著音樂快活地跳動。
He would rebop across the kitchen whenever he heard his favorite song. 只要聽到最喜歡的歌，他就會在廚房裡輕快地跳來跳去。

meaning: 再度感到厭煩；重新弄得無聊
sentences: The lecture started to rebore the students after the long examples. 那場講座在冗長例子之後，開始讓學生又覺得無聊了。
I do not want to rebore you with the same story. 我不想用同一個故事再次把你講得無聊。
After the renovation, the old theater felt reborn. 翻修後，那座老劇院像是重生了。
She felt reborn after moving to the coast. 搬到海邊後，她覺得自己煥然一新。
Can I reborrow your umbrella tomorrow if the forecast is still bad? 如果明天天氣預報還是不好，我可以再跟你借一次傘嗎？
The library lets members reborrow the book for another two weeks. 圖書館允許會員把書再續借兩週。
After filtering the juice, they rebottled it in clear glass containers. 果汁過濾後，他們又重新裝進透明玻璃瓶裡。
The winemaker decided to rebottle the batch under a new label. 釀酒師決定把這批酒重新裝瓶，換上新的標籤。
The botanist pointed to Reboulia growing on the damp stone wall. 植物學家指著潮濕石牆上的地錢屬植物。
A field guide listed Reboulia among the small liverwort genera. 一本野外圖鑑把它列在小型地錢植物的屬中。
The tennis ball seemed to rebounce off the net and land near his feet. 網球好像又彈回球網，再落到他腳邊。
Stocks can rebounce after a sharp drop, but not always for long. 股票在大跌後可能會再反彈，但不一定撐得久。
I am on the rebound. 我正在反彈。
The term rebound refers to a return to health or well-being; a recovery. 反彈一詞是指恢復健康或福祉；恢復。
The new foam is reboundable, so the chair feels springy. 新泡棉具有回彈性，所以那張椅子坐起來很有彈力。
He wanted a reboundable surface for the camera tests. 他想要一個可反彈的表面來做相機測試。
The coach called him a natural rebounder because he never gave up on loose balls. 教練說他天生就是個善於搶籃板的人，因為他從不放棄任何鬆球。
In the workshop, the rubber strip acted like a rebounder and sent the marble back. 在工作坊裡，那條橡膠帶像個反彈器一樣，把玻璃珠彈了回去。

meaning: 反彈性；持續回彈的狀態
sentences: The mattress lost some of its reboundingness after years of use. 那張床墊用了多年後，回彈性已經下降了。
She liked the reboundingness of the trampoline more than the height. 她比起高度，更喜歡那張彈床的回彈感。

meaning: 使再次帶有波本風味；重新波本化
sentences: The bartender tried to rebourbonize the sauce with a splash of whiskey. 酒吧調酒師想用一點威士忌讓醬汁重新帶回波本風味。
They rebourbonized the glaze until it tasted richer and warmer. 他們把糖霜重新調出波本味，讓味道更濃厚也更溫暖。
Please rebox the ornaments carefully before storage season starts. 在收納季開始前，請小心把裝飾品重新裝箱。
He reboxed the puzzle pieces so nothing would go missing. 他把拼圖零件重新裝盒，這樣就不會弄丟。

meaning: 重新支撐；再用支架固定
sentences: The carpenter had to rebrace the beam after the storm loosened it. 暴風雨把樑柱弄鬆後，木工只好重新加支撐。
She rebraced her ankle with tape before jogging home. 她在慢跑回家前，用膠帶重新固定了腳踝。

meaning: 重新編辮；再把髮束編起來
sentences: She stopped to rebraid her hair after the wind ruined the first braid. 風把第一條辮子吹亂後，她停下來重新編髮。
The ribbon slipped loose, so he had to rebraid the cord by hand. 緞帶鬆開了，所以他得親手把繩子重新編過。

meaning: 再次分枝；重新延伸出分支
sentences: The tree will rebranch in spring if the frost does not damage the buds. 如果霜害沒有傷到芽，這棵樹春天會再次長出分枝。
The project began to rebranch into several smaller teams. 那個專案開始重新分成幾個較小的團隊。

meaning: 更改產品或公司的品牌名稱、商標或形象。
sentences: Acme Co. is trying to rebrand their line of toasters under the Bewidget name. Acme Co. 正試圖將其烤麵包機系列重新命名為 Bewidget。
People often rebrand when the situation calls for it. 人們經常在情況需要時重塑品牌。
The actor rebrandished the sword for the final pose. 那位演員在最後一個定格動作時，又把劍揮了一次。
He rebrandished his ID at the gate when the guard asked for it again. 守衛再次要他出示證件時，他又把證件亮了一次。

meaning: 再次呼吸；重新調整呼吸
sentences: After the sprint, she stopped to rebreathe and slow her pulse. 衝刺結束後，她停下來調整呼吸，讓心跳慢下來。
The diver had to rebreathe through the mouthpiece during the drill. 那位潛水員在演練中必須透過呼吸管重新呼吸。
The farmer chose to rebreed the sheep with a stronger line. 農夫選擇用更強健的血統重新培育那些綿羊。
Some gardeners rebreed tulips to get better color and shape. 有些園丁會重新培育鬱金香，好得到更好的花色和花型。

meaning: 重新釀造；再泡一次茶或咖啡
sentences: The café had to rebrew the coffee because the first pot sat too long. 咖啡放太久了，所以咖啡館只好重新沖煮。
At the brewery, they rebrewed the batch with a cleaner yeast strain. 在釀酒廠裡，他們用更乾淨的酵母菌株重新釀造那一批酒。

meaning: 再次行賄；重新用賄賂誘使
sentences: The detective was sure someone would try to rebribe the guard. 偵探很確定有人會再去賄賂那名警衛。
The company refused to rebribe officials and chose to leave the market. 那家公司拒絕再次行賄官員，最後選擇退出那個市場。
They had to rebrick the chimney after several bricks fell out. 幾塊磚掉出來後，他們只好把煙囪重新砌好。
The wall looked stronger once the mason rebricked the broken section. 磚匠把破損的部分重新砌過後，牆面看起來更穩固了。
The city wants to rebridge the gap between the two neighborhoods. 這座城市想重新架起兩個社區之間的連結。
Her letter helped rebridge a friendship that had gone quiet for years. 她的信重新搭起了一段沉寂多年的友誼。
Could you rebring the spare charger when you come tomorrow? 你明天來的時候，可以再把備用充電器帶來嗎？
The ceremony was meant to rebring attention to the old craft. 這場儀式是為了再次把大家的注意力帶回那門老手藝。
She became the rebringer of old customs to the village. 她成了把古老習俗帶回村子的人。
In the meeting, he acted like a rebringer of forgotten ideas. 在會議上，他像是把被遺忘想法重新帶回的人。
The coach did not rebroach the mistake after practice. 練習結束後，教練沒有再責備那個失誤。
Please do not rebroach the topic if the team is already stressed. 如果團隊已經很有壓力，請不要再提起並責備這個話題。
The station will rebroadcast the interview tonight. 電台今晚會重播那段訪談。
They rebroadcast the news bulletin for viewers in another time zone. 他們為另一個時區的觀眾再次播送新聞摘要。

meaning: 重新鍍銅色；再上青銅色
sentences: We decided to rebronze the old sculpture after cleaning it. 清理後，我們決定替那座舊雕像重新上青銅色。
The studio can rebronze the frame so it matches the other pieces. 工作室可以把畫框重新鍍成青銅色，讓它和其他作品一致。

meaning: 再次變褐；重新染成褐色
sentences: The bread went back into the oven to rebrown the top. 麵包又放回烤箱，讓表面重新上色變褐。
She used a quick spray to rebrown the leather shoes. 她用快速噴劑讓皮鞋再次染回褐色。
I had to rebrush the jacket after it collected dust. 夾克沾了灰塵後，我得再刷一遍。
The artist will rebrush the surface to smooth out the texture. 藝術家會重新刷過表面，讓質地更平滑。

meaning: 再次使殘暴；再次變得殘酷
sentences: Harsh rumors can rebrutalize an already tense workplace. 嚴苛的謠言會讓原本緊張的工作環境再次變得殘酷。
The film warns how violence can rebrutalize a community. 這部電影提醒人們，暴力如何再次把社群推向殘酷。

meaning: 再次起泡；重新鼓起泡泡
sentences: The sauce began to rebubble as soon as the heat returned. 醬汁一加熱就再次冒泡。
When the soda was shaken, it started to rebubble quickly. 汽水一被搖晃，就很快又起泡了。
He stopped to rebuckle his belt before leaving the room. 他離開房間前停下來把皮帶重新扣好。
After the break, the climber had to rebuckle the strap on his pack. 休息後，那位攀登者得把背包帶重新扣緊。

meaning: 再次發芽；重新長出花苞
sentences: The rose bush may rebud after the rain. 玫瑰灌木在下雨後可能會再次長出花苞。
Gardeners wait for the plant to rebud in spring. 園丁等著這株植物在春天重新發芽。
We had to rebudget the trip after hotel prices rose. 飯店價格上漲後，我們只好重新編列旅行預算。
The company will rebudget next quarter to focus on training. 公司下個季度會重新編列預算，把重點放在培訓。
She gently rebuffed the offer and thanked him for asking. 她婉拒了提議，並感謝對方詢問。
The candidate rebuffed the criticism with a calm explanation. 這位候選人用冷靜的說明回應了批評。
The request was polite enough, but still rebuffable. 這個請求雖然客氣，但仍然可以被婉拒。
Not every invitation is rebuffable without causing offense. 不是每個邀請都能在不冒犯人的情況下被拒絕。

meaning: 可回絕地；容易被婉拒地
sentences: He phrased the proposal rebuffably, so no one felt pressured. 他把提案說得很容易被婉拒，因此沒有人覺得被逼迫。
The offer was presented rebuffably, with no hard sell. 那項提議以不強迫的方式提出，沒有硬性推銷。
The waves rebuffet the rocks all night long. 海浪整夜再次猛烈衝擊岩石。
The box rebuffeted the wall when the cart hit a bump. 推車一顛簸，那個箱子又撞向牆壁。

meaning: 不怕被拒絕的；耐回絕的
sentences: Her confidence seemed rebuffproof during the interview. 她在面試時的自信看起來完全不怕被回絕。
No one is truly rebuffproof, but some people recover fast. 沒有人真的不怕被拒絕，但有些人恢復得很快。

meaning: 在困難時期嘗試提升自己的表現。
sentences: After missing the playoffs for the seventh straight season in a row, the Detroit Red Wings are trying to rebuild. 在連續第七個賽季無緣季後賽後，底特律紅翼隊正在努力重建。
To rebuild means to attempt to improve one's performance during a period of struggling. 重建意味著在掙扎時期嘗試提升自己的表現。
The rebuilder of the bridge worked carefully for months. 那座橋的重建者小心地工作了好幾個月。
After the fire, the rebuilder helped the town regain its shape. 大火之後，那位重建者協助小鎮恢復原貌。
The rebuilt bridge opened before the rainy season. 重建後的橋在雨季前開通。
He bought a rebuilt engine for the truck. 他為卡車買了一具翻修過的引擎。

meaning: 應受責備的；可被斥責的
sentences: The delay was rebukable, but the manager stayed calm. 這次延誤是該受責備的，但經理保持冷靜。
His behavior was clearly rebukable in front of the team. 他的行為在團隊面前顯然是應受斥責的。
The teacher rebuked the student for interrupting the class. 老師責備那名學生打斷上課。
She did not rebuke him harshly; she only asked for honesty. 她沒有嚴厲斥責他，只是要求誠實。
The shortcut was rebukeable because it ignored safety rules. 那種走捷徑的做法很可責備，因為它忽視了安全規定。
His late arrival was rebukeable, though not unforgivable. 他遲到是可以被責備的，但還不到不可原諒。

meaning: 充滿責備的；帶有斥責意味的
sentences: Her rebukeful tone made the room go quiet. 她那帶著責備的語氣讓房間安靜下來。
He gave a rebukeful look before walking away. 他先給了一個充滿斥責意味的眼神，才轉身離開。
She spoke rebukefully, but not enough to humiliate him. 她帶著責備地說話，但還不至於讓他難堪。
The parent looked at the broken vase rebukefully. 父母帶著責備的神情看著那個打破的花瓶。

meaning: 責備的語氣；斥責的態度
sentences: The rebukefulness in his voice was impossible to miss. 他語氣中的責備感明顯得無法忽視。
She answered with warmth instead of rebukefulness. 她以溫和回應，而不是用責備的口吻。

meaning: 不怕責備的；不受斥責影響的
sentences: No one is fully rebukeproof, but he was close to it. 沒有人完全不怕責備，但他幾乎就是如此。
The veteran employee seemed rebukeproof during the tense review. 這位資深員工在緊張的檢討中看起來不受責備影響。
The rebuker in the corner was actually trying to help. 角落裡那位責備別人的人其實是在想幫忙。
He became the rebuker only after repeated mistakes. 只有在錯誤一再發生後，他才變成責備者。
She glanced rebukingly at the noisy students. 她帶著責備地瞥了那群吵鬧的學生一眼。
He smiled rebukingly, which made the warning feel softer. 他帶著責備意味地笑了笑，讓警告聽起來沒那麼嚴厲。

meaning: 再次成堆；重新歸攏成大塊
sentences: The papers began to rebulk on the messy desk. 那些文件又在凌亂的桌上堆成一團。
She tried to rebulk the yarn into a neat bundle. 她試著把毛線重新歸攏成整齊的一捆。
Please rebunch the flowers before putting them in water. 請先把花重新束好，再放進水裡。
The hikers rebunched near the trailhead after the storm. 暴風雨後，健行者在步道入口附近重新聚攏。
We had to rebundle the blankets for easier storage. 我們得把毯子重新打包，才好收納。
The shipping team will rebundle the items after inspection. 出貨團隊在檢查後會把物品重新捆包。

meaning: 重新躲進掩體；再次收進防護空間
sentences: When the siren sounded, everyone ran to rebunker. 警報一響，大家又跑回掩體裡避難。
The game lets you rebunker your troops after each wave. 這款遊戲允許你在每一波後把部隊重新躲回掩體。
A few encouraging words can rebuoy a tired team. 幾句鼓勵的話就能讓疲憊的團隊重新振作。
The pilot watched the marker rebuoy after the tide shifted. 潮水轉向後，飛行員看著標記再次浮起。

meaning: 重新浮起；再次振作的過程
sentences: The rebuoyage of the town took years after the flood. 那座城鎮在洪水後花了好幾年才重新振作。
We could feel a rebuoyage in the room after the good news. 好消息傳來後，房間裡有種重新振作的氣氛。

meaning: 重新加重負擔；再次使負擔沉重
sentences: Do not reburden yourself with tasks you have already finished. 不要又把自己重新壓回那些已經完成的工作裡。
The policy could reburden small businesses with extra paperwork. 這項政策可能會讓小企業再次背上額外文書負擔。
The neighborhood began to reburgeon after the new park opened. 新公園開放後，這個社區開始再次繁榮起來。
Interest in the old game may reburgeon after the remake. 舊遊戲在重製版推出後，人氣可能會重新興起。
The reburial took place beside the family chapel. 這次重新安葬是在家族禮拜堂旁進行的。
Researchers requested a reburial after the study was complete. 研究完成後，研究人員要求重新安葬遺骸。
The logs reburn slowly when the fireplace is still hot. 壁爐還熱著時，那些木柴會再次慢慢燃燒。
He had to reburn the sample to test the color changes. 他得把樣本再燒一次，測試顏色變化。
The jeweler will reburnish the ring before delivery. 珠寶匠會在交件前把戒指重新拋光。
I spent the afternoon reburnishing the brass handle. 我花了下午把黃銅把手重新擦亮。
The balloon seemed quiet, then it suddenly reburst. 氣球看似安靜，卻突然又爆了一次。

A rectoscope helps specialists see inside the rectum more clearly. 直腸鏡能幫助專科醫師更清楚地看見直腸內部。

meaning: an examination of the rectum with a rectoscope
sentences: She scheduled a rectoscopy to find the cause of the discomfort. 她安排了直腸鏡檢查來找出不適的原因。
A rectoscopy can be quick, but it still requires careful preparation. 直腸鏡檢查可能很快完成，但仍需要仔細準備。

meaning: relating to the rectum and sigmoid colon
sentences: The colonoscopy paid special attention to the rectosigmoid area. 大腸鏡特別留意了直腸乙狀結腸部位。
Inflammation in the rectosigmoid region can cause cramping and urgency. 直腸乙狀結腸區的發炎可能引起絞痛與便意急迫。
The child's pain came from rectostenosis, a narrowing of the rectum. 孩子的疼痛來自 rectostenosis，也就是直腸變窄。
Doctors may suspect rectostenosis when bowel movements become difficult. 當排便變得困難時，醫師可能會懷疑有直腸狹窄。

meaning: a surgical opening into the rectum
sentences: After the severe injury, the patient needed a rectostomy to create a temporary opening. 嚴重受傷後，病人需要接受直腸造口來建立暫時開口。
A rectostomy is a major procedure, so the team discussed every risk first. 直腸造口是重大的處置，所以團隊先討論了每一項風險。

meaning: a surgical instrument for cutting the rectum
sentences: The surgeon reached for a rectotome during the procedure. 手術時外科醫師拿起了直腸切開刀。
A rectotome is a specialized instrument, not a tool you would see in a regular clinic. rectotome 是一種專用器械，不是一般診所常見的工具。
The operation required a careful rectotomy to drain the abscess. 手術需要小心進行直腸切開，以引流膿瘍。
Modern medicine uses rectotomy far less often than less invasive methods. 現代醫療比起這種方式，更少採用直腸切開術。

meaning: relating to the rectum and vagina
sentences: The scan looked for a rectovaginal fistula after the surgery. 手術後，這次掃描是在尋找直腸陰道瘻管。
Rectovaginal complications are rare, but they can be serious. 直腸陰道相關併發症雖然罕見，但可能很嚴重。

meaning: relating to the rectum and bladder
sentences: The doctor checked for a rectovesical fistula because of the symptoms. 醫師因為症狀而檢查是否有直腸膀胱瘻管。
Rectovesical complications need prompt treatment to prevent infection. 直腸膀胱相關併發症需要及時治療，才能避免感染。

meaning: a female ruler or leader; an archaic or rare term
sentences: In the old tale, the rectress governed the city with calm authority. 在那個古老傳說裡，那位女統治者以沉著的威望治理城市。
The word rectress is rare today, so it usually appears in historical writing. rectress 這個詞今天很少見，所以通常只會出現在歷史寫作中。

meaning: relating to the tail feathers of a bird
sentences: The bird's rectricial feathers fanned out as it changed direction. 那隻鳥的尾羽在轉向時張開了。
Ornithologists use rectricial to describe features linked to the tail feathers. 鳥類學家用 rectricial 來描述與尾羽相關的特徵。

meaning: one of the large tail feathers of a bird
sentences: A damaged rectrix can make a bird's flight less steady. 受損的尾羽會讓鳥類飛行變得不穩。
The guide pointed to the long rectrix at the end of the tail. 導覽員指著尾端那根較長的尾羽。

meaning: the final part of the large intestine
sentences: The pain started near the rectum and gradually spread upward. 疼痛最初出現在直腸附近，之後逐漸往上擴散。
A doctor can examine the rectum to look for bleeding or swelling. 醫師可以檢查直腸，看看是否有出血或腫脹。

meaning: straight; also used in anatomy for a straight muscle
sentences: The rectus muscle helps stabilize the torso during movement. 直肌能在動作時幫助軀幹穩定。
In anatomy class, we learned that rectus comes from a Latin word meaning straight. 在解剖課上，我們學到 rectus 來自拉丁文，意思是直的。
The recubant figure in the painting looked almost asleep. 畫中的斜臥人物看起來幾乎睡著了。
Its recubant posture gave the statue an unusual sense of ease. 它那種斜臥的姿態讓雕像帶著一種少見的閒適感。
After practice, he would recubate on the bench and watch the clouds drift by. 練習後，他常躺回長椅上，看著雲慢慢飄過。
The poet used recubate to suggest a slow and graceful resting motion. 那位詩人用 recubate 來表現一種緩慢而優雅的休息動作。
Farmers recultivate the field after each harvest. 農民在每次收成後都會重新耕作那片田地。
The neighborhood group plans to recultivate the abandoned lot. 社區團體打算重新整治那塊荒廢的空地。
Recultivation of the slope took several seasons. 那片坡地的再耕作花了好幾個季節。
The report praised the recultivation of land damaged by mining. 報告稱讚了因採礦受損土地的再耕作。

meaning: the act or state of lying down
sentences: His recumbence in the chair made him look half asleep. 他半躺在椅子上的樣子，看起來像快睡著了。
The doctor recommended recumbence for a few hours after the treatment. 醫生建議治療後先平躺休息幾個小時。

meaning: the state of lying down or reclining
sentences: Prolonged recumbency can leave a patient stiff and weak. 長時間臥床會讓病人感到僵硬和虛弱。
The nurse checked her recumbency before adjusting the pillow. 護理師在調整枕頭前，先確認她的臥躺姿勢。

meaning: lying down, leaning back, or reclining
sentences: He stayed recumbent on the sofa while the rain drummed on the windows. 雨點敲著窗戶時，他一直斜躺在沙發上。
We found a recumbent cyclist sculpture near the museum gate. 我們在博物館門口附近看到一座臥姿的自行車雕塑。

meaning: in a reclining or lying-down manner
sentences: She lay recumbently on the mat, breathing slowly. 她平躺在墊子上，慢慢呼吸。
The cat slept recumbently in a patch of sunlight. 貓兒舒舒服服地躺著，在一塊陽光裡睡覺。

meaning: the ability to recover health, strength, or function
sentences: The team's recuperability depended on sleep, food, and patience. 這支隊伍的恢復能力取決於睡眠、飲食與耐心。
High recuperability is one reason athletes track their rest so carefully. 恢復能力強是運動員如此仔細追蹤休息狀態的原因之一。
A weekend of quiet rest gave him some recuperance. 一個安靜的週末讓他恢復了一些元氣。
The clinic focuses on recuperance as much as treatment. 這家診所同樣重視康復與治療。
She stayed home for a week to recuperate after the flu. 她在得流感後待在家裡一週休養恢復。
It took him months to recuperate from the accident. 他花了好幾個月才從那場意外中復原。

meaning: the process of recovering health, strength, or energy
sentences: Quiet evenings helped with her recuperation after surgery. 安靜的夜晚對她手術後的復原很有幫助。
The doctor said recuperation would be faster with regular walking. 醫師說，如果規律散步，復原會更快。

meaning: helping a person or thing recover
sentences: The doctor recommended a recuperative stay by the sea. 醫生建議到海邊住一陣子，好好調養恢復。
Yoga can be a recuperative routine after intense training. 瑜伽在高強度訓練後可以是一種有助恢復的日常。

meaning: the quality of being able to recover well
sentences: Her recuperativeness surprised everyone after the long illness. 她在長病之後展現的恢復力讓大家都很驚訝。
The team admired his recuperativeness more than his speed. 團隊欣賞他的恢復力勝過他的速度。

meaning: a person or device that recovers something, especially heat or energy
sentences: The factory installed a recuperator to reuse heat from the exhaust stream. 工廠安裝了熱回收器來回收排氣中的熱能。
Using a recuperator can lower energy costs without changing the main process. 使用熱回收器可以在不改變主要製程的情況下降低能源成本。

meaning: relating to recovery or helping recovery
sentences: The slow walk was part of her recuperatory routine. 那段慢走是她調養恢復日常的一部分。
He treated the trip as a recuperatory break from work. 他把這趟旅行當成從工作中恢復元氣的休息。
The same problem tends to recur whenever the software update is rushed. 只要軟體更新太匆忙，同樣的問題就容易一再出現。
Her migraines recur every few months, so she keeps careful notes about possible triggers. 她的偏頭痛每隔幾個月就會發作一次，所以她會仔細記錄可能的誘因。

meaning: 再次治癒；再度恢復；再次出現
sentences: The old journal said the wound would recure slowly if the patient rested enough. 那本舊日記寫道，只要病人休息得夠，傷口就會慢慢再度痊癒。
They hoped the neighborhood would recure after the storm, with the shops and streets coming back to life. 他們希望這個社區在暴風雨後能重新恢復，讓商店和街道再度熱鬧起來。

meaning: 可再次治癒的；會再度復原的
sentences: The doctor described the fracture as recureful, though it would still take patience. 醫生把那處骨折形容為可再次痊癒的，但還是需要耐心。
She liked the recureful sound of the word, as if recovery could happen in layers. 她喜歡 recureful 這個詞的感覺，彷彿復原是可以一層一層慢慢發生的。

meaning: 無法再次治癒的；不能再恢復的
sentences: After the second breakdown, the machine was recureless and had to be replaced. 經過第二次故障後，那台機器已經無法再修復，只能換新。
He stared at the recureless damage and realized the shortcut had cost them too much. 他看著那種無法挽回的損壞，這才明白抄近路付出了太大的代價。
Humidity made the paper edges recurl by the end of the afternoon. 到了下午，潮濕讓紙張邊緣又重新捲了起來。
She watched the ribbon recurl around her finger after she let it go. 她鬆手後，看著緞帶又繞回手指上捲成一圈。
The recurrence of the fever worried the doctor. 發燒反覆發作讓醫師很擔心。
The recurrence of that pattern made the diagnosis clearer. 那種模式一再出現，讓診斷更清楚。

meaning: 反覆發生；再發性；循環出現
sentences: The doctor was worried about the recurrency of the fever and ordered more tests. 醫生擔心這個發燒會反覆出現，因此安排了更多檢查。
In their meetings, the recurrency of the same complaint showed a deeper problem. 在他們的會議裡，同一個抱怨反覆出現，顯示背後有更深的問題。

meaning: 重複出現；一次又一次地發生。
sentences: The patient complained of recurrent chest pain. 患者主訴反覆出現胸痛。
Something described as recurrent is recurring; happening time after time. 被描述為反覆發生的事情就是反覆發生；一次又一次地發生。

meaning: 反覆地；週期性地；經常再度發生地
sentences: The alarm went off recurrently during the night because the sensor was misaligned. 因為感測器歪掉了，警報整晚都反覆響起。
He recurrently checked the oven, nervous that the cake might burn. 他一再去看烤箱，擔心蛋糕會烤焦。

meaning: 反覆出現的人或事物；經常再發者
sentences: In her family, dizziness was a recurrer, so she learned to notice the early signs. 在她家裡，頭暈是個反覆出現的問題，所以她學會了提早察覺徵兆。
The broken gate became a recurrer on the maintenance list until someone fixed it properly. 那道壞掉的門在維修清單上反覆出現，直到有人真正把它修好。
She has a recurring dream about flying. 她反覆做著一個關於飛翔的夢。
The project faced several recurring problems. 該專案面臨幾個反覆出現的問題。
The train stopped recurringly as workers tested the track ahead. 火車在前方工人測試鐵軌時，反覆停了下來。
She recurringly apologized for being late, but everyone could see she was trying. 她一再為遲到道歉，不過大家都看得出來她已經很努力了。

meaning: 遞迴；以自身定義的方式重複處理
sentences: The function will recurse until it reaches the base case. 這個函式會一路遞迴下去，直到碰到基底情況為止。
To search the folder properly, the program must recurse through every subdirectory. 要正確搜尋資料夾，程式必須遞迴走訪每個子目錄。

meaning: 遞迴；自我參照的重複結構
sentences: Recursion can make a solution elegant, but it also makes beginners stop and think. 遞迴可以讓解法很優雅，但也常讓初學者停下來多想一下。
The poem used recursion by folding one image into another, like a dream inside a dream. 那首詩運用了遞迴般的手法，把一個意象包進另一個意象裡，就像夢中有夢。

meaning: 繪製 自身，向後引用。
sentences: The recursive nature of stories which borrow from each other 相互借用的故事的 遞歸 本質 相互借用的故事的遞歸本質
The report describes the result as recursive. 該報告將結果描述為遞歸的。 該報告將結果描述為遞歸的。 該報告將結果描述為下降的。

meaning: 再加簾遮蔽；重新以幕布覆蓋
sentences: They had to recurtain the stage after the rain leaked through the side door. 雨水從側門滲進來後，他們只好重新把舞台用布幕遮起來。
The host recurtained the window to block the morning glare during the video call. 主人把窗簾再拉好，擋住視訊通話時的晨光。
The recurvant stem bent back toward the ground instead of standing straight up. 那根向後彎曲的莖不是直直往上長，而是朝地面反折回去。
Her sketch emphasized the recurvant line of the branch against the sky. 她的素描特別突出了那根樹枝在天空前向後彎折的線條。

meaning: 使向後彎曲；反向彎折的
sentences: The bird had a recurvate bill that curved gently back toward its face. 那隻鳥的喙呈向後彎折的形狀，輕輕朝牠的臉部回彎。
A recurvate branch can be beautiful in a bonsai, even if it looks odd in a forest. 一根向後彎折的枝條放在盆景裡會很美，即使在森林裡看起來有點怪。
The recurvation of the leaf made it easy to identify the plant in the field. 那片葉子的反折形狀讓人很容易在野外辨認出這株植物。
He noticed a slight recurvation in the old iron rail and called the crew over. 他注意到那根舊鐵欄有一點彎折，便把工人叫了過來。

meaning: 再次彎曲；反向彎折的狀態
sentences: The recurvature of the road surprised us because the map showed only a mild bend. 這條路的回彎程度讓我們很意外，因為地圖上看起來只是一個小彎。
She admired the recurvature of the flower stem, which seemed almost painted by hand. 她很欣賞那根花莖的反彎弧度，彷彿是手工描畫出來的一樣。
The bow limbs recurve at the ends, giving the arrow extra speed. 弓臂的末端向後反曲，因此射出的箭速度更快。
As the branch grew heavier, it began to recurve under its own weight. 隨著枝條越長越重，它開始在自身重量下向後彎曲。
The genus Recurvirostra includes the avocets. 反嘴鷸屬包括反嘴鷸。
Researchers compared two species in Recurvirostra. 研究人員比較了反嘴鷸屬中的兩個物種。

meaning: 反嘴鷸屬的；嘴喙向上彎的
sentences: The recurvirostral shape of the bill helps the bird sweep mud for tiny prey. 那種嘴喙向上彎的形狀，能幫助鳥兒在泥地裡掃尋小型獵物。
Birdwatchers loved the recurvirostral profile because it was unmistakable in flight. 觀鳥者很喜歡那種嘴喙上彎的輪廓，因為牠飛起來時一眼就能認出來。
Recurvirostridae includes avocets and stilts. 反嘴鷸科包括反嘴鷸和長腳鷸。
The guide listed Recurvirostridae among the shorebird families. 解說員把反嘴鷸科列在涉禽科之中。

meaning: 既外展又向後彎的；張開而反折的
sentences: The recurvopatent petals opened wide before curving slightly backward. 那些既張開又微微反折的花瓣先完全展開，再向後輕輕彎去。
Under the microscope, the recurvopatent hairs on the seed looked almost spring-loaded. 在顯微鏡下，那些張開又反折的種毛看起來幾乎像有彈簧一樣。

meaning: 反曲的三出式；三出且略向後彎的
sentences: The plant had recurvoternate leaves, with three leaflets that bent backward at the tips. 那株植物有反曲的三出葉，三片小葉的末端都略微向後彎。
She used recurvoternate as a mnemonic, because the shape sounded as strange as the leaf itself. 她把 recurvoternate 當成記憶口訣，因為這個詞聽起來就和葉子的怪樣子一樣特別。
The recurvous claw gave the bird a firm grip on slippery bark. 那個反捲的爪子讓那隻鳥能牢牢抓住滑溜的樹皮。
He sketched the recurvous edge of the shell with surprising care. 他非常仔細地描出了那枚貝殼反捲的邊緣。
The student’s recusance to follow the new rule annoyed the teacher. 那名學生拒絕遵守新規定，讓老師很頭痛。
In the old documents, recusance often referred to refusing official religious authority. 在那些古老文件裡，recusance 常指拒絕接受官方宗教權威。

meaning: 拒絕服從；不順從官方宗教的立場
sentences: The history book described recusancy as both a political and a religious stance. 那本歷史書把 recusancy 描述為一種同時帶有政治與宗教意義的立場。
Her quiet recusancy showed up in small ways, like refusing to sign what she did not believe. 她那種安靜的抗拒，會表現在一些小事上，例如不願簽下自己不認同的東西。
The recusant refused to attend the ceremony, even when the pressure grew intense. 那名抗命者即使壓力越來越大，仍拒絕出席典禮。
In the novel, the recusant becomes a symbol of stubborn conscience. 在那部小說裡，這個抗命者成了頑強良知的象徵。
The judge accepted the recusation because the conflict of interest was obvious. 由於利益衝突很明顯，法官接受了這項回避請求。
His recusation of the invitation was polite but unmistakable. 他對邀請的拒絕很有禮貌，卻也毫不含糊。
Her recusative answer made it clear she would not be drawn into the debate. 她那種帶著拒絕意味的回答，清楚表明她不想被捲入辯論。
The policy was written in a recusative tone, as if saying no before anyone asked. 那項政策的語氣帶著回避感，彷彿還沒有人開口就先說不。
The recusator in the story would not bend, even for comfort or safety. 故事裡的那位拒絕者連為了舒適或安全都不願退讓。
He joked that he was the team’s recusator whenever someone tried to add another meeting. 他開玩笑說，只要有人想再加一場會議，他就是團隊裡那個愛拒絕的人。

meaning: 要求回避；使自己退出審理或決定
sentences: The board member decided to recuse herself from the vote because of a family connection. 那位董事因為有家族關係，決定迴避這次表決。
A judge should recuse when personal ties might affect the fairness of the case. 當私人關係可能影響案件公正時，法官就應該自行迴避。

meaning: 重新加墊；重新裝上坐墊
sentences: We decided to recushion the old bench so people would actually want to sit on it. 我們決定把那張舊長椅重新加墊，這樣大家才會願意坐上去。
She recushioned the window seat before her parents arrived for the holiday dinner. 她在父母來吃節日晚餐前，先把窗邊座位重新鋪好坐墊。

meaning: 擊回；反擊；（法律）撤銷判決
sentences: The article described the soldiers' recussion after the first attack. 這篇文章描述了士兵在第一次攻擊後的反擊。
In the old court record, the judge ordered a recussion of part of the ruling. 在那份舊法院紀錄裡，法官下令撤銷部分判決。
The tailor had to recut the sleeves after the customer changed sizes. 顧客改了尺寸後，裁縫只好把袖子重新裁剪。
The documentary was recut to make the ending feel less abrupt. 這部紀錄片被重新剪輯過，讓結尾不那麼突兀。
We should all make an effort to recycle paper, plastic, and glass bottles. 我們都應該努力回收紙類、塑料和玻璃瓶。
The company uses recycled materials to make their environmentally friendly products. 該公司使用回收材料來製造環保產品。
She wore a stunning red dress to the gala dinner. 她穿了一件亮麗的紅洋裝參加正式晚宴。
The red light means you must stop your car immediately. 紅燈表示你必須立即停車。
She wore a red coat that brightened the whole gray street. 她穿著一件紅外套，讓整條灰色街道都亮了起來。
The artist used red to signal danger and urgency in the poster. 這位藝術家在海報裡用紅色來表現危險與緊迫感。

meaning: 編輯刪改；遮蔽敏感內容
sentences: Before releasing the report, the agency had to redact personal details. 在公布報告之前，該機構必須先刪去個人資料。
He asked his assistant to redact the email so the client's name would not appear. 他請助理把電子郵件裡的客戶姓名遮蔽起來。
The declassified redaction left only a few readable lines on the page. 解密後的刪節本只在頁面上留下了幾行可讀文字。
Her redaction of the interview removed all the names but kept the key facts. 她對這段訪談的刪改去掉了所有姓名，但保留了重點事實。
The redactional changes were small, but they made the article much clearer. 這些編輯上的改動不大，卻讓文章清楚許多。
The historian noted several redactional layers in the manuscript. 這位歷史學者指出，手稿裡有好幾層編輯痕跡。
The redactor kept the tone of the original letter but removed a few harsh phrases. 那位編輯者保留了原信的語氣，但刪掉了幾句尖銳的話。
As a redactor, he spent hours checking dates, names, and footnotes. 身為修訂者，他花了好幾個小時核對日期、姓名和註腳。
The redactorial decisions shaped the final version of the memoir. 這些修訂決定影響了回憶錄的最終版本。
We noticed a redactorial note explaining why one paragraph had been moved. 我們注意到一則編輯註記，說明為什麼有一段被移到別處。
The storm threatened to redamage the roof before the repairs were finished. 修繕還沒完成，暴風雨就差點再次損壞屋頂。
If you keep pulling the cord, you may redamage the machine. 如果你一直硬拉那條線，可能會讓機器再次受損。
The speech felt like a redamnation of the policy rather than a calm debate about it. 那場演說聽起來不像冷靜討論政策，反而像是對政策的再次譴責。
In the old sermon, redamnation was used to warn listeners about repeated sin. 在那篇古老的講道中，redamnation 被用來警告聽眾不要一再犯罪。

meaning: 棱角形工事；V形防禦工事
sentences: The museum display showed a redan built to defend a river crossing. 博物館展出了用來防守河道渡口的棱角形工事。
From the hill, we could still trace the outline of an old redan in the grass. 從山丘上，我們還能在草地裡看出一座舊棱角形工事的輪廓。
In the old legal text, redare meant to inherit property. 在那份古老的法律文本裡，這個動詞指的是繼承財產。
The verb redare appears in a medieval Tuscan record. 這個動詞出現在一份中世紀托斯卡尼紀錄裡。
The evidence was enough to redargue the witness's dramatic story. 證據已經足以駁倒那名證人的誇張說法。
He tried to redargue the rumor with facts, not with anger. 他想用事實而不是憤怒來反駁那個謠言。
The professor's redargution of the claim was careful and polite. 這位教授對該主張的駁斥既謹慎又有禮。
In the old essay, each paragraph ended with a sharp redargution. 在那篇舊散文裡，每個段落最後都以犀利的駁斥收尾。
Her redargutive remarks made it clear she did not accept the premise. 她那些帶有駁斥性的話語，清楚表明她不接受那個前提。
The judge ignored the redargutive tone and focused on the actual facts. 法官沒有理會那種反駁式語氣，而是專注在實際事實上。
His redargutory response sounded more like a rebuttal than an explanation. 他的反駁式回應聽起來比較像駁斥，而不是解釋。
The letter had a redargutory edge that made the disagreement impossible to miss. 這封信帶著明顯的反駁語氣，讓分歧無法被忽略。
The clouds seemed to redarken the room just as we were about to leave. 就在我們準備離開時，雲層似乎又讓房間變暗了。
If you want the background to redarken, lower the brightness a little more. 如果你想讓背景再暗一點，就把亮度再調低一些。
Grandma taught him how to redarn his wool socks instead of throwing them away. 奶奶教他把羊毛襪重新縫補，而不是直接丟掉。
I spent the evening redarning the hem that had come loose. 我花了一個晚上把鬆開的下擺重新補好。
The potter mixed redart into the clay body for a warmer color. 那位陶藝師把紅陶土混進泥料裡，讓成品顏色更溫暖。
Redart works well for low-fire bowls because it gives them a rich reddish tone. 紅陶土很適合低溫燒製的碗，會呈現濃郁的紅褐色調。
The archivist had to redate the letter after discovering the ink had faded. 檔案管理員發現墨跡褪色後，只好重新為那封信標日期。
We redate the meeting whenever the train strike makes the original plan impossible. 只要火車罷工讓原本的安排行不通，我們就會把會議改期。
He redaubed the fence with paint to protect it from the rain. 他又替圍欄刷了一層漆，好防雨水侵蝕。
The artist liked to redaub the canvas until the texture felt just right. 這位藝術家喜歡反覆在畫布上塗抹，直到質感剛剛好。
By the time the valley began to redawn, the hikers were already packing up camp. 等山谷再次破曉時，健行者們已經在收拾營地了。
After the blackout, the city seemed to redawn all at once. 停電過後，整座城市彷彿一下子又亮了起來。

meaning: 紅背蜘蛛；紅背動物或事物
sentences: The guide warned us not to touch the redback hiding under the deck. 導遊提醒我們不要碰躲在木平台下的紅背蜘蛛。
In Australia, a redback can mean a dangerous spider, so locals stay cautious. 在澳洲，redback 可能指有毒的蜘蛛，所以當地人都會很小心。

meaning: 以共產主義者名義抨擊；紅色獵巫式污名化
sentences: The columnist accused the campaign of trying to redbait anyone who disagreed. 專欄作家指控這場競選企圖把所有反對者都貼上共產主義者的標籤。
It's unfair to redbait a neighbor just because they support public housing. 只因為鄰居支持社會住宅，就用紅色獵巫的方式攻擊他，這並不公平。
The old fisherman earned the nickname Redbeard. 那位老漁夫得到了紅鬍子這個綽號。
In the story, Redbeard is a fearsome pirate. 在故事裡，紅鬍子是一名令人畏懼的海盜。

meaning: 紅腹動物；腹部發紅的魚、龜或其他動物
sentences: The ranger pointed out a redbelly sunning itself on a rock. 護林員指著一隻正躺在岩石上曬太陽的紅腹動物給我們看。
Anglers sometimes call that species a redbelly because of the bright stripe underneath. 釣客有時會因為牠下腹鮮明的條紋而稱牠為 redbelly。
We picked redberry from the hedge and used it to make jam. 我們從樹籬上採了紅莓，用來做果醬。
The redberry bushes attracted birds long before the fruit was ripe. 在果實成熟之前，那些紅莓灌木就已經吸引了許多鳥類。
A redbill landed on the fence and pecked at the seed tray. 一隻紅嘴鳥落在圍欄上，啄著飼料盤。
The field guide listed several species that locals simply call redbill. 那本野外圖鑑列出了幾種當地人統稱為 redbill 的鳥類。
A redbird flashed through the maple branches and disappeared into the yard. 一隻紅鳥從楓樹枝間掠過，又消失在院子裡。
My grandmother always took a redbird as a sign that spring had finally arrived. 我祖母總把紅鳥當作春天終於來臨的徵兆。
The redbone trotted ahead of us on the trail, nose low to the ground. 那隻紅骨獵犬在小徑上走在我們前面，鼻子貼著地面搜尋氣味。
Her grandparents kept a redbone for hunting in the hills. 她的祖父母養了一隻紅骨獵犬，在山裡打獵用。
A redbreast hopped onto the fence and stared at me without fear. 一隻紅胸鳥跳上籬笆，毫不怕人地盯著我看。
We heard a redbreast singing in the garden before sunrise. 日出前，我們聽見花園裡有知更鳥在歌唱。
The hillside turned bright with redbrush after the spring rain. 春雨過後，山坡上的紅色灌木開得鮮亮。
She paused to photograph a redbrush growing beside the path. 她停下來拍攝長在小路旁的一叢紅色灌木。
A redbuck crossed the open field just as the sun went down. 日落時分，一隻紅羚穿過了空曠的田野。
The guide pointed out the redbuck grazing near the riverbank. 導遊指著在河岸附近吃草的紅羚給我們看。
The redbud was already blooming before the maple woke up. 紫荊樹早在楓樹甦醒前就開花了。
We planted a redbud by the porch to add some color in spring. 我們在門廊旁種了一棵紫荊樹，好讓春天多一點色彩。

meaning: 紅帽行李員；紅帽子的人
sentences: The hotel sent a redcap to carry our bags to the room. 飯店派了一位行李員把我們的行李送到房間。
In the old station, a redcap waited by the train to help travelers. 在舊車站裡，一位紅帽行李員站在火車旁幫旅客。
The museum displayed a uniform worn by a redcoat during the war. 博物館展出了一套戰爭時期紅衣士兵穿過的制服。
In the story, a redcoat marched across the snow with steady steps. 在那個故事裡，一名紅衣士兵踏著穩定的步伐走過雪地。
He redded the campsite before dark so everyone could sleep comfortably. 他在天黑前把營地整理好，讓大家能睡得舒服。
The crew redded the harbor after the storm left debris everywhere. 暴風雨留下滿地殘骸後，工作人員把港口清理了一遍。
The cold wind made her cheeks redden at once. 冷風一吹，她的臉頰立刻變紅了。
The sunset began to redden the edges of the clouds. 夕陽開始把雲朵的邊緣染紅。
The lease contained a reddendo stating the yearly rent. 那份租約載有一條應付條款，寫明每年的租金。
In legal drafting, reddendo names the thing to be paid. 在法律草擬中，應付條款會指出必須支付的項目。
The charter set out the reddendum in a separate clause. 特許狀以單獨條文列明應交付之物。
Lawyers used reddendum to identify the payment due. 律師用這個詞來指明應付的款項。
The reddening of the sky told us sunset was close. 天空逐漸泛紅，告訴我們夕陽快到了。
A slight reddening around the cut made the nurse take a closer look. 傷口周圍稍微泛紅，讓護理師多看了幾眼。
By noon, the wall looked even redder in the sunlight. 到了中午，牆面在陽光下看起來更紅了。
This scarf is redder than the one you wore yesterday. 這條圍巾比你昨天戴的那條更紅。
The redding of the campsite took longer than we expected. 整理營地花的時間比我們預期的還久。
After the feast, the redding of the hall began almost immediately. 宴會一結束，大廳就立刻開始收拾整理。

meaning: 雷丁石；一種磷酸鹽礦物
sentences: Reddingite is a rare phosphate mineral. 雷丁石是一種稀有的磷酸鹽礦物。
The sample was identified as reddingite after testing. 樣本經過檢測後被鑑定為雷丁石。
The soup had a reddish tint from the tomatoes. 這碗湯因為番茄而帶點紅色。
His hair is dark blond with a reddish shine. 他的頭髮是深金色，還帶點紅銅光澤。
The reddishness of the leaves made the whole hill look warm. 樹葉那種微紅的色調，讓整座山看起來很溫暖。
Doctors noted a slight reddishness around the cut. 醫生注意到傷口周圍有些微泛紅。
The reddition of the stolen painting took months of negotiation. 那幅被偷的畫花了好幾個月談判才被交還。
In older legal writing, reddition could mean the act of handing something back. 在較早的法律文書裡，reddition 可以指把某物交還的行為。
The reddleman walked from farm to farm selling red ochre for marking sheep. 那位賣紅土的人走訪各個農場，販賣用來在羊身上做記號的紅赭石。
In the novel, the reddleman appears as a stranger covered in red dust. 在那部小說裡，reddleman 以滿身紅土的陌生人形象出現。
The gardener pulled up a reddock from the bed. 園丁從花圃裡拔掉了一株紅酸模。
Reddock can spread quickly in rough ground. 紅酸模會在粗糙地帶快速蔓延。

meaning: 整理者；清理者；負責清理水道的人
sentences: The reddsman cleared the river channel after the storm. 暴風雨後，整理河道的人把水路清理好了。
He worked as a reddsman, keeping the harbor path open for boats. 他做整理水道的工作，讓港口航道保持暢通。

meaning: ready 的古拼法；準備好的
sentences: The children were reddy to leave the moment the bell rang. 鈴聲一響，孩子們就準備好要走了。
In old poems, reddy often appears as a spelling of ready. 在古詩裡，reddy 常被當作 ready 的舊拼法出現。
The old tale begins with a king seeking wise rede before battle. 那個古老故事一開始，就是國王在開戰前尋求明智的忠告。
Her rede was simple: wait, listen, and then act. 她的建議很簡單：先等、先聽，再行動。
The dealer had to redeal the cards after someone touched the deck. 有人碰過牌堆後，發牌員只好重新發牌。
We redealt the tasks so each person had a fair share. 我們重新分配工作，讓每個人都拿到公平的一份。
The council agreed to redebate the issue after hearing new evidence. 委員會在聽到新證據後，同意重新辯論這個議題。
They redebated the proposal late into the night. 他們把這項提案重新討論到深夜。

meaning: 再次扣款；重新記入借方
sentences: The bank redebited the fee after correcting the account number. 銀行在更正帳號後，重新扣了那筆費用。
Please do not redebit my card unless the first payment failed. 除非第一次付款失敗，否則請不要再刷我的卡。
He promised not to redeceive the customers after the apology. 他道歉後保證不再欺騙顧客。
The scammer tried to redeceive the same victims with a new story. 那個詐騙者又換了新說法，想再度蒙騙同一批受害者。
We had to redecide which route to take when the bridge closed. 橋封閉後，我們只好重新決定要走哪條路。
She redecided the matter after sleeping on it. 她睡了一覺之後，又重新做了決定。

meaning: 再次大幅削減；再次重創
sentences: The wildfire redecimated the hillside after weeks of drought. 乾旱數週後，野火又重創了整片山坡。
If the budget is cut again, it could redecimate the program. 如果預算再被砍一次，這個計畫可能會再次遭到重創。

meaning: 重新決定；再次作出的決定
sentences: After talking to her family, she made a redecision and stayed home. 和家人談過後，她重新做了決定，選擇留在家裡。
The committee's redecision saved the project from being canceled. 委員會重新做出的決定，讓這個計畫免於被取消。
After the storm, we redecked the porch with fresh boards. 暴風雨過後，我們把門廊重新鋪上了新木板。
The boat was too old to sell, so the owner decided to redeck it instead. 那艘船太舊賣不掉，所以船主決定改為重新整修甲板。
Her redeclaration of support surprised the whole room. 她再次表態支持，讓整個房間都很意外。
The lawyer filed a redeclaration to correct the record. 律師提出了一份重新聲明，以更正紀錄。
At the meeting, he chose to redeclare his position in plain language. 在會議上，他選擇用直白的話再次說明自己的立場。
They asked the company to redeclare the shipment's value. 他們要求公司重新申報這批貨物的價值。
Sales began to redecline after a brief holiday bump. 在短暫的假期成長後，銷售又開始下滑。
By spring, the graph showed profits redeclining after a winter rebound. 到了春天，圖表顯示利潤在冬天回升後又再度下滑。
We plan to redecorate the kitchen before the guests arrive. 我們打算在客人來之前重新裝潢廚房。
She redecorated her office with warm colors and a smaller desk lamp. 她用暖色系和較小的桌燈把辦公室重新布置了一遍。
The redecoration of the lobby took two weeks. 大廳的重新裝潢花了兩週。
After the redecoration, the room felt brighter and calmer. 重新裝修後，房間感覺更明亮也更安靜。
The committee voted to redecrease the budget after new estimates arrived. 委員會在新估算出來後，投票決定再次削減預算。
Prices may redecrease if supply catches up with demand. 如果供應跟上需求，價格可能會再次下降。

meaning: 使交叉成 X 形；交叉排列
sentences: Botanists use redecussate to describe leaves that cross at right angles in pairs. 植物學家用 redecussate 來描述成對葉片以直角交錯排列。
The diagram showed the stems redecussate, forming a neat X-shaped pattern. 圖示顯示莖部交錯成十字狀，形成整齊的 X 形。
After the setback, she chose to rededicate herself to training. 在遭遇挫折後，她選擇重新投入訓練。
They rededicated the chapel with a quiet evening service. 他們用一場安靜的晚禮拜為小教堂重新獻堂。
The rededication ceremony drew former students back to campus. 重新獻校典禮吸引了許多校友回到校園。
His rededication to the craft was obvious in every careful brushstroke. 他重新投入這門手藝的心意，從每一筆細緻筆觸都看得出來。
The plaque was part of a rededicatory event for the restored bridge. 這塊紀念牌是那座修復橋梁重新啟用儀式的一部分。
She wrote a short rededicatory speech for the museum's reopening. 她為博物館重新開幕寫了一段簡短的致敬演說。
The auditor had to rededuct the tax because the first calculation was wrong. 由於第一次計算有誤，稽核員不得不重新扣除稅額。
Some philosophers use rededuct in a formal sense to mean drawing the conclusion again. 有些哲學家會正式地使用 rededuct，表示重新推導一次結論。
The rededuction was necessary after the system imported the wrong numbers. 系統匯入錯誤數字後，必須再次扣除。
His rededuction of the argument made the conclusion feel more secure. 他重新推導這個論證後，結論顯得更穩固。

meaning: 重新立契約；再次授予權利
sentences: The family decided to redeed the land to a conservation trust. 這個家庭決定再次把土地轉讓給保育信託。
To settle the dispute, they redeeded the property under a new agreement. 為了平息爭議，他們依照新協議重新辦理了產權轉讓。

meaning: 透過買回某物來恢復其所有權。
sentences: To redeem means to recover ownership of something by buying it back. 贖回意味著透過買回某物來恢復其所有權。
People may redeem in different situations depending on the context. 人們可能會根據具體情況在不同情況下進行救贖。
Investors questioned the redeemability of the bond after the downgrade. 評等調降後，投資人開始質疑這張債券的可贖回性。
The report focused on the redeemability of the product's flaws. 報告聚焦在這項產品缺點是否還有補救的可能。
These coupons are redeemable only at participating stores. 這些優惠券只能在合作商店兌換。
Even a terrible draft can be redeemable if the core idea is strong. 就算初稿很糟，只要核心想法夠好，還是有可取之處。
His redeemableness came from the fact that he always told the truth in the end. 他之所以還有可挽救之處，是因為他最後總會說實話。
The board debated the redeemableness of the project before approving more funding. 董事會在核准更多資金前，討論了這個專案是否還有挽回的價值。
The mistake was redeemably small, so no one panicked. 這個錯誤還算可補救，所以沒有人慌張。
She played the role redeemably well, even though the script was weak. 她把這個角色詮釋得還算可取，雖然劇本本身很弱。
Many people in the village saw her as a redeemer after the flood. 洪水過後，村裡很多人都把她看作救難者。
In the story, the redeemer arrives only after everyone has lost hope. 在這個故事裡，救贖者總是在大家都失去希望之後才出現。
The poet used redeemeress to describe a woman who rescues others with quiet strength. 那位詩人用 redeemeress 來形容一位以沉靜力量拯救他人的女性。
To the children, their teacher was a redeemeress who made school feel safe again. 對孩子們來說，老師就像一位讓學校重新變得安全的女性救助者。

meaning: 救贖者的身分；拯救者地位
sentences: He treated the job as a kind of redeemership, not just a paycheck. 他把這份工作當成一種救贖使命，而不只是領薪水。
The novel questions whether redeemership belongs to one hero or to a whole community. 這部小說質疑，救贖者的角色究竟屬於單一英雄，還是整個社群。

meaning: 無法贖回的；不可挽回的
