When the balloon redistended, the children laughed and crowded around the table. 氣球再次膨脹時，孩子們笑著圍到桌邊。
The researcher had to redistill the liquid to remove the last traces of impurity. 研究人員不得不再次蒸餾那液體，去除最後一點雜質。
She redistilled the old idea into a short, practical plan. 她把那個舊想法重新提煉成一個簡短又實用的計畫。
The redistillation produced a cleaner sample than the first run. 再次蒸餾後得到的樣本比第一次更純淨。
His redistillation of the argument made the whole proposal easier to understand. 他對論點的再提煉，讓整個提案更容易理解。
The old redistiller in the workshop still worked better than the new machine. 工坊裡那台老舊的再次蒸餾器，運作起來還比新機器好。
As a careful redistiller, he checked every batch twice before approving it. 作為一名細心的再次蒸餾者，他會在放行前把每一批都檢查兩遍。
After weeks of confusion, the team finally redistinguished the real problem from the side effects. 經過數週混亂後，團隊終於再次分清真正的問題和副作用。
It took me a second to redistinguish her voice from the others in the crowded room. 我花了幾秒才在吵雜的房間裡重新辨別出她的聲音。

meaning: 再次扣押；重新強制取走財物
sentences: The creditor threatened to redistrain the goods if the rent stayed unpaid. 債權人威脅說，如果房租還不繳，就要再次扣押那些貨物。
No court would allow the officer to redistrain the same property twice without a new order. 如果沒有新的命令，沒有法院會允許執法人員對同一財產再次扣押兩次。

meaning: 再次扣押者；重新強制取財的人
sentences: In the dispute, the redistrainer arrived with a second notice and a stern expression. 在這場爭議中，那位再次扣押者帶著第二份通知和嚴肅表情出現了。
The record listed him as the redistrainer, but the details of the seizure were unclear. 紀錄上把他列為再次扣押者，但這次扣押的細節並不清楚。
We had to redistribute the workload when two people called in sick. 有兩個人請病假時，我們只好重新分配工作量。
The charity will redistribute the donated clothes to shelters across the city. 這家慈善機構會把捐來的衣物再分發到全市各地的收容所。
The software acts as a redistributer, sending files to the right folders automatically. 這套軟體像一個重新分配者，會自動把檔案送到正確的資料夾。
He was the redistributer of the leftover food after every event. 每次活動結束後，他都是負責重新分發剩餘食物的人。
The redistribution of tasks helped the department move faster. 工作重新分配後，部門的進度明顯加快了。
There was a careful redistribution of the supplies after the flood. 洪水過後，物資進行了仔細的重新分配。

meaning: 重新分配的；具再分配作用的
sentences: The policy has a redistributive effect, moving resources toward poorer neighborhoods. 這項政策帶有重新分配的效果，把資源往較貧困的社區傾斜。
Her speech focused on redistributive justice rather than simple efficiency. 她的演說重點放在再分配正義，而不只是單純的效率。
The warehouse software became a redistributor of incoming orders. 倉儲軟體成了進貨訂單的重新分配者。
In the relief effort, the redistributor made sure each town got what it needed. 在救援行動中，那位再分發者確保每個城鎮都拿到所需物資。

meaning: 再分配的；具有重新分配作用的
sentences: The debate centered on whether the new tax was redistributory or simply punitive. 這場辯論的焦點在於新稅制究竟是再分配性的，還是只是懲罰性的。
She described the program as redistributory, designed to balance opportunity more fairly. 她把這個計畫形容為再分配性的，目的是讓機會分配更公平。

meaning: 重新劃分選區；重新分區
sentences: The legislature voted to redistrict the county before the next election. 州議會投票決定在下次選舉前重新劃分該郡的選區。
If they redistrict the city again, many voters will end up in a different district. 如果他們再度重劃城市選區，很多選民最後會被劃到不同的區。
I didn't mean to redisturb you after the meeting had already ended. 會議都結束了，我不是故意又來打擾你的。
The noise from the hallway redisturbed her sleep before dawn. 走廊傳來的噪音在天亮前又把她的睡眠打擾了。
The diver surfaced for air and then redove to inspect the wreck. 潛水員浮上來換氣，接著又潛回去查看殘骸。
He took a deep breath, closed his eyes, and redove into the pool. 他深吸一口氣，閉上眼睛，然後又跳進泳池裡。
The rediversion of traffic kept the roadwork moving safely. 交通重新改道讓道路施工得以安全進行。
There was a sudden rediversion of attention when the speaker changed topics. 當演講者換了話題時，大家的注意力突然又轉向別處。
The airline had to redivert several flights because of the storm. 因為暴風雨，航空公司不得不讓好幾個航班再次改道。
Please redivert the delivery to the back entrance after noon. 請在中午過後把送貨路線重新改到後門。

meaning: 可重新轉向的；可再次改道的
sentences: The route is redivertible, so the driver can adjust it if the bridge closes. 這條路線可重新改道，所以司機若遇到橋樑封閉就能調整。
He liked systems that were redivertible when plans changed at the last minute. 他喜歡那種在臨時變更計畫時，還能重新轉向的系統。
We had to redivide the budget after the funding cut. 經費被削減後，我們只好重新劃分預算。
The family agreed to redivide the land so each sibling would have fair access. 這家人同意再次分割土地，好讓每位手足都能公平使用。
The redivision of the classroom space created more room for group work. 教室空間重新劃分後，小組活動就有了更多位置。
There was a redivision of responsibilities after the manager left. 經理離職後，職責也跟著重新分配。

meaning: 再度復活的；重新活躍的
sentences: The old brand looked redivive after the campaign brought back public interest. 這個老品牌在行銷活動帶回人氣後，又重新活了起來。
She described his hope as redivive, not new but clearly alive again. 她說他的希望帶著再度復活的氣息，不是全新的，但確實又活了過來。
The poem gave the ruins a redivivous energy, as if they were waking from sleep. 這首詩賦予廢墟一種復活般的生命力，彷彿它們正從沉睡中醒來。
After the long break, the band's sound felt redivivous and fresh. 長時間休團後，這支樂團的聲音聽起來像是重新復活了一樣，充滿新鮮感。

meaning: 復活者；再現的事物；重生的
sentences: The critic called the sequel a redivivus of the original film's spirit. 那位影評人把續集稱作原作精神的再現。
In the museum catalog, the phoenix appeared as a redivivus symbol of return and renewal. 在博物館目錄中，鳳凰被寫成象徵回歸與更新的復活意象。
After remarrying in haste, they had to redivorce within a year. 他們草率再婚後，不到一年又得再次離婚。
The novel follows a couple who cannot seem to divorce, remarry, and redivorce in peace. 這本小說寫的是一對夫妻怎樣都無法平靜地離婚、再婚，又再次離婚。

meaning: 再次離婚；重新分開的狀態
sentences: Their redivorcement became the topic everyone whispered about at the reunion. 他們再次離婚成了同學會上人人私下議論的話題。
The lawyer said the redivorcement paperwork would be simpler the second time. 律師說，第二次辦離婚文件會簡單一些。
She promised not to redivulge the private message to anyone else. 她答應不會把那則私訊再透露給任何人。
The witness refused to redivulge the details after the first interview. 那名證人拒絕在第一次訪談後再重述細節。
The redivulgence of the old report stirred up fresh controversy. 那份舊報告再次被揭露，又掀起了新的爭議。
He worried that any redivulgence of the plan would ruin the surprise. 他擔心，只要這個計畫再度泄露，驚喜就全毀了。

meaning: 紅外套的人；穿紅夾克的人
sentences: The redjacket at the station turned out to be my cousin from New York. 站在車站穿紅夾克的人，原來是我從紐約來的表親。
A redjacket stood out in the crowd like a moving sign. 一件紅外套在人群中特別顯眼，像個會走動的招牌。

meaning: 紅膝的人；膝蓋泛紅的樣子
sentences: After an hour of hiking, the children came back looking like redknees from all the scrapes. 爬山一小時後，孩子們因為一路擦傷，看起來像是膝蓋都發紅了。
The old field guide mentioned redknees as a local nickname for the villagers. 那本舊野外指南把 redknees 寫成當地對村民的綽號。
In the novel, the redleg was a veteran who marched with the artillery. 在小說裡，那名紅腿兵是跟著砲兵部隊行軍的老兵。
The villagers used redleg as a rough nickname for the foreign soldiers. 村民把 redleg 當作外國士兵的粗俗綽號。
The redlegs arrived before dawn and set up camp near the river. 那些紅腿兵在拂曉前抵達，並在河邊紮營。
Locals still refer to the old unit as the redlegs in family stories. 當地人至今仍在家族故事裡把那支老部隊稱作 redlegs。
The sunset spread redly across the windows of the apartment. 日落的紅光斜斜地映滿公寓的窗戶。
He blushed redly when the teacher praised his answer. 老師稱讚他的答案時，他一下子臉紅了。

meaning: 紅嘴；嘴部發紅的人或動物
sentences: The bird guide listed the redmouth among the rare wetland species. 那本鳥類指南把 redmouth 列為稀有的濕地物種之一。
A redmouth can look striking in photographs, especially against pale feathers. 紅嘴在照片裡很搶眼，尤其和淺色羽毛形成對比時。
The redness around her eyes faded after a good night's sleep. 她眼周的紅腫在好好睡了一晚後消退了。
A touch of redness made the painting feel warmer and more alive. 一點點紅色讓這幅畫看起來更溫暖，也更有生氣。
I had to redo the slide deck after the data changed overnight. 因為資料一夜之間變了，我只好把簡報重做一遍。
If the sauce tastes wrong, just redo it from the beginning. 如果醬汁味道不對，就從頭再做一次。
The ferry had to redock because the first approach was too rough. 渡輪因為第一次靠岸太過顛簸，只好重新停靠。
They redocked the ship at the smaller pier to avoid the storm. 他們把船改停到較小的碼頭，以避開風暴。

meaning: 重新編入案卷；重新登記
sentences: The clerk had to redocket the case after the court changed the filing date. 法院更改收件日期後，書記員只好重新把案件編入案卷。
We redocketed the complaint so the new judge could review it. 我們把申訴重新登記，方便新法官審閱。

meaning: 芬芳；香氣；令人聯想到的氣息
sentences: The redolence of jasmine drifted through the open window. 茉莉的芬芳從打開的窗戶飄了進來。
There was a redolence of old books in the attic that made her nostalgic. 閣樓裡有種舊書的氣息，讓她不禁懷舊起來。

meaning: 芬芳；濃郁的香味；令人想起之感
sentences: The redolency of fresh bread made everyone hurry to the kitchen. 新鮮麵包的香氣讓大家都趕緊往廚房走去。
Her writing has a redolency of summer evenings and quiet streets. 她的文字帶著一種讓人聯想到夏夜與安靜街道的氣息。

meaning: 香氣四溢的；使人聯想到的
sentences: The room was redolent of cedar and old paper. 這個房間充滿雪松和舊紙的氣味。
His story was redolent of the kind of courage people rarely see. 他的故事讓人聯想到那種人們很少見到的勇氣。

meaning: 帶著香氣地；令人聯想到地
sentences: The market stalls smelled redolently of spices and roasted nuts. 市集攤位裡瀰漫著香料與烤堅果的氣味。
She spoke redolently of the town where she grew up. 她談起自己長大的城鎮時，語氣充滿懷舊氣息。
One idea began to redominate the discussion as the meeting went on. 會議進行時，一個想法又開始重新主導討論。
Strong defense allowed the home team to redominate after halftime. 堅實的防守讓主隊在下半場重新占上風。

meaning: 西班牙四行詩；押韻四行詩節
sentences: The poet ended the poem with a redondilla. 詩人用一段西班牙四行詩結束作品。
She studied the redondilla form before writing her own verse. 她在寫自己的詩之前先研究這種詩體。

meaning: 再次判定；再次註定；重新定奪
sentences: The legend said the mountain would redoom anyone who climbed it alone. 傳說說，那座山會再次註定任何獨自攀登者的命運。
The committee seemed ready to redoom the project before hearing the final proposal. 委員會在聽最後提案前，似乎就已準備再次判定這個計畫的命運。
We need to redouble our efforts to finish the project on time. 我們需要加倍努力以準時完成專案。
The team redoubled its energy after the half-time break. 中場休息後，球隊加強了勁頭。
The coach praised the redoublement of effort in the last five minutes. 教練稱讚球員在最後五分鐘把努力加倍了。
In language study, redoublement can describe the repetition of a sound or word. 在語言研究中，redoublement 可以指聲音或詞語的重複。

meaning: 使加倍者；加強的人或事物
sentences: In the story, he was the redoubler who kept turning a small risk into a bigger one. 在故事裡，他是那個把小風險越弄越大的加倍者。
The redoubler of the argument was actually the one who kept repeating the same point. 那場爭論的推波助瀾者，其實一直在重複同一個論點。
The redoubling of support after the flood helped the town recover faster. 洪水過後，支援加倍到來，讓小鎮恢復得更快。
There was a redoubling of caution once the weather turned worse. 天氣轉壞後，大家的警惕也明顯提高了。

meaning: 棱堡；小型防禦工事；最後防線
sentences: The old redoubt still overlooks the harbor from the hilltop. 那座古老的棱堡至今仍從山丘上俯瞰著港口。
She treated her tiny studio as a redoubt against the noise of the city. 她把自己那間小小的工作室當成對抗城市喧鬧的堡壘。

meaning: 令人敬畏的；難以對付的；強大的
sentences: The redoubtable judge asked questions that left the lawyers silent. 那位令人敬畏的法官提出的問題，讓律師們一時語塞。
She became a redoubtable opponent after years of practice and discipline. 經過多年練習與自律，她成了個很難對付的對手。

meaning: 令人敬畏；難以對付的程度
sentences: His redoubtableness on the debate stage came from calm timing, not volume. 他在辯論台上的威懾力來自穩定的節奏，而不是音量。
The redoubtableness of the old fortress was enough to discourage invaders. 那座古堡令人敬畏的程度，已足以讓入侵者卻步。

meaning: 令人敬畏地；難以對付地
sentences: The veteran spoke redoubtably, and everyone in the room listened. 那位老將軍說話時氣勢十足，房間裡的人都安靜聽著。
She redoubtably defended her choice without raising her voice. 她沒有提高音量，卻依然氣場十足地為自己的選擇辯護。

meaning: 著名的；受敬重的；令人畏懼的
sentences: The redoubted captain was mentioned in songs long after the war ended. 那位著名的船長在戰爭結束後很久，仍被人寫進歌裡。
In older texts, a redoubted hero is someone both admired and feared. 在古老文本裡，redoubted hero 指的是既受敬重又令人畏懼的英雄。
Her generosity will redound to her reputation for years. 她的慷慨會在未來多年持續為她的名聲加分。
Good planning can redound to the success of the whole team. 良好的規劃能為整個團隊的成功帶來助益。

meaning: 雷多瓦舞；波希米亞三步舞
sentences: The dancers practiced a redowa with a lively three-step rhythm. 舞者們練習了一段節奏活潑的波希米亞三步舞。
At the festival, the redowa surprised people who expected only waltzes. 在節慶上，這種舞步讓原本只期待華爾滋的人很驚喜。

meaning: 氧化還原作用；氧化還原反應
sentences: Chemistry class spent the whole afternoon on redox reactions and their energy changes. 化學課整個下午都在講氧化還原反應和它們的能量變化。
A battery works because a redox process moves electrons from one material to another. 電池之所以能運作，是因為氧化還原作用把電子從一種物質轉移到另一種物質。
A redpoll landed on the feeder and pecked at the seeds. 一隻紅額金翅雀停在餵食器上，啄著種子吃。
During winter, redpolls sometimes move farther south in search of food. 冬天時，紅額金翅雀有時會往更南邊移動找食物。
The editor asked her to redraft the memo in plainer language. 編輯請她把備忘錄重新起草，用更淺白的語言寫。
After a few revisions, the team redrafted the proposal and sent it out again. 幾輪修改之後，團隊把提案重新改寫，再次送出。
He had to redrag the suitcase across the wet floor. 他只好把行李箱在濕滑的地板上再拖一次。
The mechanic told him to redrag the cable before tightening the clamp. 技師叫他先把電纜重新拖回正確位置，再把夾具鎖緊。

meaning: 重新懸掛布料；重新垂掛
sentences: She redraped the curtains to let more light into the room. 她把窗簾重新垂掛好，讓更多光線照進房間。
The stylist redraped the fabric over the mannequin until the folds looked soft. 那位造型師把布料重新垂在模特兒上，直到皺摺看起來很柔順。
I had to redraw the map after the river changed course. 河流改道後，我只好把地圖重新畫過。
The architect redrew the entrance to make the building feel more open. 建築師把入口重新設計繪製，讓整棟建築看起來更開闊。
As a careful redrawer, he fixed old comic panels without losing their energy. 身為一個細心的重畫者，他修整舊漫畫頁面時仍保留了原本的張力。
The museum hired a redrawer to restore damaged diagrams from the archive. 博物館雇了一位重畫者，修復檔案裡受損的圖表。
After the breakup, she kept redreaming the same impossible reunion. 分手之後，她總是反覆夢見同一場不可能的重逢。
Some people redream childhood scenes so vividly that they wake up feeling they were there again. 有些人會把童年的場景夢回得非常鮮明，醒來時還覺得自己真的回到了那裡。
The city decided to redredge the harbor before the fishing season. 市政府決定在漁季前再次疏浚港口。
They had to redredge the canal after years of silt buildup. 由於多年淤積，他們只好把運河重新疏浚一遍。
The company promised to redress the billing error quickly. 公司承諾會盡快補救帳單上的錯誤。
The new policy was designed to redress a long-standing imbalance. 這項新政策是為了糾正長期存在的不平衡。
The complaint was redressable through the normal appeal process. 這項申訴可以透過一般上訴程序獲得補救。
Not every harm is redressable, but this one was clear and documented. 不是每一種傷害都能補救，但這次的情況證據明確、記錄完整。
The court ordered a redressal of the unfair charges. 法院要求對那些不公平的收費進行補救。
The union demanded redressal for the workers who had been underpaid. 工會要求替那些被低薪支付的勞工提供救濟。
In the town, the ombudsman was known as a quiet redresser of complaints. 在那個城鎮裡，申訴專員以安靜的糾正者著稱。
She acted as a redresser of old mistakes by helping people recover lost records. 她協助人們找回遺失的紀錄，像是在替舊錯誤補救。
The judge said the injury was redressible if the contract were rewritten. 法官表示，只要重新擬約，這項損害是可以補救的。
That kind of damage is redressible when the evidence is still available. 那種損害在證據仍然保存時，是可以補救的。
The redressive measures focused on training rather than punishment. 這些矯正措施把重點放在訓練，而不是懲罰。
Her redressive speech was meant to repair trust after the dispute. 她那番補救性的談話，是想在爭執後修補信任。

meaning: 無法補救的；無從糾正的
sentences: For years, the villagers felt redressless under the unfair landlord. 多年來，村民在那個不公正的地主底下都覺得無法申冤。
A redressless grievance can turn into lasting resentment. 無從補救的怨氣，可能最後變成長久的怨恨。
The report called for redressment of the discriminatory policy. 那份報告要求對歧視性政策進行補救。
He wanted redressment, not an apology that changed nothing. 他要的是實際補救，而不是一個毫無改變的道歉。
The commissioner acted as a redressor of public complaints. 那位專員扮演了公眾申訴的補救者角色。
In the story, the redressor refuses to let a small injustice go unchallenged. 在故事裡，那位糾正者不願讓小小的不公就這樣被忽略。
We had to redrill the holes after the measurements were off by a few millimeters. 因為量測差了幾毫米，我們只好把孔重新鑽過。
The coach will redrill the basics tomorrow until everyone gets the footwork right. 教練明天會再把基本動作重練一次，直到每個人的步法都正確。
The courier had to redrive through the neighborhood after missing the first turn. 快遞員錯過第一個轉彎後，只好再開一次穿過那個社區。
The database admin redrove the migration script until it finished cleanly. 資料庫管理員把遷移腳本重新執行，直到它乾淨地跑完。
Redroot grows along the trail and sends up clusters of tiny flowers. 紅根植物常長在步道旁，還會開出一簇簇小花。
The herbalist pointed to redroot as a plant with a bright underground stem. 那位草藥師指著紅根植物，說它有鮮紅的地下莖。
Please redry the dishes before you put them away. 請把盤子再弄乾一點再收起來。
The shirts were still damp, so she redried them for another ten minutes. 襯衫還是有點潮，所以她又烘乾了十分鐘。
The sun seemed to redsear the hillside by noon. 到了中午，太陽彷彿把山坡又烤焦了一遍。
He redseared the edge of the rope to keep it from fraying. 他把繩子的末端再燒一下，免得它繼續散開。
A redshank waded through the marsh with quick, nervous steps. 一隻紅腳鷸以敏捷又警覺的步伐涉過沼澤。
Birdwatchers came early to spot the redshank before the tide turned. 賞鳥人士一早就來，只為在潮水轉向前看到那隻紅腳鷸。

meaning: 紅衫球員；延後出賽的新生球員
sentences: The quarterback took a redshirt year and spent it learning the playbook. 那位四分衛先以紅衫年身分休戰，把時間拿來熟悉戰術本。
He returned from his redshirt season stronger and more confident. 結束紅衫賽季後，他回到場上時更強壯也更有自信。

meaning: 舊稱，現多視為冒犯的美洲原住民稱呼
sentences: The word redskin is now widely regarded as offensive and outdated. 這個詞如今普遍被視為冒犯且過時。
The book noted that historical documents sometimes used redskin, but modern writers should avoid it. 那本書提到歷史文獻有時會用到 redskin，但現代寫作者應避免使用。
A redstart flashed through the branches like a little ember. 一隻紅尾鴝像小火星一樣，從樹枝間掠過。
We heard a redstart sing near the campsite at dawn. 破曉時分，我們聽見營地附近有一隻紅尾鴝在唱歌。
A redstreak ran through the marble and caught the light. 大理石裡有一道紅色條痕，還被光線照得很明顯。
The sunset left a redstreak across the horizon. 夕陽在地平線上留下了一道紅色的長痕。
He clipped a redtab onto the folder so the report would stand out. 他在資料夾上夾了一個紅色標籤，讓那份報告更醒目。
The jacket had a redtab at the pocket seam, which made it easy to spot. 那件外套口袋縫線上有一個紅色標記，因此很好辨認。
A redtail circled above the field and then vanished into the clouds. 一隻紅尾鵟在田野上空盤旋，接著消失在雲裡。
The children stopped to watch the redtail perch on the fence post. 孩子們停下來看那隻紅尾鵟棲在柵欄柱上。

meaning: 紅喉鳥；喉部帶紅色的鳥類
sentences: A redthroat perched on the fence and sang at sunrise. 一隻紅喉鳥停在圍欄上，在日出時唱著歌。
We spotted the redthroat again near the creek this afternoon. 今天下午我們又在小溪附近看見那隻紅喉鳥。

meaning: 紅頂草；紅穗草一類的植物
sentences: The meadow was dotted with redtop swaying in the wind. 草地上點綴著隨風搖曳的紅頂草。
Farmers once valued redtop for the hay it could provide. 農人過去很重視紅頂草，因為它能提供乾草。
The studio had to redub several lines after the microphone failed. 麥克風出問題後，錄音室不得不把幾句台詞重新配音。
They decided to redub the documentary for a younger audience. 他們決定為年輕觀眾把這部紀錄片重新配音。

meaning: 重新配音的人；重錄配音者
sentences: The redubber matched the actor's mouth movements with surprising care. 那位重新配音者把演員的口型對得出奇仔細。
In a busy post-production house, a good redubber is worth a lot. 在忙碌的後期製作公司裡，好的重新配音者非常珍貴。
We should all try to reduce our usage of single-use plastic. 我們都應該努力減少一次性塑料的使用。
The new system will help to reduce the overall operational costs. 新系統將有助於降低整體的營運成本。
The company treats overtime as reduceable when deadlines are flexible. 公司認為，只要期限有彈性，加班時間就是可以縮減的。
Not every cost in the budget is reduceable without consequences. 預算裡並不是每一筆開銷都能在沒有後果的情況下縮減。

meaning: 可縮減性；可降低的程度
sentences: She argued about the reduceableness of the project before signing off. 她在簽核前先討論了這個專案到底有多大的可縮減性。
The reduceableness of the plan depends on how much waste we can cut. 這個方案有多可縮減，要看我們能減掉多少浪費。

meaning: 變成 更小 或 更少 ；經歷了 減少。
sentences: the reduced prices in a summer sale 夏季促銷 降價 夏季促銷 夏季降價
The report describes the result as reduced. 報告將結果描述為減少。 報告將結果描述為減少。 報告將結果描述為減少。
The reducement of traffic noise made the street much calmer. 交通噪音的減少讓這條街安靜許多。
He presented the reducement of costs as the first step toward recovery. 他把成本縮減當成復甦的第一步。

meaning: 起減少作用的；使降低的
sentences: They were looking for a reducent ingredient in the formula. 他們正在配方裡尋找一種能起減少作用的成分。
The medicine has a reducent effect on swelling. 這種藥對腫脹有減輕作用。

meaning: 減縮器；降低裝置；減少者
sentences: The plumber installed a pressure reducer on the main line. 水管工在主管線上裝了一個減壓器。
In the lab, a reducer can make the reaction easier to control. 在實驗室裡，降低裝置能讓反應更容易控制。
The team tested the reducibility of the problem before choosing a method. 團隊在選擇方法前先測試了這個問題的可歸約性。
His talk focused on the reducibility of complex systems into smaller parts. 他的演講聚焦於複雜系統能否化簡成更小的部分。
The fraction is reducible if both numbers share a common factor. 如果分子和分母有公因數，這個分數就是可化簡的。
For her, stress was reducible once she changed her schedule. 對她來說，只要調整行程，壓力就能減輕。
The reducibleness of the equation made the homework easier than expected. 這道方程式的可化簡性讓作業比預期簡單。
He questioned the reducibleness of the whole proposal. 他質疑整個提案到底有多少可縮減的空間。
The data were organized reducibly so the model could read them quickly. 這些資料是以可化簡的方式整理的，所以模型能快速讀取。
He explained the idea reducibly, without losing the main point. 他把這個概念用可化簡的方式說明，卻沒有丟掉重點。
The city is reducing car lanes to make room for bikes. 這座城市正在減少汽車車道，為自行車騰出空間。
She is reducing her sugar intake before the marathon. 她在馬拉松前正減少糖分攝取。

meaning: 還原物；被還原的物質；縮減結果
sentences: In chemistry, the reduct was examined under a microscope. 在化學中，這種還原物被放在顯微鏡下檢查。
The old manuscript looked like a reduct of an earlier, longer version. 那份古老手稿看起來像是早期較長版本的縮減本。
The chemist added a reductant to speed up the reaction. 化學家加入還原劑來加快反應。
In this process, the reductant must be chosen very carefully. 在這個過程中，還原劑必須非常小心挑選。
The report mentioned a reductase linked to the metabolic pathway. 報告提到一種與代謝途徑相關的還原酶。
Scientists studied how reductase changes the speed of the reaction. 科學家研究還原酶如何改變反應速度。
The reductibility of the compound made it useful in the experiment. 這種化合物的可還原性讓它在實驗中很有用。
We discussed the reductibility of the theory before the lecture ended. 在講座結束前，我們討論了這個理論的可化簡性。
The company announced a significant reduction in its workforce this year. 該公司宣布今年將大幅削減（減少）其勞動力。
You can get a further reduction in price if you pay for the goods in cash. 如果你用現金付款，價格可以進一步降低（折扣）。
The manager introduced a reductional policy to cut waste. 經理提出了一項縮減性的政策來減少浪費。
Her argument was reductional, but it helped the room reach a decision. 她的論點帶有縮減傾向，但也幫助大家做出決定。
The philosopher warned against reductionism in debates about human behavior. 那位哲學家警告，在討論人類行為時不要陷入還原主義。
Reductionism can be useful, but it also hides important details. 簡化主義有時很有用，但也會遮蔽重要細節。
The reductionist said every social problem could be traced to incentives. 那位還原主義者說，每個社會問題都能追溯到誘因。
As a reductionist, he liked explanations that were short and direct. 身為還原主義者，他喜歡簡短直接的解釋。

meaning: 還原主義的；過度簡化的
sentences: The article criticized the reductionistic view that money explains everything. 這篇文章批評了那種認為金錢能解釋一切的還原主義觀點。
A reductionistic answer is not always a wrong answer, but it can be incomplete. 過度簡化的答案不一定錯，但常常不完整。
The teacher gave a reductive summary to help beginners start. 老師給了一個簡化的摘要，讓初學者能先入門。
His reductive explanation left out the emotional side of the story. 他的簡化式說明忽略了故事中的情感面。
She reductively framed the issue as a choice between speed and safety. 她以簡化的方式把這個問題框成速度與安全之間的選擇。
The report reductively grouped several unrelated causes together. 那份報告用過度簡化的方式，把幾個不相關的原因混在一起。

meaning: 減速器；還原器；降低裝置
sentences: The machine needs a reductor to keep the gears from spinning too fast. 這台機器需要減速器，才能避免齒輪轉得太快。
In older texts, reductor can refer to a device or agent that reduces something. 在較舊的文獻裡，reductor 可以指降低某物的裝置或作用者。

meaning: 與縮減有關的；與還原有關的
sentences: The essay had a reductorial tone that stripped the topic to its basics. 這篇文章帶有縮減式的語氣，把主題剝到最基本的層次。
His reductorial reading of the case missed the broader context. 他對這個案例的還原式解讀忽略了更大的背景。
If the numbers look wrong, redue the calculation from the beginning. 如果數字看起來不對，就從頭再算一次。
The editor asked the writer to redue the opening paragraph. 編輯要作者把開頭段落重新處理一次。
Redunca is a genus of antelope found in Africa. 大羚屬是分布於非洲的羚羊屬。
The guide pointed out Redunca as a graceful plains animal. 導覽員把大羚屬指給大家看，當作草原上優雅動物的例子。
The report had too much redundance, so I trimmed several paragraphs. 這份報告冗詞太多，所以我刪掉了幾段。
A little redundance can be helpful in a speech, but too much becomes tiring. 演說裡有一點冗餘也許有幫助，但太多就會讓人疲倦。
The company announced a series of redundancies following the economic crisis. 公司在經濟危機後宣佈了一連串的裁員。
The new software is designed to eliminate data redundancy and save space. 這款新軟體旨在消除數據冗餘並節省空間。
Four employees were made redundant. 四名員工被裁員。
Something described as redundant is dismissed from employment because no longer needed. 被描述為多餘的人因不再需要而被解僱。
He redundantly repeated the warning three times before leaving. 他在離開前多餘地重複提醒了三次。
The system was redundantly backed up in case one server failed. 這套系統以冗餘方式備份，以防其中一台伺服器故障。
The announcer reduplicated the final phrase for dramatic effect. 主持人為了營造戲劇效果，把最後一句又重複了一次。
I don't want to reduplicate your work, so I'll check the shared notes first. 我不想重複你的工作，所以我會先查看共用筆記。

meaning: 重複；複製；語言中的重疊構詞
sentences: The designer used reduplication to make the logo feel playful. 設計師用重複手法讓標誌看起來更俏皮。
In linguistics, reduplication can change meaning without adding new words. 在語言學裡，重疊構詞可以不增加新字就改變意思。
Her reduplicative style made the speech sound musical and memorable. 她那種重複性的說法讓演講聽起來更有韻律，也更好記。
The children loved the reduplicative rhyme in the bedtime story. 孩子們很喜歡睡前故事裡那種重疊式的押韻。

meaning: 以重複的方式；以重疊構詞的方式
sentences: He spoke reduplicatively, letting each important word come back twice. 他用重複的方式說話，讓每個重要的字都回來兩次。
The chant was reduplicatively patterned, so it sounded almost hypnotic. 那段吟唱以重疊的節奏排列，聽起來幾乎有催眠感。

meaning: 造成重複的；具重疊效果的
sentences: The editor removed the reduplicatory lines to tighten the paragraph. 編輯刪掉那些造成重複的句子，讓段落更精簡。
The poem's reduplicatory rhythm gave it an old folk-song feel. 這首詩那種反覆的節奏，讓它有種古老民謠的味道。

meaning: 摺返的部分；重疊折返處
sentences: The map had a reduplicature where the paper folded back on itself. 那張地圖上有一處摺返，紙邊往回折了起來。
A careful hand smoothed the reduplicature before the manuscript was photographed. 在手稿拍照前，一隻細心的手先把摺返處壓平。
The reduviid moved slowly along the wall, looking like a tiny predator. 那隻蠍蝽科昆蟲沿著牆慢慢爬行，看起來像個小獵手。
A naturalist identified the bug as a reduviid rather than a harmless beetle. 一位自然學家認出那隻蟲是蠍蝽，而不是無害的甲蟲。
Reduviidae includes many insects that hunt other bugs. 蠍蝽科包含許多會捕食其他昆蟲的物種。
The guide explained that Reduviidae is famous for its assassin bugs. 解說員提到，蠍蝽科以刺客椿象聞名。
The insect had a reduvioid shape, narrow and sharply pointed. 那隻昆蟲有蠍蝽狀的外形，又窄又尖。
Its reduvioid profile made it easy to mistake for a predatory bug. 它那種像蠍蝽的輪廓，很容易讓人誤以為是掠食性昆蟲。
The specimen was labeled Reduvius in the museum drawer. 樣本在博物館抽屜裡被標成蠍蝽屬。
A curator pointed out that Reduvius belongs to assassin bugs. 館員指出，蠍蝽屬屬於刺客椿象類。

meaning: 再現的；重新呈現的；復返的
sentences: The film felt like a noir redux with brighter colors. 這部電影像是黑色電影的復返版，只是色彩更明亮。
She treated the dish as a family recipe redux, not a copy. 她把這道菜當成家傳食譜的再現版，而不是照抄。
The sky shifted redward as the sun dropped lower. 太陽愈沉愈低時，天空也往紅色那端轉去。
The graph drifted redward when the warm light hit the screen. 暖光照到螢幕時，圖表的色調往紅端偏移。
The shelf was lined with old redware from a local kiln. 架子上擺滿了當地窯場燒出的舊紅陶。
She collected redware because she loved the warm color of the clay. 她收藏紅陶，因為她喜歡那種泥土的溫暖色澤。

meaning: 紅色雜草；常指罌粟或商陸
sentences: The farmer spotted redweed along the edge of the field. 農夫在田邊發現了一叢紅色雜草。
After the rain, the redweed seemed brighter against the green grass. 雨後，那些紅色雜草在綠草襯托下顯得更鮮明。

meaning: 紅翼鳥；尤指歐洲紅翼鶇或紅翅黑鸝
sentences: A redwing flashed across the hedges and vanished into the trees. 一隻紅翼鳥掠過樹籬，隨即消失在樹林裡。
In winter, the park sometimes fills with redwings from farther north. 冬天時，公園裡有時會飛來北方的紅翼鳥。

meaning: 紅柳枝；可彎曲的紅色繩條
sentences: The fence was tied with a redwithe cut from a willow tree. 那道籬笆是用從柳樹上割下的紅柳枝綁住的。
He bent the redwithe into a loop before fastening the bundle. 他先把紅柳枝彎成圈，再把那捆東西綁好。
This redwood deck will last forever. 這款 紅木 甲板將永遠持續下去。 這個紅木甲板將永遠持續下去。 這個紅木甲板將永遠持續下去。
The term redwood refers to A tree of the species Sequoia sempervirens. 紅木一詞指的是 該物種的樹 Sequoia sempervirens 。 紅杉一詞是指紅杉屬的樹。 紅木是指該物種的樹Sequoia sempervirens 。
I want to redye this scarf so the color looks deeper. 我想把這條圍巾重新染色，讓顏色更深一些。
They had to redye the fabric after the first batch came out too pale. 第一批布料染得太淡，所以他們只好再染一次。
Ree signed the guest book before entering the gallery. 他在進入展廳前先在來賓簿上簽名。
The package was addressed to Ree, so the front desk held it aside. 包裹是寄給某人的，所以櫃台先代為保留。
The baker had to ree the flour before mixing the dough. 麵包師傅在和麵之前，得先把麵粉過篩。
Old recipes sometimes ask you to ree grain by hand. 舊食譜有時會叫你用手把穀物篩過。

meaning: 有濃烈氣味的；煙燻發黑的
sentences: The kitchen went reechy after the onions burned. 洋蔥燒焦後，廚房裡瀰漫著一股濃重的味道。
His coat smelled reechy from the campfire and the wet wood. 他的外套沾上了營火和濕木頭的味道，聞起來很嗆。

meaning: 凝乳酵素；反芻動物的第四胃
sentences: In older texts, reed meant the fourth stomach of a ruminant. 舊文本中，這個詞指反芻動物的第四胃。
The old recipe called for reed to help the milk curdle. 舊配方要求使用凝乳酵素來幫助牛奶凝結。

meaning: 葦地鳥；常指在蘆葦叢中活動的小鳥
sentences: A reedbird darted out of the marsh and vanished in a blink. 一隻葦地鳥從沼澤裡竄出來，一眨眼就不見了。
The birdwatcher came early to catch sight of the reedbird at dawn. 那位賞鳥人很早就來，只為在清晨看見那隻蘆葦鳥。

meaning: 水羚屬的非洲羚羊；蘆葦羚
sentences: A reedbuck stepped out of the tall grass near the riverbank. 一隻蘆葦羚從河岸旁的高草裡走了出來。
The safari guide pointed out a reedbuck hiding in the reeds. 狩獵導遊指著躲在蘆葦裡的一隻蘆葦羚。

meaning: 蘆葦叢；長滿蘆葦的灌叢
sentences: The path disappeared into a dense reedbush beside the pond. 小徑消失在池塘邊濃密的蘆葦叢裡。
We heard frogs before we saw the reedbush sway in the wind. 我們先聽見青蛙叫，才看到那片蘆葦叢在風中搖動。

meaning: 有細條紋的；帶滾紋的；飾有蘆葦狀紋理的
sentences: The old coin had a reeded edge that felt familiar in my palm. 那枚舊硬幣邊緣有滾紋，握在手裡很有熟悉的觸感。
She chose a reeded glass vase because the grooves caught the light. 她選了一只帶細紋的玻璃花瓶，因為那些凹槽會把光線抓住。

meaning: 由蘆葦做成的；含蘆葦的
sentences: The cottage had a reeden roof that looked rustic and tidy. 那間小屋有一個蘆葦做的屋頂，看起來樸實又整齊。
He followed the reeden bank until the stream widened into a marsh. 他沿著長滿蘆葦的河岸走，直到溪流變寬成了沼澤。

meaning: 從事蘆葦屋頂、織機筘或相關工作的工人
sentences: The reeder checked the loom before the day's weaving began. 那位修筘工人在一天的織布開始前先檢查了織機。
In the village, a reeder was once needed to keep the roof watertight. 在那個村子裡，過去得靠蘆葦屋頂工人來保持屋頂不漏水。

meaning: 戲謔造出的長詞；看起來像玩笑的自造字
sentences: The teacher wrote reediemadeasy on the board just to make everyone laugh. 老師把 reediemadeasy 寫在黑板上，只是想逗大家笑。
It looked like a reediemadeasy kind of word, impossible to take seriously. 那看起來就像一個戲謔造出的長字，實在很難當真。

meaning: 像蘆葦般地；纖細地；帶有蘆葦感地
sentences: The singer leaned reedily into the microphone, almost too softly to hear. 那位歌手像蘆葦般纖細地靠近麥克風，聲音小得幾乎聽不見。
The grass moved reedily in the wind along the river edge. 河岸邊的草在風中像蘆葦一樣輕輕搖擺。

meaning: 蘆葦茂密；纖細如蘆葦的狀態
sentences: The reediness of the marsh made the shoreline hard to see. 沼澤裡蘆葦叢生，讓岸線很難看清。
People admired the reediness of the young actor's voice and frame. 大家很欣賞那位年輕演員聲音和身形都帶點蘆葦般的纖細感。

meaning: 滾紋；細凸紋；條狀裝飾紋
sentences: The watchmaker polished the reeding around the bezel until it shone. 錶匠把錶圈上的滾紋擦亮到發光。
You can feel the reeding on the handle even when you are not looking. 就算不看，手上也能摸到把手上的細紋。
The pond smelled reedish after the wind pushed the plants together. 風把植物都吹攏後，池塘聞起來有點像蘆葦味。
Her sketch gave the marsh a reedish, fragile look. 她畫出的沼澤帶著一種像蘆葦般脆弱的感覺。
The bookstore displayed a reedition of the old travel diary near the front desk. 書店把那本舊旅行日記的再版擺在櫃檯旁。
This reedition includes extra notes that were not in the first printing. 這個再版收錄了第一版沒有的補充註記。
The riverbank looked reedless after the clearing work was finished. 清理工作做完後，河岸看起來沒有蘆葦了。
We expected a reedless stretch of shore, but the marsh was still dense. 我們原以為岸邊會是一段沒有蘆葦的地帶，但那片濕地仍然很茂密。
The artist painted the grass as a set of reedlike strokes. 那位畫家把草畫成一筆筆像蘆葦的線條。
A reedlike stem bent easily in the evening breeze. 傍晚的微風吹來，一根蘆葦狀的莖很容易就彎了。
A single reedling swayed at the water's edge. 水邊有一株小蘆葦輕輕搖晃著。
The gardener protected the reedlings until the marsh bed had settled. 園丁一直保護那些蘆葦幼芽，直到沼澤土床穩定下來。

meaning: 蘆葦製作者；簧片製作者
sentences: A reedmaker checks each piece by hand before it goes into a clarinet. 簧片製作者會先手工檢查每一片，再裝進單簧管裡。
The old village reedmaker was known for tools that lasted for decades. 那位老村裡的簧片工匠以工具耐用聞名，能用上幾十年。
Reedmaking takes patience, a sharp blade, and a good eye for detail. 製作簧片需要耐心、鋒利的刀，還有對細節的好眼力。
She learned reedmaking from her uncle, who taught her to split the cane evenly. 她跟叔叔學簧片製作，叔叔教她如何把蘆竹均勻劈開。
The reedman carried his bundle of cane back from the marsh. 那位蘆葦工人扛著一捆蘆竹從沼澤回來。
In the workshop, the reedman adjusted the thin strips until they matched. 在工坊裡，那位簧片製作者把細薄的片材調整到一致為止。
Birdwatchers waited quietly beside the reedplot at sunrise. 日出時，賞鳥人安靜地等在那片蘆葦地旁。
The map marks a reedplot just beyond the footpath. 地圖上在小徑外側標出了一塊蘆葦叢地。
The museum case held reedwork baskets woven by local families. 博物館展示櫃裡放著當地家庭編織的蘆葦製品籃子。
He admired the reedwork, especially the tight weaving around the rim. 他很欣賞那些蘆葦工藝品，特別是邊緣處織得很緊密。
The reedy bank hid the ducks until they suddenly flew out. 那片多蘆葦的河岸把鴨子都藏了起來，直到牠們突然飛出。
His voice had a reedy edge that carried across the room. 他的聲音帶著一點像蘆葦般尖細的質感，傳遍了整個房間。
The Great Barrier Reef is home to a wide variety of colorful corals and fish. 大堡礁是各式各樣彩色珊瑚和魚類的家園。
The ship was badly damaged after hitting a hidden reef near the coast. 船撞上岸邊的暗礁後嚴重受損。

meaning: 可形成礁的；適合礁化的
sentences: The engineers chose a reefable design to help marine life settle there. 工程師選擇了可形成礁的設計，好讓海洋生物在那裡棲息。
Only certain materials are reefable enough to survive the salt water. 只有某些材料夠適合礁化，能在鹽水裡撐得住。
He threw on a reefer before stepping out into the cold wind. 他在走進冷風裡之前，先披上一件厚短外套。
The cargo was loaded into a reefer to keep the fish fresh. 那批貨被裝進冷藏車裡，讓魚保持新鮮。
Reefing started as soon as the wind began to rise. 風一開始變強，船員就開始收帆。
The captain called for reefing before the storm reached the bay. 船長在風暴抵達海灣前下令縮帆。
The reefy coast looked beautiful but was dangerous for small boats. 那段礁岩密布的海岸很美，卻對小船很危險。
Divers avoided the reefy channel when the tide turned. 潮水轉向時，潛水員避開了那條多礁的水道。
A reek of smoke hung in the hallway after the power outage. 停電之後，走廊裡瀰漫著一股煙味。
The reek from the trash bins made everyone hurry past. 垃圾桶傳出的臭味讓大家都快步走過去。

meaning: 發臭的東西；散發強烈氣味的人或物
sentences: The old fish box was such a reeker that nobody wanted to open it. 那個舊魚箱臭得不得了，沒人想打開它。
He jokingly called his gym shoes a reeker after the long run. 長跑之後，他開玩笑說自己的運動鞋簡直是個臭傢伙。

meaning: 充滿臭味地；明顯地發出惡臭地
sentences: The drain was reekingly bad after the storm flooded the basement. 暴雨淹過地下室後，那個排水孔臭得很明顯。
She opened the bag and found the leftovers reekingly stale. 她打開袋子，發現裡面的剩菜臭得過分又發酸。
The reeky towel should have been washed days ago. 那條發臭的毛巾早就該洗了。
After the rain, the alley turned reeky and hard to pass. 下雨後，巷子變得有臭味，走起來很不舒服。
He wound the fishing line onto the reel. 他把釣魚線繞在捲軸上。
The news left her reeling with shock. 這個消息讓她震驚得不知所措。
The fishing line is reelable, so it stores neatly in the case. 這條釣線是可捲起的，收進盒子裡很整齊。
We needed a reelable hose that would not tangle on the deck. 我們需要一條可收線的水管，才不會在甲板上打結。
He reeled in the kite line before the rain started. 他在下雨前把風箏線收了回來。
After hearing the news, she reeled slightly and had to sit down. 聽到消息後，她晃了一下，只好坐下來。

meaning: 卷線器；使人搖晃的人或物
sentences: The reeler on the boat was jammed with wet fishing line. 船上的卷線器被濕漉漉的釣線卡住了。
The sudden blow was a real reeler and left him dizzy for a moment. 那一下重擊真讓人頭暈，害他暫時站不穩。
He walked reelingly down the hall after skipping lunch. 他沒吃午餐，走廊上走得有些搖搖晃晃。
The crowd reacted reelingly to the sudden announcement. 那項突如其來的宣布讓人群一時間都暈頭轉向。

meaning: 一陣亂轉；混亂的翻滾或旋轉
sentences: The children laughed at the reelrall of the toy spinning across the floor. 孩子們看著玩具在地板上亂轉亂滾，都笑了起來。
His speech turned into a reelrall of half-finished ideas and sudden pauses. 他的演說變成一陣混亂的翻滾，盡是沒講完的想法和突然停頓。
The mechanic had to reem the opening before the new bolt would fit. 機械師必須先把孔擴大，新螺栓才裝得進去。
He used a file to reem the hole just enough for the screw head. 他用銼刀把孔稍微磨大，好讓螺絲頭塞得進去。
The reeming took longer than expected because the metal was hard. 因為金屬很硬，擴孔花的時間比預期還久。
A careful reeming can make the final fit much cleaner. 小心地再磨孔，最後的配合會整齊得多。

meaning: 略帶擴孔意味的；有點像 reem 的
sentences: The hole had a reemish edge, rough but still usable. 那個孔的邊緣帶點 reemish 的感覺，粗糙但還能用。
His explanation was reemish enough to suggest a quick fix rather than a perfect one. 他的說法有點像臨時擴孔那樣，只能看出是權宜之計，不算完美。
She tied the tag to a small reen so it would not slip off. 她把吊牌綁在一個小繩圈上，免得掉下來。
The belt had a reen stitched near the buckle for extra support. 皮帶在扣環附近縫了一個小環來加強固定。
The rumor could reenge old suspicions if someone repeated it carelessly. 如果有人不小心又傳一次，這個謠言可能會再次挑起舊疑心。
He refused to reenge the feud by bringing up the argument again. 他拒絕再把那場爭執提起來，免得重新煽動仇怨。

meaning: 攀爬者；匍匐生長的植物
sentences: The ivy acted like a reeper, climbing slowly across the wall. 那株常春藤像攀爬者一樣，慢慢爬滿牆面。
In the garden, the reeper wrapped around the fence and softened its sharp lines. 在花園裡，那種匍匐植物纏上了圍欄，讓生硬的線條變柔和了。
Rees signed the visitor log and left before the meeting started. 里斯在會議開始前簽了訪客簿就離開了。
Her laptop case had the name Rees stitched on the corner. 她的筆電包角落繡著 Rees 這個名字。
Reese waited by the door. 他在門邊等待。
The letter was addressed to Reese. 那封信是寄給那個人的。
The children reeshled in the hallway so the librarian would not notice them. 孩子們在走廊裡低聲嘀咕，好讓圖書館員別注意到他們。
He reeshled an apology as he handed back the broken cup. 他把破掉的杯子遞回去時，低聲說了句道歉。

meaning: 重新冒險；再度承擔風險
sentences: I would not reesk that shortcut after the road washed out last week. 上週那條路被沖毀後，我不會再冒險走那條捷徑。
She reesked her savings on a tiny shop, and the gamble paid off. 她把積蓄再度投進一家小店，結果這場冒險真的值得。

meaning: 輕輕安定；慢慢放鬆下來
sentences: The crowd reesled after the lights dimmed and the music softened. 燈光變暗、音樂放柔之後，人群慢慢安靜放鬆下來。
He reesled into the armchair with a long sigh. 他長長吐了一口氣，慢慢窩進扶手椅裡。
We had to reest before climbing the last hill. 在爬最後一段山坡前，我們得先再休息一下。
The coach told the team to reest and drink water before practice resumed. 教練要全隊先休息、補充水分，再繼續訓練。
They found a shaded reester beside the trail and ate lunch there. 他們在步道旁找到一處陰涼的休息點，就在那裡吃午餐。
The old station still serves as a reester for hikers and cyclists. 那座老車站如今仍是登山客和騎士的短暫停靠點。
The paper bags reestled in the wind outside the bakery. 麵包店外的紙袋在風中沙沙作響。
She reestled the curtains so they would hang straighter. 她輕輕整理窗簾，讓它垂得更直。
After a long nap, the baby looked warm and reesty. 午睡一大覺後，寶寶看起來又暖和又很有精神。
His reesty voice made the whole room feel calmer. 他那種放鬆的嗓音讓整個房間都安靜下來。
The neighbors reeted us at the gate with tea and fruit. 鄰居們在大門口端著茶和水果來迎接我們。
When the plane landed, the family reeted him with a hug that lasted far too long. 飛機一落地，家人就用一個長到不像話的擁抱來迎接他。
The project needed a reetam because two of the deadlines overlapped. 這個專案需要重新安排，因為有兩個期限撞在一起。
After the merger, the office went through a quiet reetam of its duties. 合併之後，辦公室悄悄重新調整了職責分工。
He reetled the chair closer to the window to catch the breeze. 他把椅子稍微挪向窗邊，好吹到一點風。
Please reetle the picture frame before the guests arrive. 客人到之前，請把相框再微調一下。

meaning: 里夫；古代地方官或監督者
sentences: The reeve settled disputes between farmers and kept the accounts for the village. 那位里夫負責調解農民糾紛，並管理村裡帳目。
In the story, the reeve was stern, but everyone trusted his judgment. 在這個故事裡，里夫雖然嚴厲，卻人人信服他的判斷。
The train line ended in Reeveland. 那條鐵路的終點是一座安靜的小鎮。
She said Reeveland felt calm and distant. 她說這個地方給人平靜而遙遠的感覺。
He accepted the reeveship after the old official retired. 舊官員退休後，他接下了里夫這個職位。
The reeveship carried more paperwork than prestige. 這個里夫職位帶來的文書工作，比名聲還多。
I wrote the page number in the margin as a ref for later. 我把頁碼寫在頁邊，方便之後當作參考。
The editor asked for one more ref before approving the article. 編輯在核准文章前，又要求補上一個引用來源。
They decided to reface the cabinet instead of buying a new one. 他們決定把櫥櫃重新貼面，而不是買新的。
The builder had to reface the wall after the old tiles came loose. 舊磁磚鬆脫後，工人只好把那面牆重新整修外表。

meaning: 再次促進；重新協助推動
sentences: The mediator stepped in to refacilitate the conversation after tempers cooled. 情緒降下來之後，調解人介入重新促進對話。
A short call from the manager was enough to refacilitate the stalled plan. 經理打一通短電話，就足以把停滯的計畫重新推動起來。
The kite began to refall when the wind suddenly changed direction. 風向突然改變時，風箏又開始往下掉。
If the shelf keeps shaking, the books may refall onto the floor. 如果那層架子一直晃，書可能又會掉回地板上。

meaning: 重新休耕；再讓土地休息
sentences: Farmers may refallow the field to let the soil recover after a heavy season. 農夫可能會重新讓田地休耕，好讓土壤在密集耕作後恢復。
The hillside was refallowed for a year, and wildflowers returned quickly. 那片山坡重新休耕一年後，野花很快又回來了。
She used a magazine to refan the charcoal before grilling the vegetables. 她用雜誌重新扇旺木炭，好烤蔬菜。
The rumor only got louder when the blog tried to refan it. 那則謠言被部落格再度煽動後，聲勢反而更大了。
That old map can still refascinate me for hours. 那張老地圖仍然能讓我看上好幾個小時都著迷。
A good teacher can refascinate students who think they are already bored. 一位好老師能讓自以為已經無聊透頂的學生重新著迷。
Her refascination with astronomy started after one clear night in the desert. 她對天文的重新著迷，始於沙漠裡一個晴朗的夜晚。
The documentary sparked a refascination with old train stations. 那部紀錄片讓人們再次對老火車站產生興趣。

meaning: 重新設計；改造成新樣貌
sentences: He refashioned his speech to sound warmer and less defensive. 他把演講重新修飾得更溫暖，也少了防衛感。
The tailor refashioned an old coat into a short jacket. 裁縫把舊大衣重新改造成短外套。

meaning: 重新改造者；改版設計者
sentences: The refashioner turned thrift-store finds into polished office clothes. 那位重新改造者把二手店的舊衣物變成了俐落的上班服。
As a refashioner, she cared more about shape than labels. 身為重新改造者，她更在意版型，而不是品牌標籤。
The refashionment of the lobby made the building feel much newer. 大廳的重新改造讓整棟建築看起來年輕多了。
The dress kept its comfort, but the refashionment gave it a sharper silhouette. 那件洋裝保留了舒適度，但重新改造後線條更俐落了。
He stopped to refasten his backpack strap before running up the stairs. 他停下來把背包帶重新扣緊，才跑上樓梯。
Please refasten the lid so the soup does not spill. 請把蓋子再扣緊一點，免得湯灑出來。

meaning: 重新有父親般照顧的；再度受父輩引導的
sentences: After years of conflict, the boy finally felt refathered by the uncle who raised him. 經過多年衝突後，那男孩終於從撫養他的叔叔身上感受到再次被父親般照顧。
The novel describes a refathered hero who learns patience from a mentor. 那本小說描寫了一位再次得到父輩引導的英雄，從導師身上學會耐心。
Voters began to refavor the candidate after the debate went well. 辯論表現不錯後，選民開始再次支持那位候選人。
I have started to refavor tea over coffee in the morning. 我早上開始重新偏愛喝茶，而不是咖啡。

meaning: 使恢復活力；以食物或休息恢復
sentences: A bowl of soup was enough to refect him after the long hike. 一碗湯就足以讓他在長途健行後恢復體力。
The team paused to refect at the lodge before heading back out. 團隊在小屋停下來補充體力後，再繼續出發。
The monks gathered in silence for their evening refection. 修士們靜靜聚在一起，準備吃晚上的簡餐。
After the long hike, even a plain refection felt like a feast. 走完長途健行後，就算只是簡單的一餐也像盛宴一樣滿足。
The old monastery kept its refectionary rules strict and orderly. 那座老修道院的用餐規矩一直很嚴格而有條理。
A refectionary smell of soup and bread drifted from the kitchen. 廚房飄出一股像湯和麵包般的餐室氣味。
Each refectioner washed his hands before entering the dining hall. 每位用膳者進入餐廳前都先洗手。
The young refectioner was the last to leave the table, still finishing his tea. 那位年輕的用膳者最後才離開餐桌，還在慢慢喝茶。
Her refective pause made the whole conversation feel calmer. 她那段沉思般的停頓，讓整場對話都安靜了下來。
The glass had a refective surface that picked up every light in the room. 那面玻璃有種反光的表面，會把房間裡每一道光都映出來。

meaning: 餐室管理人；膳堂負責人
sentences: The refectorarian checked that enough bowls were ready before supper. 餐室管理人在晚餐前確認碗盤是否都準備好了。
As refectorarian, she kept the dining hall clean and calm even during winter rushes. 身為膳堂負責人，她即使在冬天最忙的時候也能把餐廳維持得整潔又安穩。
The refectorary windows looked out over the herb garden. 餐室的窗戶正對著藥草園。
We found a refectorary bench tucked beside the old chapel. 我們在舊禮拜堂旁邊找到一張像餐室用的長凳。

meaning: 用餐者；在餐室進食的人
sentences: Every refectorer waited until the bell rang before touching the food. 每位在餐室用餐的人都等鈴聲響了才碰食物。
The refectorer at the corner table was quietly reading a prayer card between bites. 角落那位用餐者一邊吃，一邊安靜地看著祈禱卡。
The building retained its refectorial arches even after the renovation. 這棟建築在翻修後仍保留著食堂式拱門。
A refectorial hush settled over the room when the teacher walked in. 老師走進來時，房裡立刻安靜得像食堂一樣。

meaning: 膳堂的；食堂相關的；膳堂工作者
sentences: The refectorian was responsible for arranging meals during the retreat. 這位膳堂工作者要安排退修期間的餐食。
He spoke like a refectorian who had spent years serving meals to quiet crowds. 他說話的樣子，就像一位多年替安靜人群端菜的膳堂工作者。
The students crowded into the refectory as soon as classes ended. 一下課，學生們就湧進食堂裡。
A single candle lit the refectory, making the long tables look ceremonial. 一支蠟燭照亮了膳堂，讓那些長桌看起來很有儀式感。
The two towns agreed to refederate after years of rivalry. 這兩個城鎮在多年競爭後同意重新結盟。
If the small clubs want more influence, they may need to refederate under one banner. 如果那些小社團想爭取更多影響力，或許得重新在同一旗幟下結盟。
The nurse told us not to refeed the patient too quickly after the fast. 護理師提醒我們，禁食後不要太快重新餵食病人。
I had to refeed the printer with paper before the report would finish. 我得先再把紙補進印表機，報告才印得完。
She could refeel the old excitement the moment the music started. 音樂一響起，她就再次感受到當年的興奮。
When I opened the box, I refelt the same ache I had felt years ago. 我打開盒子時，又重新感受到多年前那種痛楚。
He tried to refeign indifference, but his grin gave him away. 他想再次裝作無所謂，但嘴角的笑意早就出賣了他。
The actor had to refeign surprise for the second take. 那位演員在第二次拍攝時得再次裝作驚訝。
The editor wrote a short note to refel the rumor before it spread further. 編輯寫了一則簡短說明，駁斥那則謠言，以免它繼續擴散。
She could refel a bad argument with one sharp question. 她只要用一個尖銳的問題，就能駁倒糟糕的論點。

meaning: 重新圍籬；再以圍欄圍住
sentences: They had to refence the pasture after the storm tore down the fence. 暴風雨把圍欄吹倒後，他們只好把牧場重新圍起來。
The city plans to refence the garden so children can play safely inside. 市府計畫把花園重新圍上圍籬，讓孩子們能安全在裡面玩耍。
Please refer to the instruction manual if you have any questions about the machine. 如果你對這台機器有任何疑問，請參考（查閱）說明書。
The doctor decided to refer the patient to a specialist for further tests. 醫生決定將病人轉介給專科醫生進行進一步檢查。

meaning: 可歸因於某事的；可參照的
sentences: The delay was referable to a train strike, not to bad planning. 這次延誤可歸因於火車罷工，而不是規劃失當。
Several notes in the margin were referable to the chapter we had just read. 頁邊的幾則筆記都能對照到我們剛讀過的那一章。
The referee made several controversial decisions during the football match. 裁判在足球比賽中做出了幾項具爭議的判決。
She asked her former professor to act as a referee for her job application. 她請以前的教授擔任她求職申請的推薦人（介紹人）。
He made a brief reference to the incident during his speech but didn't go into detail. 他在演講中簡短地提到了（參考了）那次事件，但沒有詳述細節。
You will need to provide at least two professional references for your job application. 你的工作申請需要提供至少兩份專業推薦人（參考資料）。
The constitution allowed local referenda on school funding. 憲法允許地方就學校經費舉行公投。
Two referenda were held in the same year, and both drew strong public debate. 同一年舉行了兩次公投，兩次都引發激烈的公眾討論。

meaning: 公投的；與公民投票有關的
sentences: The committee studied the referendal question for weeks before making a recommendation. 委員會花了好幾週研究這個公投議題，才提出建議。
His speech turned referendal when he asked the crowd to vote on the proposal. 當他請群眾對提案投票時，演說就帶上了公投式的語氣。
The referendary announced the final count late that night. 那位公投官在當晚很晚才宣布最終票數。
As referendary, he had to keep the process fair and transparent. 身為公投官，他必須讓程序保持公平又透明。

meaning: 公投官職；公投官的職位
sentences: She accepted the referendaryship only after the council promised full support. 她是在議會承諾全力支援後，才接受這個公投官職。
His referendaryship was short, but it left a strong record of impartial work. 他的公投官任期雖短，卻留下了公正辦事的好紀錄。
The country held a national referendum to decide on the new policy. 該國舉行了全國公民投票來決定這項新政策。
The results of the referendum show a strong support for democratic principles. 公投結果顯示大眾對民主原則的強烈支持。
In linguistics, the word's referent is the actual thing it points to. 在語言學裡，詞語的所指是它實際指向的事物。
When he said 'that book,' the referent was clear to everyone in the room. 當他說「那本書」時，房間裡每個人都知道他指的是哪一本。

meaning: 參照的；提及的；指稱性的
sentences: Her joke was so referential that only longtime fans understood it. 她的笑話太多參照梗，只有老粉絲看得懂。
The article was carefully referential and included sources for every major claim. 那篇文章引用得很謹慎，幾乎每個重要說法都有來源。
The phrase works referentially, pointing back to an earlier line in the poem. 這個片語在指稱上是有作用的，它指回詩中的前一句。
He spoke referentially, as if every sentence depended on an old family story. 他說話總帶著參照意味，彷彿每句話都依附在某個老家族故事上。

meaning: 以指稱方式地；作為參照地
sentences: The teacher used the term referently, connecting it to a map on the wall. 老師以參照的方式使用這個詞，並把它和牆上的地圖連結起來。
In the novel, the name is used referently rather than literally. 在那部小說裡，這個名字是作為指涉來用，而不是字面上的意思。
The referment of the case to another office caused a long delay. 這個案件被轉交到另一個單位，因而拖了很久。
Her referment to the old letter changed the tone of the meeting. 她提到那封舊信後，整場會議的氣氛都變了。
The doctor gave her a referral to a specialist downtown. 醫生把她轉介給市區的一位專科醫師。
Thanks to a referral from a friend, he found the apartment before it was listed online. 多虧朋友介紹，他在房子上網刊登前就先找到了那間公寓。
The referrer asked for an update after the interview. 那位推薦人在面試後詢問了進度。
Each referrer received a thank-you message when the program ended. 活動結束時，每位介紹人都收到了一封感謝訊息。

meaning: 可轉介的；可歸屬的；可提及的
sentences: The complaint was referrible to the customer service team, not to accounting. 這起投訴應轉給客服團隊處理，不是會計部門。
His nickname was referrible to a joke he had made years earlier. 他的綽號可以追溯到他多年前開的一個玩笑。

meaning: 可轉介性；可歸屬性；可提及性
sentences: The referribleness of the issue mattered more than the wording of the report. 這個問題是否能被轉介處理，比報告用詞更重要。
We discussed the referribleness of the claim before deciding whom to contact. 在決定要聯絡誰之前，我們先討論了這項主張是否有可轉介性。
The farmer used refertilization to bring the tired field back to life. 那位農夫透過再次施肥，讓疲乏的田地重新恢復生氣。
After the first harvest, the garden needed refertilization before the next planting season. 第一輪收成後，花園在下一個種植季前需要再次施肥。
They decided to refertilize the soil instead of replacing it. 他們決定再次為土壤施肥，而不是直接換土。
If the lawn starts to look pale, we should refertilize it in early spring. 如果草坪開始發白，我們應該在初春再施一次肥。
The app had to refetch the data after the connection came back. 連線恢復後，應用程式必須重新抓取資料。
Could you refetch the book from the shelf? I left my notes inside it. 你可以再去把那本書從書架上拿來嗎？我的筆記夾在裡面。

meaning: to fight again or fight over again
sentences: The two cousins refused to refight the argument at dinner. 那兩位表親在晚餐時不願把爭執重新吵一遍。
Historians often say that nations should not refight old wars in their minds. 歷史學家常說，國家不該在心裡把舊戰爭再打一遍。

meaning: to figure out or calculate again
sentences: I had to refigure the budget after the rent went up. 房租漲了之後，我只好重新計算預算。
She refigured the route on paper and found a faster way home. 她在紙上重新推算路線，結果找到一條更快的回家路。

meaning: 用於補充或替換某物的東西。以優惠的價格提供額外的食物或飲料。
sentences: Today it is $2 for a coffee, with free refills throughout the day. 現在一杯咖啡的價格為 2 美元，全天免費續杯。
Tank's empty. We need to go for a refill. 水箱空了。我們需要去補充一下。
This bottle is refillable, so we do not need to buy plastic ones every week. 這個瓶子可以重複裝填，所以我們不用每週都買塑膠瓶。
She prefers refillable pens because they last longer and waste less. 她比較喜歡可重填的筆，因為比較耐用，也比較不浪費。
The director asked them to refilm the ending with softer lighting. 導演要求他們把結局重拍一次，並把燈光調柔和些。
We may need to refilm the interview because the microphone failed halfway through. 我們可能得把訪談重拍，因為麥克風錄到一半就出問題了。
The chef chose to refilter the broth so it would look perfectly clear. 廚師決定把高湯再過濾一次，讓它看起來更加清澈。
At work, the search tool sometimes has to refilter results when new tags are added. 在工作中，搜尋工具有時在加入新標籤後，得重新篩選結果。

meaning: able to be improved or made more precise
sentences: Her draft was already strong, but still refinable. 她的草稿已經不錯，但仍有可以再打磨的空間。
The design is refinable, so we can keep adjusting it after the first test. 這個設計還能再改進，所以我們可以在第一次測試後繼續調整。

meaning: the process of refining or being refined
sentences: The article described the refinage of crude sugar into a brighter, cleaner product. 那篇文章描述了粗糖被精煉成更白、更乾淨成品的過程。
In old industrial texts, refinage appears as a technical term for the refining process. 在古老的工業文本中，refinage 是指精煉流程的技術用語。

meaning: to replace a loan with a new one, usually on better terms
sentences: They refinanced their mortgage to lower the monthly payment. 他們重新辦理房貸，讓每月還款金額降低。
It made sense to refinance after interest rates dropped. 利率下降後，重新融資就變得很合理。
I had to refind the file after moving it into a different folder. 我把檔案移到別的資料夾後，只好再找一次。
She smiled when she managed to refind the old cafe from her childhood. 當她終於再次找到童年時去過的那家老咖啡館時，忍不住笑了。
Oil is refined into gasoline at the refinery. 原油在煉油廠被提煉成汽油。
He spent years trying to refine his technique. 他花了多年時間試圖完善自己的技術。
The company is looking for ways to refine its manufacturing process. 公司正在尋找精鍊（改善）其生產流程的方法。
The painting shows a high level of artistic refinement and detail. 這幅畫展現了極高的藝術修養（優雅）和細節處理。

meaning: 精確，沒有不精確，特別是： 睿智，有時過於微妙或假裝睿智。微妙、謹慎、深思熟慮。
sentences: The argument, while not persuasive, is quite refined. 這個論點雖然沒有說服力，但相當精煉。
The curriculum has been carefully refined to meet the needs of foreign students. 課程經過精心完善，以滿足外國學生的需求。

meaning: in a polished, elegant, or cultured manner
sentences: He spoke refinedly, as if every word had been polished first. 他說話很講究，彷彿每個字都先打磨過。
The room was decorated refinedly, with quiet colors and simple art. 那個房間布置得很雅致，色調安靜，藝術品也很簡約。

meaning: the quality of being refined, elegant, or polished
sentences: There was a calm refinedness in the way she handled the meeting. 她主持會議的方式帶著一種沉穩的雅緻。
The refinedness of the meal came from its balance, not from expensive ingredients. 這道餐點的精緻感來自平衡，而不是昂貴食材。

meaning: 精煉；提純；去除雜質的過程
sentences: The refinement of the metal removed the last impurities. 金屬的精煉去除了最後的雜質。
Further refinement improved the sample's purity. 進一步提純提高了樣本的純度。

meaning: a person or thing that refines something
sentences: The gold refiner checked the metal for tiny impurities. 那位黃金精煉師檢查金屬中細微的雜質。
Good editors are refiners of thought as much as of language. 好的編輯不只是在修文字，也是在打磨想法。
The refinery turns crude oil into fuel. 那座精煉廠把原油轉成燃料。
A new refinery was built near the port. 港口附近新建了一座精煉廠。

meaning: to handle or touch again with the fingers
sentences: He refingered the guitar chord until the notes rang clearly. 他重新調整手指按法，直到和弦清楚響亮。
The child kept refingering the coin in his pocket while waiting in line. 那孩子排隊時一直用手指反覆摸著口袋裡的硬幣。

meaning: the process of making something purer, better, or more precise
sentences: Refining takes time, whether you are polishing metal or improving a story. 無論是打磨金屬還是改進故事，精煉都需要時間。
The refining of the recipe made the sauce smoother and less salty. 這份食譜經過調整後，醬汁變得更滑順，也沒那麼鹹。

meaning: in a manner that makes something more refined
sentences: She spoke refiningly, trimming away extra words until the idea was sharp. 她說話時很有修整感，把多餘的字刪掉，讓想法變得更精準。
The architect worked refiningly on the plan, adjusting each line with care. 那位建築師細心地修整設計圖，把每一條線都調整到位。

meaning: to finish again, especially by restoring a surface
sentences: We decided to refinish the old table instead of throwing it away. 我們決定重新上漆那張舊桌子，而不是直接丟掉。
After years of use, the floor needed to be refinished to bring back its shine. 使用多年後，地板需要重新整修，才能恢復光澤。

meaning: to fire again or restart a firing process
sentences: The oven had to refire before the ceramics could be glazed. 陶器上釉之前，窯爐必須再次加熱燒製。
In basketball, the coach told him to refire the shot with more confidence. 在籃球訓練中，教練要他帶著更大的信心再投一次。

meaning: to fit again, repair, or equip anew
sentences: The ship will refit in port before its next voyage. 那艘船會先在港口整修，然後再出航。
After the surgery, she needed new shoes to refit her changed posture. 手術後，她需要新鞋來配合自己改變的姿勢。

meaning: the act of refitting or the state of being refitted
sentences: The refitment of the apartment included new shelves and better lighting. 這間公寓的重新整修包括新層架和更好的照明。
Engineers planned the refitment of the train carriage during the holiday break. 工程人員安排在假期進行列車車廂的整修。
I had to refix the button after it fell off my coat. 外套上的鈕扣掉了，我只好再縫回去。
The technician refixed the cable so the monitor would stop flickering. 技術人員把線重新接好，讓螢幕不再閃爍。
The refixation of the sign saved it from blowing away in the wind. 標誌被重新固定後，才沒有被風吹走。
During the repair, the refixation of the handle took only a few minutes. 維修時，手把重新固定只花了幾分鐘。

meaning: something fixed again, or the act of refitting a fixture
sentences: The refixture of the lamp made the hallway feel safer at night. 燈具重新安裝後，走廊在夜裡感覺更安全了。
A careful refixture of the shelf prevented it from tilting. 仔細把層架重新固定後，它就不再歪斜。

meaning: to flag again, or to register a ship under a different flag
sentences: The shipping company decided to reflag the vessel for tax reasons. 那家航運公司因稅務考量，決定把船隻改掛其他旗幟。
When the alarm appeared again, the system would reflag the message for review. 當警示再次出現時，系統會把訊息重新標記以供審查。

meaning: to flog or whip again; to punish again
sentences: The historian noted that some old regimes would reflagellate dissenters to scare the crowd. 那位歷史學家提到，有些舊政權會再次鞭打異議者來嚇唬群眾。
The word is rare today, but it can describe the cruel act of punishing someone again by whipping. 這個字今天很少見，但可以描述以鞭打方式再次懲罰某人的殘酷行為。
The campfire began to reflame when the wind brought in fresh air. 營火在風帶來新鮮空氣時，又重新燃旺了。
Their old argument seemed dead, but one sentence made it reflame. 他們原本像是吵完了，但一句話又把爭執重新點燃。

meaning: to flash again or update software by flashing it again
sentences: The mechanic had to reflash the car's computer after the update failed. 更新失敗後，技師只好重新刷寫汽車電腦。
The lighthouse seemed to reflash across the fog every few seconds. 燈塔每隔幾秒就在霧中再次閃現。
He used the pump to reflate the soccer ball before practice. 他用打氣筒在練習前把足球重新打氣。
After the tire was patched, we had to reflate it to the right pressure. 補胎之後，我們得把輪胎重新打到正確胎壓。

meaning: 通貨再膨脹；讓經濟與物價回升的政策
sentences: The central bank hinted at reflation to pull the economy out of its slump. 中央銀行暗示會推動通貨再膨脹，好讓經濟走出低迷。
Investors began pricing in reflation after wages and spending picked up. 在薪資和消費回升後，投資人開始把通貨再膨脹納入考量。

meaning: 通貨再膨脹主義；主張以擴張貨幣刺激經濟的觀點
sentences: His speech sounded like reflationism, with its promise to flood the market with easier money. 他的演說聽起來很像通貨再膨脹主義，承諾要用更寬鬆的資金灌進市場。
The committee remained split over whether reflationism would revive growth or simply raise prices. 委員會對於通貨再膨脹主義究竟能振興成長，還是只會推高物價，始終意見分歧。
The calm surface of the lake reflected the surrounding mountains perfectly. 平靜的湖面完美地倒映（反射）出周圍的山巒。
After the project finished, we took some time to reflect on what we had learned. 專案結束後，我們花了一些時間來反思（思考）我們學到了什麼。

meaning: 反射率；表面反射光線的比例
sentences: The engineer checked the panel's reflectance before approving it for the roof. 工程師在核准它用於屋頂前，先檢查了面板的反射率。
A fresh coat of white paint can raise reflectance and keep a room cooler. 一層新的白漆可以提高反射率，讓房間更涼爽。

meaning: 彎曲或發回（尤其是入射的聲音或光）。
sentences: reflected light or reflected heat 反射光或反射熱
The report describes the result as reflected. 該報告描述了所反映的結果。

meaning: 反射地；經由反射地；經思考後地
sentences: The lamp's glow reached the hallway reflectedly from the polished wall. 燈光經由拋光牆面反射地照進了走廊。
She answered reflectedly, choosing her words only after a long pause. 她思索後才回答，停了很久才選定用字。
The reflectedness of the image made it hard to tell where the window ended. 影像的反射狀態讓人很難分辨窗戶到底在哪裡結束。
Scientists measured the reflectedness of the surface under different angles. 科學家測量了該表面在不同角度下的反射狀態。

meaning: 反射的；可反射的；反光的
sentences: The reflectent surface flashed whenever the train headlights passed. 列車頭燈經過時，那個反光表面就會一閃一閃。
A reflectent coating was added to make the instrument easier to read. 後來又加上一層可反射的塗層，讓儀器更容易讀值。

meaning: 反射器；反光裝置；反光的人
sentences: The bicycle light has a small reflecter that helps drivers notice it at night. 這台腳踏車的燈上有一個小反射器，能讓駕駛人在夜裡更容易注意到它。
He used the shiny tray as a makeshift reflecter to brighten the corner. 他把那個亮面托盤當成臨時反射器，來照亮角落。

meaning: 可反射性；能被反射的特性
sentences: The reflectibility of the foil made it useful in the experiment. 那層箔片的可反射性，讓它很適合用在實驗裡。
Low reflectibility is one reason the coating reduces glare so well. 低可反射性正是這種塗層能有效減少眩光的原因之一。

meaning: 可反射的；能反射光線的
sentences: The film is thin but still reflectible enough to show a faint image. 這層薄膜雖然很薄，卻仍然具有足夠的可反射性來呈現淡淡的影像。
He chose a reflectible layer so the sensor could read the signal clearly. 他選了可反射的那一層，好讓感測器能清楚讀取訊號。
The reflecting water turned the sunset into a second sky. 那片會反光的水面把夕陽變成了另一片天空。
She sat by the window, reflecting on the decision she had to make. 她坐在窗邊，沉思著自己必須做出的決定。
He stared at the table reflectingly before giving his answer. 他在回答前，先若有所思地盯著桌面。
The essay was written reflectingly, with every claim carefully weighed. 那篇文章寫得很有反思感，每個論點都經過仔細衡量。
She stared at her own reflection in the mirror for a long time. 她對著鏡子裡自己的影像（倒影）凝視了良久。
The survey results are a clear reflection of public opinion on the new policy. 調查結果清楚地反映（體現）了大眾對新政策的意見。
The reflectional pattern on the glass made the storefront look deeper than it was. 玻璃上的反射圖樣讓店面看起來比實際更有深度。
She gave a reflectional account of the incident, not just a quick summary. 她用帶有反思意味的方式描述那件事，而不只是草草摘要。

meaning: 反思論者；重視反思哲學的人
sentences: The reflectionist argued that careful self-examination should come before any judgment. 那位反思論者主張，在做出任何判斷前都應先仔細自我檢視。
As a reflectionist, she loved books that turned ordinary moments into questions. 她身為一位重視反思的人，特別喜歡把平凡時刻變成問題意識的書。
The new display screen was almost reflectionless, even under bright lights. 新螢幕幾乎不反光，就算在強光下也一樣。
A reflectionless surface can make scientific measurements far more reliable. 不反光的表面能讓科學測量可靠得多。
The moon's reflective light illuminated the calm surface of the lake. 月亮的反射光照亮了平靜的湖面。
She was in a reflective mood, pondering her future plans and dreams. 她正處於沈思的心境中，思索著未來的計畫與夢想。
He smiled reflectively, as if the answer had taken shape slowly in his mind. 他若有所思地笑了，彷彿答案在腦中慢慢成形。
The surface shimmered reflectively in the afternoon sun. 那個表面在午後陽光下反光閃爍。

meaning: 反思性；沉思氣質；反光性
sentences: Her reflectiveness showed up in the way she asked careful follow-up questions. 她那種沉思氣質，從她總是謹慎追問後續問題就看得出來。
The reflectiveness of the metal helped the camera pick up the shape of the room. 金屬的反光性幫助相機捕捉到房間的輪廓。
Snow has high reflectivity, which is why it can be painful to look at on a sunny day. 雪的反射率很高，所以晴天直視時會很刺眼。
The scientist compared the reflectivity of several coatings before choosing one. 科學家先比較了幾種塗層的反射率，再決定選哪一種。
The reflectometer gave a precise reading of the sample's surface. 反射計精確地讀出了樣本表面的數值。
In the lab, a reflectometer can reveal changes that the eye would miss. 在實驗室裡，反射率測定儀能看出肉眼忽略的變化。

meaning: 反射測量法；反射率測定技術
sentences: The team used reflectometry to inspect the coating without damaging it. 團隊用反射測量法檢查那層塗膜，而且不會破壞它。
Reflectometry is especially useful when the surface is too delicate to touch. 當表面太脆弱不適合碰觸時，反射率測定技術特別有用。
The road reflector caught my headlights long before I reached the bend. 道路反光器在我轉彎前很久就先把車燈反射回來了。
A good reflector can make a small stage feel much brighter. 一個好的反射器能讓小舞台看起來明亮許多。

meaning: 反射投影儀；早期投影裝置
sentences: The old reflectoscope is now kept in the museum's science gallery. 那台古老的反射投影儀如今收藏在博物館的科學展廳裡。
Before digital projectors, a reflectoscope could help teachers show images to a class. 在數位投影機出現之前，反射投影儀就能幫老師把影像展示給全班看。

meaning: 再次長出羽毛；再度成熟起來
sentences: The rescued bird needed time to refledge before it could be released. 那隻獲救的鳥需要時間重新長出羽翼，才能放回野外。
After the setback, the team slowly refledged and found its rhythm again. 經過那次挫折後，團隊慢慢重新站穩腳步，找回了節奏。
The reflee slipped through the side gate before anyone noticed. 那名逃離者趁沒人注意時從側門溜了出去。
In the story, the reflee keeps moving because stopping would mean capture. 在那個故事裡，逃走的人一直奔逃，因為一旦停下就會被抓住。

meaning: 反射或由反射產生的影像；光線從照明表面反射到陰影表面。
sentences: A reflex camera uses a mirror to reflect the image onto a ground-glass viewfinder. 反射相機使用鏡子將影像反射到磨砂玻璃觀景窗上。
The term reflex refers to a reflection or an image produced by a reflection; the light reflected from an illuminated surface to one in shade. 術語「反射」是指反射或由反射產生的影像；光線從照明表面反射到陰影表面。
The flower had reflexed petals that curled back around the center. 那朵花有向後彎曲的花瓣，往外翻捲著花心。
A reflexed leaf can look almost folded in on itself. 一片反折的葉子看起來幾乎像是自己向內摺起來。
The reflexibility of the petals made the arrangement look unusually elegant. 花瓣的可反折性，讓這個花藝作品顯得格外優雅。
Engineers tested the reflexibility of the material before using it in the hinge. 工程師先測試材料的可反折性，才把它用在鉸鏈上。
The young leaves were still flexible enough to be reflexible after the storm. 年輕的葉子仍然很柔軟，風雨過後還能向後折轉。
In older texts, reflexible often described something that could bend or be turned back. 在較舊的文本裡，reflexible 常用來形容能彎回或折回的東西。

meaning: 反射論；只把行為研究限於反射的傾向
sentences: The article criticized reflexism for ignoring thought, emotion, and context. 那篇文章批評反射論忽略了思考、情感與情境。
Researchers moved away from reflexism once they began studying motivation more seriously. 當研究者開始更認真地研究動機後，就逐漸不再只看反射論。

meaning: 屬於反射或由反射引起的。
sentences: The electric shock elicited an automatic and reflexive response from him. 電擊引起了他本能的、條件反射的反應。
The report describes the result as reflexive. 該報告將這一結果描述為反射性的。

meaning: 反射性地；本能地；不假思索地
sentences: I reflexively reached for my phone when the notification sounded. 通知一響，我就本能地伸手去拿手機。
She reflexively ducked when the ball flew toward her face. 球朝她臉上飛來時，她反射性地低頭閃避。

meaning: 反射性；本能反應的特質
sentences: The reflexiveness of his response surprised even him. 他的反射性反應連他自己都嚇了一跳。
The study looked at reflexiveness in both language and behavior. 這項研究同時探討了語言與行為中的反射性。

meaning: 自反性；反射性；自我關聯的性質
sentences: The professor explained reflexivity as the idea that a system can act on itself. 教授把自反性解釋為系統能作用於自身的概念。
In grammar, reflexivity shows up when an action points back to the subject. 在文法裡，當動作回指主詞時，就會出現自反性。

meaning: 反射地；出於本能反應地
sentences: She reflexly reached for the handrail when the bus lurched. 公車一晃時，她本能地伸手去抓扶手。
He reflexly said yes before he had time to think. 他還來不及思考，就本能地先答應了。
His reflexness kicked in and he caught the falling glass. 他的反射性一上來，就接住了快掉下來的玻璃杯。
The coach liked the player's reflexness more than his raw strength. 教練比起單純的力氣，更欣賞那名球員的反應速度。

meaning: 引發反射的；誘發反應的
sentences: The doctor described the stimulus as reflexogenous because it triggered a quick response. 醫師把那個刺激描述為會引發反射，因為它會迅速引起反應。
The article said the reflexogenous signal could change the body's automatic reactions. 文章說這種刺激訊號可能改變身體的自動反應。
She took a reflexological course to learn pressure points on the feet. 她去上反射療法課，學習腳底的穴位。
The brochure promised reflexological relief for tired travelers. 這本宣傳手冊宣稱，反射療法能讓疲憊的旅人放鬆。
A reflexologist massaged his feet and talked him through the session. 一位反射療法師替他按摩雙腳，並在過程中陪他放鬆。
My aunt visits a reflexologist whenever her schedule gets too packed. 我阿姨只要行程太滿，就會去找反射療法師。
She books reflexology appointments after long weeks on her feet. 她在長時間站立工作後，會預約反射療法。
The spa offered reflexology as part of its evening package. 那家 SPA 把反射療法列入晚間方案。

meaning: 反射的簡寫；罕見縮略形
sentences: The old glossary used refling as a shorthand for reflex. 舊詞彙表把這個詞當作反射的簡寫。
In modern writing, refling is so obscure that most editors would replace it. 在現代寫作裡，這個詞太冷僻了，大多數編輯都會把它換掉。

meaning: 使重新浮起；讓再次浮上水面
sentences: Workers had to refloat the barge after the tide came in. 潮水漲上來後，工人們必須把那艘駁船重新弄浮起來。
The rescue team tried to refloat the stranded boat before nightfall. 救援隊想在天黑前把擱淺的船重新浮起來。
The refloatation of the cargo ship took two tugboats and a lot of patience. 那艘貨船的重新浮起作業動用了兩艘拖船，還花了不少耐心。
After the storm, engineers planned the refloatation carefully to avoid more damage. 暴風雨過後，工程師仔細規劃重新浮起的程序，以免造成更多損害。
The reflog saved me after I accidentally reset the branch. 我不小心重設分支之後，是引用日誌救了我。
By checking the reflog, she found the commit that had seemed lost. 她查看引用日誌後，找回了那個看似遺失的提交。
Heavy rain can reflood the road even after crews have cleared it once. 大雨會讓道路在搶通後再次淹水。
The technician had to reflood the tank before starting the test. 技術人員在開始測試前，得先把槽體重新注水。
We decided to refloor the kitchen instead of patching the old tiles. 我們決定把廚房重新鋪地板，而不是修補舊磁磚。
The landlord promised to refloor the apartment before the next tenant moved in. 房東答應在下一位房客入住前，把公寓重新鋪地板。
The reflorescence of the cherry trees made the park look new again. 櫻花樹再次開花，讓公園看起來煥然一新。
Gardeners watched for a late reflorescence after the cool spell passed. 天氣轉涼後，園丁們留意著晚些時候是否會再度開花。

meaning: 再次開花的；再度盛開的
sentences: The reflorescent vines climbed over the fence by midsummer. 到了盛夏，那些再次開花的藤蔓已經爬滿了圍欄。
We marked the reflorescent shrubs so we could trim them later. 我們把再次開花的灌木標記起來，好之後再修剪。
The neighborhood began to reflourish after the train station reopened. 火車站重新啟用後，那個社區開始再度興盛。
Small bookstores can reflourish when local readers keep showing up. 當地讀者持續捧場時，小書店就有機會重新繁榮起來。
The city's reflourishment was visible in the crowded markets and new cafes. 從擁擠的市集和新開的咖啡館，就看得出這座城市正在重新繁榮。
Economists tracked the reflourishment of the port after the trade route recovered. 貿易路線恢復後，經濟學家追蹤那個港口的再度興盛情況。
The solder had to reflow properly or the circuit board would fail. 錫焊必須正確地重新熔流，不然電路板就會失敗。
After the blockage cleared, water began to reflow through the channel. 阻塞排除後，水又開始在渠道裡重新流動。
The roses usually reflower if you deadhead them early. 如果你及早剪掉殘花，玫瑰通常還會再次開花。
By autumn, the balcony plants had started to reflower in the cooler air. 到了秋天，陽台上的植物在涼爽的空氣中開始再次開花。
Market refluctuation made the forecast hard to trust. 市場再次波動，讓預測變得很難完全相信。
The engineers studied the refluctuation of pressure inside the pipe. 工程師研究了管道內壓力的回流波動。
The refluence of the tide filled the harbor with cold water. 潮水的回流讓港灣裡灌進冰冷的海水。
In older medical writing, refluence referred to a backward flow of fluid. 在較早期的醫學文獻裡，refluence 指的是液體向後回流。
The refluency of the river after the storm surprised everyone. 暴風雨過後，河水的回流狀態讓所有人都很驚訝。
He wrote about the refluency of time in a poem about memory. 他在一首關於記憶的詩裡寫到時間的回流感。
The refluent water left a line of mud along the bank. 回流的河水在河岸邊留下了一道泥痕。
His essay compared refluent emotions to waves coming back after a storm. 他的文章把回流般的情緒比作暴風雨後退回來的浪潮。
The nurse had to reflush the IV line before the medication could run smoothly. 護理師必須先把點滴管路再沖洗一次，藥水才能順利流動。
Please reflush the sink if the drain still smells after cleaning. 如果水槽清完還是有味道，請再沖洗一次排水口。
Acid reflux kept him awake after a heavy dinner. 晚餐吃太飽後，胃酸逆流讓他睡不著。
The lab measured the reflux of steam inside the sealed chamber. 實驗室測量了密閉腔體內蒸氣的回流情況。
The refluxed sample was kept separate from the fresh solution. 那個曾經逆流過的樣本被和新溶液分開存放。
She noted that the refluxed liquid looked darker than expected. 她注意到那份逆流過的液體顏色比預期更深。
The pilot had to refly the route after the weather changed. 天氣變化後，飛行員必須重新飛一次航線。
We may need to refly the drone mission if the footage is blurry. 如果畫面太模糊，我們可能得把無人機任務重飛一次。
A quiet lunch break helped refocillate the exhausted team. 安靜的午餐休息讓疲憊的團隊恢復了精神。
Her goal was to refocillate the patient with warm tea and a blanket. 她的目標是用熱茶和毯子讓病人重新暖和起來、恢復元氣。
After the long hike, a refocillation by the fire felt wonderful. 長途健行後，坐在火旁重新恢復精神的感覺真好。
The doctor recommended rest and refocillation before returning to work. 醫師建議先休息、恢復元氣，再回去工作。

meaning: 重新聚焦；重新集中注意力
sentences: I had to refocus after every notification on my phone. 每次手機跳出通知後，我都得重新把注意力拉回來。
The camera can refocus automatically when the subject moves. 主體移動時，相機可以自動重新對焦。
She had to refold the map after it slipped out of her pocket. 地圖從口袋滑出來後，她只好重新摺好。
Please refold the blanket neatly before you leave the room. 離開房間前，請把毯子重新整齊摺好。
He tried to refoment the dispute, but everyone was ready to move on. 他試圖再次挑起爭端，但大家都已準備向前看。
The article warned that careless rumors can refoment old tensions. 那篇文章警告說，輕率的謠言會重新挑起舊有緊張。
The foundry agreed to refont the broken bell into a new casting. 那家鑄造廠同意把破鐘重新熔鑄成新鑄件。
To refont the metal, workers first sorted out every contaminated piece. 為了重新熔鑄金屬，工人先把每一塊受污染的材料分開。
No one wanted to refool the voters with another empty promise. 沒有人想用另一個空洞承諾再次愚弄選民。
She said she would not let the salesman refool her a second time. 她說自己不會再讓那位推銷員第二次騙倒。

meaning: 重新裝上腳部；使再次站立或以腳支撐
sentences: The museum conservator had to refoot the damaged statue before the exhibit opened. 博物館修復師必須先替那尊受損雕像重新安上底座，展覽才能開放。
After the long illness, she worked hard to refoot herself and walk confidently again. 經歷長期病後，她努力讓自己重新站穩，再次自信地行走。
The committee voted to reforbid smoking near the station entrance. 委員會投票決定再次禁止在車站入口附近吸菸。
If the noise returns, the landlord may reforbid late-night gatherings. 如果噪音又出現，房東可能會重新禁止深夜聚會。
They decided to reforce the bridge before the rainy season arrived. 他們決定在雨季來臨前再次加固那座橋。
A good coach knows when to reforce a habit instead of criticizing it. 好教練知道何時該重新強化習慣，而不是一味批評。

meaning: 再次涉水而過；重新渡過淺水處
sentences: We had to reford the stream after the path on the east side washed out. 東側小徑被沖毀後，我們只好再次涉溪而過。
The guide refused to reford the river until the current slowed down. 向導堅持等到水流變慢後才肯再次過河。
The finance team had to reforecast revenue after the market shifted. 市場變動後，財務團隊不得不重新預測營收。
We reforecast the schedule every month so the client sees the latest plan. 我們每個月都會修正進度預估，讓客戶看到最新計畫。

meaning: 重新造林；使再度長滿森林
sentences: Volunteers returned each spring to reforest the burned hillside. 志工每年春天都回來替那片燒毀的山坡重新造林。
The region hopes to reforest the valley with native trees over the next decade. 那個地區希望在未來十年內用原生樹種讓山谷重新披上森林。
Reforestation after the wildfire became the town's top priority. 山火過後的重新造林成了鎮上的首要任務。
The company funded reforestation projects to offset part of its emissions. 那家公司資助重新造林計畫，以抵銷部分排放。

meaning: 重新造林化；讓土地恢復森林覆蓋的過程
sentences: The report described reforestization as a long-term strategy for restoring the watershed. 報告把重新造林化描述為恢復流域的長期策略。
Reforestization works best when local species are planted in the right season. 重新造林化若能在合適季節種植當地物種，效果最好。

meaning: 使重新森林化；重新造林
sentences: The village hopes to reforestize the dry slopes with help from the park service. 那個村莊希望在公園管理單位協助下，讓乾坡重新長出森林。

sentences: The ancient memo listed several reformandum items for the council to review. 那份古老備忘錄列出了多項待改革之事，供議會審查。

meaning: 與改革有關的；改革時期的
sentences: The speaker praised the town's reformationary spirit after the flood. 演講者稱讚那個城鎮在洪災後展現出的改革精神。

sentences: The reformationist argued that small steps would make the law fairer. 那位改革主義者主張，小幅調整就能讓法律更公平。

meaning: 改革性的；有改進作用的
sentences: The judge chose a reformative program instead of a harsher penalty. 法官選擇了具有改革性的方案，而不是更嚴厲的懲罰。
A reformative approach works best when people can see a path forward. 當人們看得到前進的方向時，改革性的做法最有效。

meaning: 以改革方式地；帶有改革意味地
sentences: The coach spoke reformatively after the loss, focusing on better habits instead of blame. 那位教練在輸球後以改革式的口吻說話，重點放在建立更好的習慣，而不是責備。

sentences: The reformatness of the scanned page made the headings jump around on my screen. 那張掃描頁面的格式重整狀態讓標題在我的螢幕上跳來跳去。

meaning: 女性改革者；女改革人士
sentences: The old newspaper article praised her as a reformeress who fought for cleaner streets. 那篇舊報導稱讚她是一位為乾淨街道奮鬥的女性改革者。

meaning: 以改革的方式地；帶著改良意味地
sentences: She reformingly rewrote the club rules after listening to the members' complaints. 她在聽完社員的抱怨後，以改革的方式重新改寫了社團規則。

meaning: 改革派人士；改革主義者

meaning: 改革主義的；偏向改革的
sentences: Her reformistic approach kept the school stable while still improving the rules. 她那種偏改革的做法讓學校在維持穩定的同時，也能慢慢改善規章。

sentences: The old bureaucracy seemed reformproof, surviving every new manager who tried to change it. 那套老官僚體系看起來幾乎不受改革影響，每位想改變它的新主管都撐不久。

The refracted image looked slightly doubled in the shallow water. 那個經過折射的影像在淺水裡看起來有點重影。

sentences: The lamp shone refractedly through the water bottle on the desk. 桌上的水瓶讓燈光以折射後的樣子散開。

meaning: 折射中的；使光線彎折的
sentences: The refracting window caught the afternoon sun and scattered it across the room. 那扇會折射光線的窗戶把午後陽光散開，灑滿整個房間。

The chart showed refractional differences between the two lenses. 那張圖表顯示了兩片鏡片之間的折射差異。
The technicians refractionate the light before measuring each wavelength. 技術人員先把光分段折射，再測量每個波長。
In the old lab notes, the beam was refractionated through several prisms. 在那份舊實驗筆記裡，光束曾經經過好幾個稜鏡被分段折射。

meaning: 研究折射的人；折射學家
sentences: The refractionist spent the morning comparing how different lenses bent the light. 那位折射學家花了整個上午比較不同透鏡如何彎折光線。
As a refractionist, she enjoyed explaining a complex optical effect in plain language. 身為折射學家，她很喜歡用淺白的語言解釋複雜的光學現象。
The crystal has a strong refractive quality that makes the edges shimmer. 這塊水晶具有很強的折光特性，讓邊緣看起來閃閃發亮。
Her glasses were designed with a refractive coating to reduce glare. 她的眼鏡加了折射塗層，好減少眩光。
The beam moved refractively through the layered glass panels. 那道光束以折射的方式穿過層層玻璃板。
The scene looked almost unreal because the water surface bent the image refractively. 因為水面以折射的方式扭曲了影像，整個畫面看起來幾乎不真實。
The refractiveness of the mineral made it useful in optical instruments. 這種礦物的折射性使它很適合用在光學儀器裡。
He was surprised by the refractiveness of the surface, which scattered the lamp light in every direction. 他對那表面的折光特性感到驚訝，因為它把燈光四散到各個方向。
Scientists measured the refractivity of the sample before publishing the results. 科學家在發表結果前，先測量了樣本的折射性。
A small change in refractivity can make a lens behave very differently. 折射性只要有一點點變化，就會讓透鏡表現大不相同。
She placed a drop of juice on the refractometer to check its sugar level. 她把一滴果汁滴在折射計上，檢查它的糖度。
The refractometer gave a precise reading, even for the cloudy sample. 即使是混濁的樣本，折射計也能給出精確讀值。
The lab report included a refractometric analysis of the liquid mixture. 那份實驗報告包含了液體混合物的折射測量分析。
A refractometric test can reveal tiny differences that the eye would miss. 折射測量檢驗可以看出肉眼會忽略的細微差異。

meaning: 折射測量法；折射計量學
sentences: He studied refractometry so he could work in quality control for beverages. 他研習折射測量法，為的是到飲料品質管制部門工作。
Refractometry is especially helpful when a sample is too delicate for rough handling. 當樣本太脆弱、不能粗暴處理時，折射測量法特別有用。
The old refractor still gave a clear view of the moon. 那台老式折射望遠鏡看月亮時依然很清楚。
He carried the refractor to the roof and spent the evening stargazing. 他把折射望遠鏡搬到屋頂，整個晚上都在觀星。
The child stared refractorily at the teacher and refused to apologize. 那孩子倔強地瞪著老師，怎麼也不肯道歉。
The old horse moved refractorily until it recognized the handler's voice. 那匹老馬在聽出照料者的聲音前，始終不情不願地移動。
The refractoriness of the valve made the repair take much longer than expected. 那個閥門難以處理的特性，讓維修時間比預期長得多。
Her refractoriness showed up only when someone tried to rush her decisions. 只有在別人想催她做決定時，她的倔強才會明顯表現出來。

meaning: 倔強的；難處理的；耐火的
sentences: The mechanic was dealing with a refractory bolt that refused to turn. 那位機械師正對付一顆怎麼也轉不動的頑固螺栓。
The patient became refractory to the first treatment, so the doctor tried another approach. 病人對第一種治療反應不佳，所以醫生改用了另一種方法。
He was careful not to refracture the wrist during basketball practice. 他很小心，免得在籃球練習時讓手腕再次骨折。
A sudden slip on the stairs could refracture a bone that has not healed fully. 樓梯上要是一滑倒，還沒完全癒合的骨頭可能會再次折斷。
The lawyer pointed out the refragability of the witness's statement. 律師指出了那位證人證詞的可反駁性。
In a debate, refragability matters because no claim should be beyond question. 在辯論裡，說法是否可被反駁很重要，因為沒有哪個主張應該完全不能被質疑。
His argument sounded confident, but it was still refragable. 他的論點聽起來很有自信，但仍然是可以反駁的。
The professor reminded us that even a polished theory must remain refragable. 教授提醒我們，即使是很完整的理論也仍然應該保留可反駁性。
The refragableness of the claim became obvious once the data arrived. 一旦資料到手，那個主張的可反駁性就很明顯了。
He appreciated the refragableness of the proposal because it kept the discussion honest. 他欣賞這份提案的可反駁性，因為這能讓討論保持誠實。
To refrain means to show restraint; to hold oneself back. 克制意味著表現克制；阻止自己。
People may refrain in different situations depending on the context. 人們可能會根據具體情況在不同的情況下克制。

meaning: 使規範化；使合法化；使正常化
sentences: The company decided to regularize its hiring process after several complaints. 公司在接到幾次投訴後，決定把招聘流程規範化。

meaning: 規則性的；小王的；屬於規制的
