A relucent screen lit the room without needing the overhead lamp. 那個發光的螢幕在不開頂燈的情況下就照亮了房間。
She would reluct before answering the question. 她在回答問題前總會猶豫一下。
He relucted into the meeting only after his manager called twice. 直到主管打了兩次電話，他才勉強進了會議室。
Our new dog shows reluctance to go on walks, preferring to be indoors. 我們的新狗不願意散步，更喜歡待在室內。
The term reluctance refers to unwillingness to do something. 不情願這個字是指不願意做某件事。
His reluctancy was obvious when the plan changed at the last minute. 計畫臨時變動時，他的猶豫非常明顯。
She spoke with reluctancy, as if each word had to be chosen carefully. 她說話時帶著勉強的神情，彷彿每個字都得仔細挑選。
He was reluctant to admit that he had made a mistake in front of his colleagues. 他不情願在同事面前承認自己犯了錯。
She gave a reluctant smile when they asked her to perform on stage. 當他們要求她上台表演時，她露出了勉強的微笑。

meaning: 以不情願或猶豫的方式。
sentences: If someone acts reluctantly, they do so in a way that is in a reluctant or hesitant manner. 如果某人不情願地行事，他們會以不情願或猶豫的方式這樣做。
The speaker responded reluctantly during the discussion. 發言者在討論中勉強回答。

meaning: 猶豫地行動；不情願地接受
sentences: The intern reluctated to speak up in the crowded room. 那位實習生在擁擠的房間裡猶豫著不敢開口。
They reluctate when a decision feels rushed or unfair. 當決定顯得倉促或不公平時，他們就會猶豫不決。
There was reluctation in his voice when he agreed to the deadline. 他勉強同意期限時，聲音裡帶著猶豫。
The proposal met reluctation from people who wanted more time. 那項提案因為大家想要更多時間而遭到猶豫性的回應。

meaning: 磁阻率；對磁通的阻抗特性
sentences: Engineers measured the core's reluctivity before redesigning the coil. 工程師在重新設計線圈前，先量測了磁芯的磁阻率。
A lower reluctivity can make a magnetic circuit more efficient. 較低的磁阻率可以讓磁路更有效率。
They relume the lantern before the storm arrives. 他們在暴風雨來臨前把燈籠重新點亮。
The guide relumed the path with a small torch. 那位導遊用一支小手電筒重新照亮了小路。
The sunrise seemed to relumine the valley in a few slow minutes. 日出似乎在短短幾分鐘內再次照亮了山谷。
A single candle can relumine a dark hall better than people expect. 一支蠟燭往往比人們想像的更能重新照亮昏暗的長廊。
You can always rely on your best friends in times of need. 在需要的時候，妳總是可以依靠妳最好的朋友。
The success of the project relies on our teamwork and dedication. 專案的成功依賴於我們的團隊合作與奉獻。
She remade the dress with softer fabric. 她用更柔軟的布料重新製作了那件洋裝。
The chef remade the sauce after tasting it once. 主廚試過一次之後，又把醬汁重新做了一遍。
The lab studied remagnetization after the sample was heated. 樣本加熱後，實驗室研究了再磁化的情況。
Remagnetization can restore the strength of certain magnetic parts. 再磁化可以恢復某些磁性零件的強度。
You may need to remagnetize the tool after heavy use. 在重度使用後，你可能需要讓工具重新磁化。
The technician remagnetized the clasp so it would close firmly again. 技術人員把扣件重新磁化，讓它能再次牢牢扣上。
The microscope image was clearer after remagnification. 顯微鏡影像在再次放大後變得更清楚。
Remagnification helped the team inspect the tiny crack. 重新放大讓團隊能檢查那條細小的裂縫。
Please remagnify the photo so we can read the label. 請把照片再放大一點，好讓我們看清楚標籤。
The editor chose to remagnify the map before printing it. 編輯在印刷前決定把地圖重新放大。
Please remail the form with the missing signature. 請把少了簽名的表格重新寄送一次。
After the address changed, the office had to remail every invoice. 地址變更後，辦公室只好把每張發票都再寄一次。
It is important to remain calm and focused during an emergency. 在緊急情況下保持冷靜與專注是很重要的。
The mystery of the disappearance managed to remain unsolved. 消失之謎竟然（保持）懸而未決。
I'll finish the first part of the report now and do the remainder tonight. 我現在會完成報告的第一部分，今晚再做剩餘部分。
The teacher asked the students to solve the math problem and find the remainder. 老師要求學生解開這道數學題並算出餘數。

meaning: 剩餘財產受領人；餘留權人
sentences: The remainderman will receive the house after the life estate ends. 在終身產權結束後，剩餘財產受領人將取得那棟房子。

The family discussed how the remaindership would pass to the next generation. 這個家族討論了餘留權要如何傳給下一代。

meaning: 留下來的人；仍在場的人
sentences: He was the last remainer in the office after midnight. 午夜過後，他是辦公室裡最後還留下來的人。

To his great intellectual powers his published remains bear abundant witness. 他出版的遺著充分證明了他偉大的智力。
The term remains refers to The extant writings of a deceased person. 「遺骸」一詞是指死者現存的著作。
They remaintain the archive in a cool, dry room. 他們把檔案持續維持在陰涼乾燥的房間裡。

The remaker trimmed the footage into a tighter version. 這位重製者把影片剪成更精簡的版本。
Every remaker leaves a slightly different fingerprint on the final piece. 每位重新製作的人都會在成品上留下些微不同的風格。
He was the only reman on the platform after the last train left. 最後一班火車開走後，他是月台上唯一還留著的人。
The reman stayed behind to lock the building and switch off the lights. 那位留守者留下來鎖門並關掉燈。
The team had to remanage the schedule after two people quit. 有兩個人離職後，團隊只好重新安排行程。
She remanaged the budget so the trip would still be affordable. 她重新管理預算，讓這趟旅程仍然負擔得起。
The remanagement of the project took only two weeks. 那個專案的重新管理只花了兩週。
Good remanagement can rescue a plan that is drifting off course. 良好的重新管理可以挽救一個逐漸偏離方向的計畫。
The sensor detected remanation of heat after the machine shut down. 感測器偵測到機器關閉後仍有熱量再散發。
Scientists studied the remanation of energy from the cooled surface. 科學家研究冷卻表面的能量再發散現象。

meaning: 重新轉讓；再次釋放所有權
sentences: The heirs decided to remancipate the property to the trust. 繼承人決定把那筆財產重新轉讓給信託。

sentences: The contract referred to the remancipation of the estate. 合約提到了那筆遺產的重新轉讓。
Remancipation is a rare term, but the archive kept a clear record of it. 雖然 remancipation 是個罕見詞，檔案館仍保留了清楚的紀錄。

The remandment sent the file back to the lower court. 那道發回重審令把卷宗送回了下級法院。
Her lawyer explained the remandment before the hearing began. 庭訊開始前，她的律師先解釋了那份還押命令。
The metal kept some remanence even after the field was removed. 即使磁場移除後，那塊金屬仍保留一些剩磁。

The material's remanency was tested at different temperatures. 這種材料的剩磁性在不同溫度下都接受了測試。
High remanency can be useful in small magnetic components. 高剩磁性在小型磁性元件中可能很有用。
The remanent heat made the cup warm long after breakfast. 早餐結束很久後，那殘留的熱度仍讓杯子溫溫的。
Researchers examined the remanent signal after the test ended. 研究人員在測試結束後檢查了殘留訊號。
One remanet from the old inventory was still in the drawer. 舊庫存裡有一件遺留物還在抽屜裡。
The museum labeled the remanet so future staff would know its origin. 博物館替那件剩件貼上標籤，讓未來的工作人員知道它的來源。
The editor had to remanipulate the audio to remove the hiss. 編輯只好重新調整音訊，去掉嘶聲。
Some people tried to remanipulate the vote after the results were posted. 結果公布後，有些人試圖再次操弄選票。
The report warned against any remanipulation of the data. 報告警告不要對資料進行任何再次操弄。
A careful remanipulation of the image brought back the missing details. 對影像仔細重新調整後，缺失的細節又回來了。
We remantled the gear in waterproof cloth before the hike. 登山前，我們把裝備重新包覆上防水布。
The crew remantled the device after testing to protect the wires. 團隊在測試後重新拆裝並包覆那台裝置，好保護裡面的線路。
The company decided to remanufacture the part instead of replacing the whole unit. 公司決定將零件再製造，而不是整台更換。
They remanufacture used bottles into sturdy new containers. 他們把用過的瓶子再製造成堅固的新容器。
The farmer planned to remanure the field after harvest. 農夫打算在收割後再次為田地施肥。
If the soil looks tired, it may need to be remanured carefully. 如果土壤看起來很疲乏，就可能需要謹慎地再次施肥。

meaning: 重新對應；重新規劃地圖
sentences: We need to remap the keyboard shortcuts for the new workflow. 我們需要為新的工作流程重新對應鍵盤快捷鍵。
The city will remap the bike lanes after the road project ends. 這座城市會在道路工程結束後重新規劃自行車道。
At dawn, the soldiers remarch toward the northern ridge. 黎明時分，士兵們再次朝北邊山脊行軍。
The parade will remarch through the square next spring. 明年春天，遊行隊伍會再次穿過廣場。

meaning: 重新加邊；重新設定邊界
sentences: The designer had to remargin the page before printing. 設計師在列印前必須重新設定頁面邊界。
Please remargin the spreadsheet so the notes fit on one page. 請重新調整試算表邊界，好讓註解能放在同一頁。
The teacher's encouraging remarks on my essay gave me a lot of confidence. 老師對我文章的鼓勵性評論給了我很大的信心。
He remarked that the weather was unusually warm for this time of year. 他談到（評論說）今年這個時節的天氣異常溫暖。

The remarkability of the landscape made the trip unforgettable. 那片風景的引人注目程度，讓這趟旅行難以忘懷。

meaning: 卓越的、非凡的、值得注意的
sentences: She has made remarkable progress in her piano playing over the past year. 在過去的一年裡，她的鋼琴彈奏取得了卓越（顯著）的進步。

People discussed the remarkableness of her calm response under pressure. 大家談論她在壓力下仍能平靜應對的非凡程度。

meaning: 用來引起對某個命題的特別注意。
sentences: Remarkably, three State assembly elections were decided by a total of fewer than one hundred votes. 值得注意的是，三場州議會選舉都是以不到一百票的總票數決定的。
If someone acts remarkably, they do so in a way that is used to draw special attention to a proposition. 如果某人表現出色，他們這樣做的方式是為了引起人們對某個主張的特別注意。
The room looked remarkedly brighter after the curtains were opened. 窗簾拉開後，房間明顯亮了許多。
Her voice changed remarkedly once she felt more confident. 她一旦更有信心，聲音就顯著地變了。
Every remarker in the room seemed to have a different opinion. 房間裡每位發言者似乎都有不同意見。
The remarker added a short note beside the drawing. 那位評論者在圖畫旁邊加了一則簡短註解。
The brand decided to remarket the product to younger buyers. 品牌決定把這項產品重新行銷給年輕買家。
After the update, they remarket the app with a new campaign. 更新之後，他們用新的宣傳活動重新推廣這個應用程式。
Her quick remarque ended the awkward silence. 她那句簡短的評語打破了尷尬的沉默。
He wrote a small remarque beside the paragraph. 他在那一段旁邊寫下一則小註記。
Their remarriage surprised the whole neighborhood. 他們再婚讓整個街區都感到驚訝。
The law treats remarriage differently in some countries. 在一些國家，法律對再婚的規定不同。
After years alone, she decided to remarry. 在獨自生活多年後，她決定再婚。
He did not want to remarry until he felt ready. 在真正準備好之前，他不想再婚。

meaning: 重新整隊；重新安排順序
sentences: The coach told the players to remarshal before the drill. 教練要球員在演練前重新整隊。
We had to remarshal the files after the labels changed. 標籤改過之後，我們只好重新整理檔案順序。

meaning: 重新戴上面罩；再次遮蓋
sentences: She had to remask before entering the lab. 她在進入實驗室前必須重新戴上面罩。
The stage crew remasked the prop so it would blend in. 舞台工作人員把道具再次遮蓋，讓它更融入背景。
After lunch, the crowd remassed near the entrance. 午餐後，人群又在入口附近重新聚集。
The team will remass at the station before sunrise. 團隊會在日出前在車站重新集合。
The crew had to remast the boat after the storm. 暴風雨後，船員必須重新裝上桅桿。
It took them a day to remast the old sailboat. 他們花了一整天才把那艘舊帆船的桅桿重新裝好。
He remasticated the tough bread before swallowing it. 他把硬麵包又嚼了一遍才吞下去。
The animal seemed to remasticate its food slowly. 那隻動物似乎在慢慢地把食物再咀嚼一次。
The doctor noted a brief remastication during the exam. 醫生在檢查時注意到短暫的再咀嚼動作。
For the cow, remastication is part of normal digestion. 對牛來說，再咀嚼是正常消化的一部分。

meaning: 與上一場相同的對手或球隊之間重複進行的比賽。
sentences: After being beaten in pool by Melanie, John asked for a rematch. 在桌球比賽中被梅蘭妮擊敗後，約翰要求重賽。
The term rematch refers to a repeated contest staged between the same opponents or teams which played a previous contest. 複賽一詞是指與上一場相同的對手或球隊之間重複進行的比賽。
The missing wallet seemed to rematerialize on the kitchen table. 失蹤的錢包似乎又在廚房桌上出現了。
In the story, the hero can rematerialize after disappearing. 在故事裡，英雄消失後還能重新實體化。
Please remble the toys before bedtime. 請在睡前把玩具收拾整齊。
She rembled the workshop so everything had a place. 她把工作間整理好，讓每樣東西都有固定位置。
Rembrandt is famous for his dramatic use of light. 林布蘭以戲劇性的光影運用聞名。
The museum displayed a painting attributed to Rembrandt. 這座博物館展出了一幅被認為出自林布蘭之手的畫作。
The portrait had a Rembrandtesque glow around the face. 那幅肖像的臉部周圍帶著林布蘭式的光暈。
Her Rembrandtesque shadows made the painting feel timeless. 她那種林布蘭式的陰影處理讓畫面顯得歷久彌新。
The artist used a Rembrandtish shadow across one cheek. 那位藝術家在一側臉頰上運用了林布蘭式的陰影。
His Rembrandtish style gave the room a warm, old-world mood. 他的林布蘭式風格讓房間有種溫暖的舊時代氣息。
The critic praised the painter's gentle Rembrandtism. 評論家稱讚那位畫家溫柔的林布蘭風格。
You can see a touch of Rembrandtism in the deep colors and shadows. 你可以在濃厚的色彩和陰影中看到一點林布蘭派的影子。
The remeant hikers finally reached camp at dusk. 那些歸來的登山客終於在黃昏抵達營地。
A remeant breeze drifted through the open window. 一陣回返的微風從打開的窗戶吹進來。
We should remeasure the room before buying the sofa. 在買沙發前，我們應該重新量一次房間。
The survey team will remeasure the boundary tomorrow. 測量團隊明天會重新量一次邊界。
The survey required a remeasurement of the boundary. 這次勘測需要重新量一次界線。
A remeasurement confirmed that the shelf still fit. 重新測量後確認那個架子還是放得下。
The village healer offered a simple remede for the cough. 村裡的草藥師提供了一個簡單的止咳良方。
They searched for a remede after the first plan failed. 第一個方案失敗後，他們尋找新的補救辦法。
The damage was serious but still remediable. 損壞雖然嚴重，但仍然可以補救。
She saw the mistake as remediable, not fatal. 她認為這個錯誤是可補救的，不是致命的。
The remediableness of the flaw gave the team hope. 這個缺陷的可補救性讓團隊看到了希望。
He doubted the remediableness of the old bridge. 他懷疑那座老橋是否還有可補救性。
The leak was remediably repaired with a small patch. 這個漏水點只要小補一下就能補救地修好。
The flaw was remediably close to being fixed. 這個缺陷其實還在可補救的範圍內。
The school offered remedial math after class. 學校在課後提供補救數學。
He took a remedial course to strengthen his writing. 他上了補救課程來加強寫作。
The tutor used the worksheet remedially to target weak spots. 家教把這份講義當作補救用途，用來針對弱項。
The medication was prescribed remedially, not regularly. 這種藥是作為補救治療開立的，不是固定服用。
The site required extensive environmental remediation before it could be used for other purposes. 該場地需要進行廣泛的環境整治才能用於其他目的。
The school introduced a remediation program for students who needed extra support. 學校為需要額外協助的學生推出補救教學計畫。
Without treatment, the wound seemed remediless. 沒有治療時，那個傷口看起來無法補救。

The museum label explained that a Remoboth was an irregular monk. 博物館標牌說明，這個詞指的是不受常規約束的修士。

meaning: 再次嘲弄；重新模仿取笑
sentences: He tried to remock the speaker's accent, but it sounded forced. 他試著再次模仿那位講者的口音，卻顯得很刻意。
The class kept remocking the joke until the teacher stopped it. 全班反覆拿那個笑話取笑，直到老師出面制止。
They decided to remodel their kitchen next summer. 他們決定明年夏天重新裝修廚房。
The company is planning to remodel its existing business strategy. 公司正計畫更新其現有的業務策略。
A remodeler gutted the kitchen and rebuilt it from scratch. 一位重新裝修者把廚房整個拆空，從頭重做。
They hired a remodeler to open up the cramped hallway. 他們請來一位改造者，把那條狹窄的走廊打通。
The remodeller planned a brighter layout for the studio flat. 那位改造者為單間公寓規畫了更明亮的格局。
Our remodeller suggested moving the sink closer to the window. 我們的裝修改造者建議把水槽移到更靠窗的位置。
The remodelment of the storefront took three weeks. 店面的重新改造花了三週。
Her plan called for a full remodelment of the old loft. 她的計畫要求把那間舊閣樓徹底重整。
The remodification of the schedule caused confusion. 日程的再次修改造成了混亂。
We made a remodification to the contract before signing. 在簽約前，我們又對合約做了一次重新調整。
They remodified the app after user testing. 他們在使用者測試後再次修改了應用程式。
Please remodify the sentence so it sounds clearer. 請把這句話再改寫得更清楚。

meaning: 法式雷莫拉德醬；調味醬
sentences: The chef served the salmon with remolade on the side. 主廚把鮭魚配上雷莫拉德醬一起端上來。
A spoonful of remolade gave the sandwich a sharp kick. 一匙雷莫拉德醬就讓三明治的味道更有勁。
The sculptor can remold the clay before it dries. 雕塑家可以在黏土乾掉前重新塑形。
Hardship can remold a person's priorities. 困難能重塑一個人的優先順序。

meaning: 使再度柔軟的；再軟化的
sentences: The remollient lotion softened the rough patch on her hands. 這款再軟化乳液讓她手上的粗糙處變柔軟了。
A remollient treatment helped the leather regain its bend. 這種再軟化處理讓皮革重新恢復了彈性。

meaning: 重新貨幣化；恢復貨幣功能
sentences: The remonetization of silver changed trade across the region. 白銀重新貨幣化改變了整個地區的貿易。
The policy debate focused on remonetization rather than tax cuts. 這場政策辯論聚焦在重新貨幣化，而不是減稅。

meaning: 使重新貨幣化；使再度流通
sentences: Some countries may remonetize old coins during shortages. 有些國家在短缺時可能會讓舊硬幣重新流通。
The government refused to remonetize the canceled notes. 政府拒絕讓已作廢的紙鈔重新成為通行貨幣。
Her remonstrance was calm but unmistakably firm. 她的抗議平靜卻毫不含糊。
The board ignored the parents' remonstrance about the policy. 董事會忽視了家長對這項政策的抗議。
The remonstrant spoke for the neighborhood at the meeting. 那位抗議者在會議上代表社區發言。
Each remonstrant was given two minutes to explain the objection. 每位提出異議的人都被給了兩分鐘說明。
She remonstrantly asked why the rule had changed overnight. 她帶著抗議的口氣問，為什麼規定一夜之間就變了。
He shook his head remonstrantly at the rushed decision. 他對這個倉促決定搖頭表示不滿。
I had to remonstrate when they skipped safety checks. 當他們跳過安全檢查時，我不得不提出抗議。
The teacher remonstrated gently with the noisy class. 老師溫和地勸告那個吵鬧的班級。
Her remonstrating voice cut through the room. 她帶著抗議意味的聲音劃破了整個房間。
He gave me a remonstrating look before speaking. 他先用勸諫的眼神看了我一眼才開口。
The neighbor waved remonstratingly at the late-night music. 鄰居對著深夜音樂不滿地揮手抗議。
She remonstratingly pointed at the broken window. 她帶著勸阻意味地指向破掉的窗戶。
Their remonstration was recorded in the meeting notes. 他們的抗議已記錄在會議紀錄中。
He offered a quiet remonstration instead of shouting. 他沒有大吼，而是平靜地提出勸諫。
His remonstrative tone made everyone listen. 他那種勸諫式的語氣讓所有人都安靜下來聽。
The letter was remonstrative, but never rude. 那封信帶著勸戒意味，但並不失禮。
She folded her arms remonstratively and waited. 她雙臂交叉，帶著抗議的姿態等著。
The child remonstratively asked for one more story. 那孩子帶著不滿地要求再講一個故事。
The remonstrator stood up to question the new policy. 那位抗議者站起來質疑新政策。
Every remonstrator was heard before the vote. 在投票前，每位提出異議的人都被聽取了意見。
The editor wrote a remonstratory note in the margin. 編輯在頁邊寫下帶勸諫意味的註記。
His remonstratory letter warned the company to change course. 他的勸諫信警告公司該改變方向了。
The old story described him as a remontado who left the lowlands for the hills. 舊故事把他描述成一位離開平原、回到山中的反叛者。
Historians used the word remontado for a rebel living beyond state control. 歷史學者用這個詞來指稱生活在政權控制之外的反叛者。

meaning: 多次開花的；再度抽花的
sentences: The gardener planted remontant roses for a longer blooming season. 園丁種了多次開花的玫瑰，好讓花期更長。
A remontant variety can bloom again after the first flush. 這種再度抽花的品種在第一波盛開後還會再開一次。

meaning: 時計補償裝置；上鏈裝置
sentences: The watchmaker adjusted the remontoir with a steady hand. 鐘錶匠用穩定的手勢調整上鏈裝置。
A tiny remontoir can help a clock keep a more even beat. 小小的時計補償裝置能讓時鐘走時更穩。
Please remop the entryway after the rain. 請在下雨後把入口地板再拖一次。
She had to remop the kitchen because the paint dripped onto it. 由於油漆滴到地上，她只好把廚房重新拖地。
A remora clung to the shark's side for the ride. 一條鮣魚吸附在鯊魚身側搭順風車。
For the project, his doubts became a remora on progress. 在這個計畫裡，他的疑慮成了進展的阻礙。
Old guilt seemed to remord him whenever he saw the letter. 每當他看到那封信，舊日罪疚就像在折磨他。
The memory would remord her for years after the accident. 那場意外的記憶會在往後多年持續折磨她。
He felt a deep sense of remorse for what he had done. 他對自己的所作所為感到深深的悔恨。
She showed no remorse for her actions during the trial. 審判期間，她對自己的行為沒有表現出任何自責。
He sounded genuinely remorseful after the harsh comment. 他在說出那句刻薄的話後，聽起來真心懊悔。
The remorseful student wrote an apology by hand. 那位懊悔的學生親手寫了一封道歉信。
She smiled remorsefully and admitted her mistake. 她帶著愧疚的笑容承認了自己的錯誤。
He looked remorsefully at the broken vase. 他愧疚地望著那個打碎的花瓶。
There was no remorsefulness in his voice. 他的語氣裡沒有半點悔意。
Her remorsefulness showed in the long apology she wrote. 她寫下的長篇道歉信裡可以看出她的懊悔。

meaning: 無情的；冷酷的；不知悔改的
sentences: The remorseless storm battered the coast all night. 那場無情的暴風雨整夜拍打著海岸。
He was remorseless even after hearing the victim's story. 即使聽到受害者的故事，他仍然不知悔改。
The wind blew remorselessly across the plain. 風毫不留情地掠過平原。
The critics attacked the film remorselessly. 評論家毫不留情地批評了這部電影。
The remorselessness of the attack shocked the whole town. 這場攻擊的無情程度震驚了整個城鎮。
What bothered her most was his remorselessness. 最讓她不安的是他的不知悔改。

meaning: 毫無悔意的；不受愧疚影響的
sentences: He looked almost remorseproof after the cruel prank. 那場惡作劇之後，他看起來幾乎毫無悔意。
The villain was written as remorseproof and proud of it. 那個反派被寫成毫無悔意，甚至還對此感到自豪。

meaning: 重新抵押；再次辦理房貸
sentences: They decided to remortgage the house to get a lower interest rate. 他們決定把房子重新抵押，好拿到較低的利率。
She remortgaged her apartment after the renovation costs went up. 裝修費用增加後，她把公寓重新抵押了。
The small village is located in a remote mountain area. 那個小村莊位於偏遠的山區。
The possibility of a global financial crisis seems quite remote. 全球金融危機的可能性似乎相當遙遠。
I'm not remotely in love with you. 我並沒有完全愛上你。
If someone acts remotely, they do so in a way that is not much; scarcely; hardly. 如果有人遠端行動，他們的方式並不多；幾乎沒有；幾乎沒有。
The remoteness of the village made deliveries slow and expensive. 那個村子的偏遠讓送貨又慢又貴。
He felt the remoteness between himself and his old friends. 他感受到自己和老朋友之間的疏離。
The remotion of the broken shelf took only a few minutes. 那個壞掉的層架移除只花了幾分鐘。
In the old report, remotion meant the act of taking something away. 在舊報告裡，remotion 指的是把某物移走的動作。

meaning: 具有移除作用的；促使離開的
sentences: The cleaner had a remotive effect on the stubborn stain. 那種清潔劑對頑固污漬有移除作用。
His remotive comment made the volunteers step back from the argument. 他那句讓人退場的話，使志工們從爭論中退開。
The artist remoulded the clay until the face looked alive. 那位藝術家把黏土重新塑形，直到臉孔看起來有了生氣。
The company wants to remould its image after the scandal. 這家公司想在醜聞後重塑形象。
After the horse startled, he tried to remount as calmly as he could. 馬受驚後，他盡量冷靜地再次上馬。
The technician had to remount the screen before the meeting started. 技術人員必須在會議開始前把螢幕重新裝回。
The removability of the filter makes cleaning much easier. 這個濾網的可拆卸性讓清潔容易得多。
Engineers tested the removability of each panel before shipping. 工程師在出貨前測試了每個面板的可移除性。
The chair has a removable cushion. 這張椅子有可拆卸的坐墊。
He chose a removable cover for easy washing. 他選了可拆下的外罩，方便清洗。
The removableness of the cover was the feature she liked most. 她最喜歡的就是這個外蓋的可拆開性。
We checked the removableness of the battery before buying the device. 我們在購買這台裝置前，先確認電池是否可拆。
The sticker was attached removably so it would not leave residue. 那張貼紙是可拆卸地貼上的，才不會留下殘膠。
The shelf hooks lock removably into the frame for easy storage. 那些層架掛鉤可拆卸地卡進框架，方便收納。
The removal of the old furniture took several hours and required a large truck. 搬走（移走）舊家具花了幾個小時，還需要一輛大卡車。
The board of directors voted for the removal of the CEO following the scandal. 董事會在醜聞發生後投票免除了執行長的職務。
Please remove your shoes before you enter the house. 進入屋內前請先脫鞋。
The surgeon performed a difficult operation to remove the tumor. 外科醫生進行了一場艱難的手術以切除腫瘤。

meaning: 在時間、空間或程度分開。
sentences: Now that we are here one week removed... 現在我們已經在這裡 移除 一週了... 現在我們已經在這裡移除一周了...現在我們已經在這裡移除一周了...
The report describes the result as removed. 該報告將結果描述為已刪除。 該報告將結果描述為已刪除。 該報告將結果描述為已刪除。
He spoke removedly, as if the topic belonged to someone else. 他說話帶著疏遠感，彷彿那個話題跟他無關。
From the balcony, she watched the street removedly and quietly. 她站在陽台上，隔著距離安靜地看著街道。
The removedness in their conversation made everyone uncomfortable. 他們談話中的疏離感讓每個人都不自在。
Years of travel gave her a calm removedness from daily drama. 多年的旅行讓她對日常紛擾有種平靜的距離感。
The removement of the old cabinets opened up the kitchen. 舊櫥櫃移除後，廚房一下子寬敞多了。
The report described the removement of debris after the storm. 這份報告描述了風暴後清除碎石雜物的工作。
We had to take my little brother to the hospital when he swallowed some nail-polish remover. 我弟弟吞下了一些指甲油去除劑後，我們只好帶他去醫院。
The label warned not to mix the remover with bleach. 標籤警告不要把去除劑和漂白水混合。
Removing the labels took longer than I expected. 去除那些標籤比我預期花了更久。
The crew is removing fallen branches from the road. 工作人員正在把倒下的樹枝從路面移開。

meaning: 再次乘法運算；重複相乘
sentences: The teacher used remultiplication to check the student's answer. 老師用再次乘法運算來檢查學生的答案。
In this exercise, remultiplication helps confirm the pattern. 在這個練習中，重複相乘有助於確認規律。
Please remultiply the numbers before you submit the worksheet. 在交作業前，請把這些數字再乘一次。
If the total looks wrong, remultiply the columns from the start. 如果總數看起來不對，就從頭把各欄重新乘算。
The remunerability of the project convinced the investors to stay. 這個專案的報酬性說服投資人繼續留下來。
She asked about the remunerability of the internship before she applied. 她在申請前先詢問這個實習是否有報酬。
The extra weekend shift was remunerable, so he took it. 額外的週末班是有酬勞的，所以他接了下來。
Not every volunteer task is remunerable, but some require paid expertise. 並不是每項志工工作都可獲報酬，但有些需要付費專業。
He worked remunerably during the summer to save for school. 他在夏天有酬地工作，好為學費存錢。
The consultation was remunerably arranged for a small fee. 這次諮詢是以小額費用有酬安排的。
The firm promised to remunerate the designer fairly. 公司承諾會公平地酬勞這位設計師。
They remunerated the guide for three full days of work. 他們為導覽員整整三天的工作支付了報酬。
The contract promised fair remuneration for overtime work. 合約承諾加班工作會有合理報酬。
She negotiated her remuneration before accepting the role. 她在接受職位前先談好了薪酬。
Freelance editing can be remunerative if you build a strong client base. 如果客戶基礎夠穩，接案編輯可以很有報酬。
He left the low-paid job for something more remunerative. 他離開那份低薪工作，去找更有報酬的職位。
She worked remuneratively as a translator on the side. 她兼職做翻譯，賺得還不錯。
The skills he learned abroad could be used remuneratively at home. 他在國外學到的技能回國後也能有報酬地運用。
The remunerativeness of the contract made the offer hard to refuse. 那份合約的報酬豐厚程度讓人很難拒絕。
He judged the job by its remunerativeness as much as by its title. 他衡量這份工作時，和職稱一樣重視報酬性。
The remunerator covered the travel costs and the speaker's fee. 付酬者負擔了旅費和講者費用。
In the contract, the remunerator must pay within thirty days. 在合約裡，酬勞方必須在三十天內付款。
The bonus was remuneratory, but it also rewarded long-term loyalty. 那筆獎金帶有酬勞性，也獎勵了長期忠誠。
She viewed the offer as remuneratory rather than merely symbolic. 她認為這個提議不只是象徵性的，而是確實有報酬。

meaning: 再次低聲低語；輕聲回響
sentences: The crowd seemed to remurmur after the announcement. 公告之後，人群又開始低聲喃語。
She remurmured the line to herself before going on stage. 上台前，她把那句台詞又低聲唸了一遍。

meaning: 雷穆斯；羅馬神話中的雷穆斯
sentences: Remus appears in the legend of Rome's founding. 雷穆斯出現在羅馬建城的傳說中。
The story of Romulus and Remus is taught in many history classes. 羅穆路斯與雷穆斯的故事常在許多歷史課上講到。
After the break, the coach told everyone to remuster on the field. 休息後，教練叫大家重新在場上集合。
The army had to remuster its troops after the sudden storm. 突然的暴風雨過後，部隊必須重新編組。

meaning: 再次變異；回復原狀的變化
sentences: The scientist watched for remutation in the next cell sample. 那位科學家留意下一個細胞樣本是否會再次變異。
The old text described remutation as a return to a previous form. 舊文獻把 remutation 描述為回到先前形態的變化。
Her renable explanation made the whole plan easier to accept. 她那番合理的解釋讓整個計畫更容易被接受。
He is a renable guest who can keep a dinner conversation lively. 他是個健談的客人，總能讓晚餐對話很熱絡。
She renably explained why the budget needed to change. 她用很合理的方式解釋了預算為何需要調整。
He spoke renably with everyone at the reception. 他在招待會上和每個人都談得很健談。
We had to renail the loose board before anyone could step on it. 我們得先把鬆動的木板再釘牢，才有人能踩上去。
He used a hammer to renail the shutter after the wind blew it open. 風把百葉窗吹開後，他拿錘子把它重新釘牢。
The city experienced a renaissance after the new train line opened. 新鐵路開通後，這座城市迎來了復興。
Painters of the renaissance changed the way people saw art. 文藝復興時期的畫家改變了人們看待藝術的方式。
The Renaissance changed art, science, and learning across Europe. 文藝復興改變了歐洲的藝術、科學與學術。
The city is enjoying a small cultural Renaissance with new galleries and theaters. 這座城市正因新畫廊和劇院而迎來小小的文化復興。

meaning: 文藝復興研究者；文藝復興支持者
sentences: The Renaissancist spent years studying Italian manuscripts. 那位文藝復興研究者花了多年研究義大利手稿。
As a Renaissancist, she loved comparing portraits and poetry from the era. 作為一名文藝復興研究者，她喜歡比較那個時代的肖像畫與詩歌。

meaning: 文藝復興時期的；復甦中的
sentences: The museum opened a Renaissant wing with paintings from Florence. 博物館開設了一個文藝復興時期的展區，陳列佛羅倫斯畫作。
The old district feels Renaissant again after years of restoration. 經過多年修復後，這片老街區又有了復甦的氣息。
renal transplant 腎臟移植
Something described as renal is pertaining to the kidneys. 被描述為腎臟的東西與腎臟有關。
Please rename the file so it is easier to find later. 請把檔案重新命名，這樣之後比較好找。
They decided to rename the street after a local hero. 他們決定以一位在地英雄的名字重新命名這條街。
His Renardine smile suggested he knew more than he said. 他那種狐狸般的微笑，顯示他知道得比說出口的還多。
The novel gives the trickster a Renardine wit and a quick tongue. 這部小說讓那個騙子擁有狐狸般的機智和敏捷口才。
The neighborhood saw a renascence after the new train line opened. 新鐵路開通後，這個社區重新興起了。
Her renascence as a singer surprised everyone in the room. 她作為歌手重新復出，讓房間裡的人都很驚訝。
The renascency of interest in vinyl records came as a surprise. 黑膠唱片的興趣再度興起，讓人感到意外。
Writers often talk about the renascency of a forgotten genre. 作家們常談到某個被遺忘類型的再生。
The gallery became renascent after the new curator arrived. 新策展人到任後，這間畫廊重新煥發生機。

meaning: 微小的放棄；戲謔式讓步
sentences: The scholar used renunculus as a playful term for a tiny surrender. 那位學者把它當作一個帶點玩笑意味的小小放棄之詞。

The team met to replan the budget for the next quarter. 團隊開會重新規劃下一季的預算。

meaning: 重新刨平；再次用刨子修整

After the move, we replant the herbs in larger pots. 搬家後，我們把香草重新栽到更大的盆裡。

meaning: 可重新栽種的；可移植的
sentences: These seedlings are replantable after two weeks. 這些幼苗兩週後就可以重新栽種。

Replantation can save tissue if treatment starts quickly. 如果及時處理，再植手術有機會保住組織。
A careful replanter checks the soil before moving a shrub. 細心的重新栽種者在移植灌木前會先檢查土壤。
The replanter worked slowly to protect the roots. 那位移植者動作很慢，好保護根部。

meaning: 重新抹灰；重新粉刷抹灰
sentences: They replastered the wall after the pipes were fixed. 管線修好後，他們重新抹灰那面牆。

sentences: The lawyer asked to replead the case with clearer facts. 律師要求以更清楚的事實重新提出訴狀。

sentences: The judge allowed a repleader so the case could be restated. 法官允許重新答辯，讓案件能重新陳述。

The borrower repledged the asset to secure a new agreement. 借款人把資產重新抵押，以取得新的協議。

meaning: 重新抵押的人；重新作保的人
sentences: The repledger signed the new agreement at noon. 那位重新抵押的人在中午簽了新協議。
As a repledger, she needed to read every clause carefully. 身為重新作保的人，她必須仔細閱讀每一條條款。

meaning: 重新填充；更新；再次供應或添加新數量。
sentences: It's a popular product, and they have to replenish their stock of it frequently. 這是一種受歡迎的產品，他們必須經常補充庫存。
To replenish means to refill; to renew; to supply again or to add a fresh quantity to. 補充的意思是補充；更新；再次供應或增加新數量。
A good replenisher keeps the shelves stocked. 好的補貨者會讓貨架保持充足。
The hotel asked for a replenisher to restock the minibar. 飯店請補貨員去補充迷你吧。
The meal felt replenishingly warm after the long hike. 長途健行後，這頓飯吃起來特別有補充體力的感覺。
She slept replenishingly well after the weekend trip. 週末旅行後，她睡得格外能恢復元氣。
Water replenishment is essential during dry seasons. 乾季時，補充水源非常重要。
The store scheduled a replenishment of snacks before lunch. 商店在午餐前安排補貨零食。

The table was set repletively with bowls, bread, and fruit. 那張桌子上擺滿了碗、麵包和水果。
The repletory treatment was meant to restore strength. 這種補充性治療是為了恢復體力。
She chose a repletory soup after the long day. 經過漫長的一天後，她選了那種滋補的湯。

sentences: The seized goods were repleviable under local law. 依當地法律，被扣押的貨物可以提起取回訴訟。

meaning: 可依法取回的；可再領回的
sentences: The judge said the seized tools were replevisable after the paperwork was filed. 法官表示，只要文件辦妥，這些被扣押的工具就能依法取回。
The lawyer explained that only replevisable property could be recovered through that procedure. 律師解釋，只有可依法取回的財物才能透過那個程序追回。

meaning: 提起返還訴訟的人；原告

sentences: They hired a lawyer to replevy the equipment from the warehouse. 他們雇了律師，依法從倉庫把設備取回。

sentences: The insect's replicatile wings tucked neatly against its body. 那隻昆蟲可向後摺疊的翅膀整齊貼在身側。

meaning: 複製性的；與複製有關的
sentences: The lab studied the replicative behavior of the new strain. 實驗室研究了新菌株的複製性行為。

meaning: 重新規劃；重寫情節的動作
sentences: The city's replotment of the waterfront took months. 市政府對海濱地帶的重新規劃花了好幾個月。
The editor called the sudden replotment of the story an improvement. 編輯認為這個故事突然重新改寫情節反而更好。

meaning: 重新規劃者；重寫情節的人
sentences: The replotter spent the afternoon redrawing the map. 重新規劃者整個下午都在重畫地圖。

sentences: The botanist pointed to the replum inside the seed pod. 那位植物學家指著種莢內的中隔。

meaning: 重新裝上羽毛；再加羽飾
sentences: The costume team replumed the hat with bright feathers. 服裝組把帽子重新加上鮮亮的羽毛。
Bird collectors sometimes replume old displays to restore their look. 鳥類標本收藏者有時會替舊展品重新裝飾羽毛，好恢復外觀。

meaning: 以回應的方式；像在答覆地
sentences: He nodded replyingly without looking up from the page. 他看都沒抬頭，只是像在回應似地點了點頭。

meaning: 重新放回口袋；再塞入口袋
sentences: He repocketed the receipt before leaving the counter. 他離開櫃台前把收據重新塞回口袋。

meaning: 重新勾縫；重新填補接縫
sentences: They repointed the old brick wall to stop the leaks. 他們把老磚牆重新勾縫，好止住滲水。

The news outlet repolled readers after the debate. 辯論結束後，那家新聞媒體又對讀者做了一次民調。
One careless spill can repollute the cleaned stream. 一次不小心的外洩就可能讓清理過的溪流再度污染。
The factory was fined after it repolluted the river. 那家工廠在再次污染河川後被罰款。

meaning: 馬術中的五拍迴轉；五拍圓圈動作
sentences: The rider practiced a repolon on the training ring. 騎士在訓練場裡練習一個五拍迴轉。

She repondered the offer before signing anything. 她在簽字前又重新斟酌了這個提議。

The lawyer asked the court to repone his client to the earlier legal status. 律師請法院讓他的當事人恢復先前的法律地位。

meaning: 再任命為教宗；使重新當上教宗
sentences: The satirical article joked about trying to repope the hero after the election. 那篇諷刺文章開玩笑說，要在選舉後讓主角再次當上教宗。

meaning: 重新填補人口；再度移入人口
sentences: The town tried to repopulate the empty district with young families. 這個小鎮試著用年輕家庭重新填補空蕩的區域人口。

meaning: 重新人口化；再次充實人口
sentences: The repopulation of the island took years after the evacuation. 疏散之後，這座島的重新人口化花了好幾年。

She hoped to move from editing into reportership. 她希望從編輯轉到記者工作。

The rumor spread reportingly from table to table. 那則傳聞在一桌傳一桌的過程中流傳開來。

meaning: 以記者式地；以報導風格地
sentences: She wrote reportorially, sticking to observation and detail. 她以記者式的方式寫作，緊扣觀察與細節。

Each district has its own political representation in the local government. 每個地區在地方政府中都有自己的政治代表。
Her painting moved away from abstract art toward a more representational style. 她的畫作從抽象藝術轉向較具再現性的風格。
The teacher asked for a representational sketch of the machine. 老師要求畫一張那台機器的具體示意圖。

meaning: 修復者；復原者；修復工作者

sentences: The restward corner of the cabin stayed quiet all afternoon. 小屋裡那個讓人安歇的一角整個下午都很安靜。

meaning: 朝著休息的方向；往安歇處
sentences: The children drifted restwards as the movie ended. 電影結束時，孩子們慢慢往休息的方向走去。

The collector showed a pale sample of retinalite. 收藏家展示了一塊淡色的稀有礦物。
A thin vein of retinalite ran through the rock. 岩石中有一條細細的稀有礦物脈。
The sample dried into a dark retinasphalt. 樣本乾燥後變成深色的類瀝青物質。
He scraped the retinasphalt from the tray. 他把托盤上的類瀝青物質刮了下來。
The jar contained a sticky retinasphaltum. 罐子裡裝著黏稠的瀝青質樹脂。
She chipped a fragment of retinasphaltum from the block. 她從那塊硬塊上敲下一小片瀝青質樹脂。

A careful retincture gave the curtain a deeper blue tone. 仔細的再染色讓窗簾呈現更深的藍調。
The paper uses retinene as an older name. 這篇文章把它稱作較舊的名稱。
Retinene was measured in the solution. 溶液中的視黃醛被測了出來。

meaning: 具網狀葉脈的；網脈明顯的
sentences: The leaf looked retinerved under the bright lamp. 那片葉子在明亮燈光下看起來具網狀葉脈。
Botanists noted a retinerved pattern running through the blade. 植物學家注意到葉片上有明顯的網脈紋路。
The report mentioned a retinian abnormality in the scan. 報告提到掃描中有視網膜方面的異常。
She asked the doctor to explain the retinian findings in plain language. 她請醫師用簡單的話說明那些視網膜檢查結果。
The label identified the culture as retinispora from the old taxonomy. 標籤把這個培養物標成舊分類裡的舊屬名。
She copied the name retinispora carefully into her notes. 她小心地把這個舊屬名抄進筆記裡。
The old chart used retinite for a retinal condition. 那張舊圖表用這個詞指涉一種視網膜病變。
The clinician explained that retinite was affecting the patient's vision. 臨床醫師解釋，這種病變正在影響病人的視力。
The patient was treated for retinitis before the symptoms worsened. 病人在症狀惡化前接受了視網膜炎治療。
Retinitis can make reading difficult when the central vision is affected. 當中央視力受影響時，視網膜炎會讓閱讀變得困難。

meaning: 使網狀化；使呈現網狀結構
sentences: The designer used a mesh pattern to retinize the background. 設計師用網格圖案把背景網狀化。
Scientists retinized the surface to help the coating grip better. 科學家把表面做成網狀，讓塗層更容易附著。
He retinkered the radio until the static finally disappeared. 他把收音機反覆修補，直到雜訊終於消失。
If the shelf still wobbles, we can retinker the brackets tomorrow. 如果那個架子還是晃，明天我們可以再把支架修一修。
The screening helped doctors detect retinoblastoma early. 篩檢幫助醫師及早發現視網膜母細胞瘤。
Families are often relieved when retinoblastoma is found before it spreads. 當視網膜母細胞瘤在擴散前被發現時，家屬通常會鬆一口氣。
The article referred to the retinochorioid as part of the eye's lining. 那篇文章把視網膜脈絡膜稱為眼部內襯的一部分。
She underlined the word retinochorioid in the pathology report. 她在病理報告上把這個詞劃了線。
The retinochorioidal layer was described in the anatomy seminar. 解剖學研討會中提到了視網膜脈絡膜層。
A retinochorioidal lesion can change how light reaches the retina. 視網膜脈絡膜的病灶會改變光線到達視網膜的方式。
The diagnosis of retinochorioiditis worried the patient at first. 被診斷為視網膜脈絡膜炎時，病人一開始很擔心。
Treatment for retinochorioiditis often focuses on reducing inflammation. 視網膜脈絡膜炎的治療通常著重於減輕發炎。

meaning: 類視黃醇化合物；類維生素A物質
sentences: The cream contains a retinoid that may help smooth the skin. 這款乳霜含有一種類視黃醇化合物，可能有助於讓肌膚更平滑。
She checked whether the retinoid was safe to use at night. 她確認這種類視黃醇物質是否適合晚上使用。
The serum lists retinol as one of its active ingredients. 這瓶精華液把視黃醇列為活性成分之一。
She started with a low dose of retinol to avoid irritation. 她先從低濃度的視黃醇開始使用，以避免刺激。
The specialist explained that retinopapilitis can blur vision. 專科醫師解釋，視網膜視乳頭炎會讓視力變模糊。
The chart listed retinopapilitis as a possible cause of the pain. 病歷表把視網膜視乳頭炎列為疼痛的可能原因。

meaning: 與視網膜攜帶細胞有關的；視覺細胞的
sentences: The paper discussed retinophoral structures in the tiny organism. 那篇論文討論了小型生物中的視覺相關構造。
A retinophoral cell may carry pigments that affect how the animal sees. 視覺相關細胞可能攜帶影響動物視覺的色素。
The zoology text mentioned a retinophore in the animal's eye. 動物學教材提到該動物眼中的色素細胞。
Under the microscope, the retinophore looked like a small colored cell. 在顯微鏡下，這個色素細胞看起來像一個小小的有色細胞。
The optometrist reached for a retinoscope during the exam. 驗光師在檢查時拿起了檢影鏡。
She watched the light from the retinoscope move across the pupil. 她看著檢影鏡的光線在瞳孔上移動。

meaning: 檢影的；與檢影鏡有關的
sentences: The retinoscopic reading helped determine the prescription. 檢影結果幫助決定了處方度數。
She asked for a retinoscopic explanation of the vision test. 她請對方用檢影法的角度解釋這項視力測驗。

meaning: 以檢影法地；用檢影方式地
sentences: The lenses were assessed retinoscopically in a dim room. 這些鏡片是在昏暗的房間裡以檢影法來評估的。
He retinoscopically checked the eye before changing the prescription. 他在更改處方前先用檢影方式檢查了眼睛。
The retinoscopist adjusted the light and asked the patient to stay still. 檢影驗光師調整燈光，請病人保持不動。
An experienced retinoscopist can spot small changes in refraction quickly. 經驗豐富的檢影驗光師能迅速看出折光的細微變化。
Retinoscopy is often used before choosing glasses. 在選擇眼鏡前，常會先做檢影驗光。
The student practiced retinoscopy until the reflections made sense. 那名學生練習檢影驗光，直到能看懂反光為止。
The old nursery tag still read Retinospora. 那張舊苗圃標籤上仍寫著這個舊屬名。
She smiled at the outdated name Retinospora in the botany book. 她看到植物學書中過時的舊屬名時笑了。
The mayor arrived with a small retinue of aides. 市長帶著一小隊隨行人員到場。
A quiet retinue followed the actor through the hotel lobby. 一群安靜的隨從跟著那位演員穿過飯店大廳。

meaning: 視小體；複眼中的感光單位
sentences: The insect eye contains a retinula that helps detect light. 昆蟲的眼睛裡有一個視小體，用來偵測光線。
Under the microscope, the retinula looked like a neat cluster. 在顯微鏡下，這個視小體看起來像整齊的一簇細胞。

meaning: 視細胞群的；感光細胞的
sentences: The report described retinular cells in the compound eye. 報告描述了複眼中的視細胞群細胞。
A retinular pattern could be seen in the image after staining. 染色後，影像中可以看見視細胞群式的排列。
The old anatomy note referred to each retinule as a separate unit. 那份舊解剖筆記把每個單位視為獨立單位。
She drew a tiny retinule beside the larger diagram. 她在較大的圖旁邊畫了一個小感光單位。
I had to retip the umbrella after the cap fell off. 傘頭掉了之後，我只好重新裝尖。
The carpenter will retip the broken pencil-like tool tomorrow. 木工明天會把那支像鉛筆的工具重新裝上尖頭。
The retiracied scholar lived quietly near the coast. 那位退隱的學者安靜地住在海邊。
Her retiracied life left plenty of time for reading. 她隱居般的生活留下了很多閱讀時間。
After years of public service, he chose retiracy. 在多年公職之後，他選擇了退隱。
The essay described retiracy as a life of quiet reflection. 那篇文章把 retiracy 描述為一種安靜沉思的生活。
The general ordered a retirade before nightfall. 將軍命令在天黑前撤退。
A hurried retirade left the camp in disarray. 一場匆忙的撤退讓營地亂成一團。
Her retiral from the company was announced in April. 她在四月宣布離職退休。
The ceremony marked his retiral after forty years of work. 這場典禮標誌著他工作四十年後的退休。
He is planning to retire from the company next year. 他計畫明年從公司退休。
She decided to retire from the competition due to an injury. 她因受傷決定退出比賽。
My father plans to retire next year and travel around the world with my mother. 我父親計畫明年退休，並和我母親一起環遊世界。
She started planning for her retirement early to ensure financial security. 她很早就開始規劃退休生活，以確保經濟上的安全感。

meaning: 與社會隔絕（生活方式、活動等）；私密，安靜。
sentences: I lead a retired lifestyle. 我過著退休的生活方式。
The report describes the result as retired. 報告將結果描述為退役。

meaning: 以退休者的方式；隱退地
sentences: He retiredly spent the morning reading by the window. 他像退休者般悠閒地在窗邊讀了一上午書。
She spoke retiredly, with the calm of someone long past the rush. 她說話帶著隱退後的從容，像是早已遠離忙碌的人。
The retiredness of the village made it feel peaceful. 那座村莊的隱退氣息讓人感到平靜。
He liked the retiredness of his new routine. 他喜歡新作息帶來的退休般安穩。
She looked forward to retirement. 她期待退休生活。
His retirement from public life was quiet. 他從公眾生活退隱得很低調。
The retirer now spends his days gardening and walking. 那位退休者如今把日子花在園藝和散步上。
As a retirer, she finally had time to learn painting. 作為一名退隱者，她終於有時間學畫畫。
I don't really know him well, since he's so shy and retiring. 我不太了解他，因為他很害羞，而且很內向。
The report describes the result as retiring. 報告將結果描述為退休。
She smiled retiringly and looked at the floor. 她羞怯地笑了笑，低頭看著地板。
He retiringly stepped back to let the others speak first. 他謙讓地退到後面，讓其他人先說。
Her retiringness made her seem thoughtful rather than distant. 她的內斂讓人覺得她只是沉思，而不是疏離。
The speaker's retiringness softened the tone of the whole meeting. 那位講者的謙遜退讓，讓整場會議的氣氛都柔和了。
The chemist isolated a fragile retistene from the residue. 化學家從殘渣中分離出一種脆弱的稀有化合物。
A faint smell of retistene lingered in the storage room. 倉庫裡還殘留著淡淡的那種氣味。
Please retoast the bread so it crisps up again. 請把麵包再烤一次，讓它重新變脆。
She re-toasted the nuts lightly before adding them to the salad. 她先把堅果輕輕再烤一下，才加進沙拉裡。
He retold the story with a few extra details. 他把那個故事又講了一遍，還加了幾個細節。
The legend was retold from one generation to the next. 這個傳說被一代又一代地重述下去。
I can retolerate the noise if the work finishes sooner. 如果工作能早點完成，我可以再忍受那個噪音。
After the repair, the machine was retolerated for another week. 維修之後，這台機器又被勉強再用了一週。
Retoleration was the only practical choice during the busy season. 在繁忙季節裡，重新容忍是唯一務實的選擇。
The manager's retoleration of small delays kept the team calm. 經理對小延誤的再次容忍，讓團隊保持冷靜。
The cloth seemed to retomb after I smoothed it out. 我把布撫平後，它似乎又重新鼓了起來。
By afternoon, the old cushion had retombed in the middle. 到了下午，那個舊坐墊中央又再次鼓起來了。
The choir's retonation was softer than before. 那個合唱團的重新發聲比先前更柔和。
For language learners, retonation can help correct a flat tone. 對語言學習者來說，重新發音有助於修正平板的語調。

meaning: 再次拿回；重新奪回；重考
sentences: She retook the exam and passed on her second try. 她重考了那場測驗，第二次就通過了。
The army retook the bridge before sunrise. 這支軍隊在日出前重新奪回了那座橋。
The workshop had to retool its machines for the new product line. 工坊必須為新產品線重新改裝機器。
We need to retool our study habits if we want better results. 如果我們想要更好的成果，就得重新調整讀書習慣。
The carpenter had to retooth the saw before using it again. 木匠在再次使用鋸子前，必須重新裝齒。
Some machines are designed to retooth quickly when the blades wear down. 有些機器設計成刀刃磨損後可以快速重新裝齒。

meaning: 重新裝齒的人；補齒工具
sentences: The retoother checked each blade before the shift began. 那位重新裝齒的人在交班前檢查了每片刀鋒。
In the old factory, the retoother was as important as the mechanic. 在那座老工廠裡，重新裝齒的人和機械師一樣重要。
She gave a sharp retort when he questioned her professional ability. 當他質疑她的專業能力時，她給予了尖銳的反駁（回嘴）。
He was ready with a witty retort when he was asked the difficult question. 面對困難的問題時，他準備好了一個機智的反駁。
His claim was retortable, so the debate continued. 他的說法是可以反駁的，因此辯論繼續下去。
Not every rude remark is worth answering, even when it is retortable. 即使某些無禮的話可以回嘴，也不代表每一句都值得回應。
He retorted that the plan had never been his idea. 他反駁說，那個計畫根本不是他的主意。
She retorted so quickly that the room went silent. 她回嘴得太快，整個房間都安靜了下來。
No retorter in the room could beat her sharp logic. 房間裡沒有任何擅長回嘴的人能贏過她犀利的邏輯。
The best retorter is not always the loudest speaker. 最會反駁的人不一定是最吵的那一個。
His retortion of the facts only made people more suspicious. 他對事實的扭曲只讓大家更起疑。
The lawyer's retortion came across as clever but strained. 那位律師的反駁聽起來機巧，卻也有些勉強。
His retortive tone made the meeting tense. 他那種愛回嘴的語氣讓會議變得緊繃。
A retortive answer can sound witty, but it may also sound unkind. 回嘴式的回答有時很機智，但也可能顯得不友善。
The prisoner described the interrogation as a kind of retorture. 那名囚犯把這次訊問形容成一種折磨。
Sleepless nights can feel like retorture when the mind will not rest. 失眠的夜晚會像折磨一樣，讓人怎麼也無法安歇。
He retossed the salad just before serving it. 他在上桌前又把沙拉翻拌了一次。
The boat seemed to retoss on the rough water. 小船在湍急的水面上似乎又被拋起翻轉。
The clerk had to retotal the receipts after finding an error. 收據出現錯誤後，櫃檯人員不得不重新加總。
Please retotal the votes before announcing the winner. 在宣布得主之前，請重新統計票數。
She retouched the portrait to soften the shadows. 她把肖像再修飾了一下，好讓陰影變柔和。
I only needed to retouch the photo before posting it. 我只需要在上傳前稍微修一下照片。
The retoucher fixed the skin tones in minutes. 那位修圖者在幾分鐘內就修好了膚色。
A skilled retoucher can improve an image without making it look fake. 熟練的潤飾者能提升影像品質，卻不會讓它看起來失真。
The magazine used light retouching on the cover photo. 那本雜誌只對封面照做了輕微修圖。
Too much retouching can erase the character of a real face. 過度修圖會抹去真實臉孔的個性。
The old painting needed only a small retouchment. 那幅舊畫只需要小幅修整。
His speech was polished through careful retouchment. 他的演講經過仔細潤飾後更加順暢。
We booked a retour ticket so the trip would be easier. 我們訂了來回票，這樣旅行會方便些。
After the long walk, the retour felt peaceful. 經過長途步行後，回程讓人覺得很平靜。
The route is retourable if the bridge stays open. 如果橋還開著，這條路是可以回返的。
They chose a retourable plan so no one would be stranded. 他們選了可返回的方案，這樣沒有人會被困住。
We retraced our steps to find the missing wallet. 我們沿著來時的路折返，好找回遺失的錢包。
The historian tried to retrace the events of that night. 那位歷史學家試著追溯那晚發生的事件。

meaning: 可追溯的；可沿原路返回的
sentences: The path was retraceable even after the rain. 即使下過雨，那條路仍然可以沿路折返。
Her reasoning was clear and retraceable from start to finish. 她的推理從頭到尾都清楚可追溯。
The retracement of his journey took several hours. 他這趟旅程的回溯花了好幾個小時。
In finance, retracement can describe a temporary pullback. 在金融領域裡，retracement 可以指短暫回落。
We had to retrack the route after the storm changed the trail. 暴風雨改變路徑後，我們不得不重新追蹤路線。
The detective tried to retrack the suspect's steps through the city. 那名偵探試著在城裡重新追蹤嫌犯的足跡。

meaning: 將（某物）拉回或拉回裡面。
sentences: An airplane retracts its wheels for flight. 飛機為了飛行而收起機輪。
A cat can retract its claws. 貓可以縮回爪子。
The retractability of the awning makes the patio more useful. 遮棚的可收回性讓露台更實用。
Engineers tested the retractability of the landing gear. 工程師測試了起落架的可收回性。
The pen has a retractable tip, so it is easy to carry. 這支筆有可收回的筆尖，攜帶起來很方便。
A retractable roof can change the feel of an entire stadium. 可伸縮屋頂能改變整座球場的氛圍。

The cat retracted its claws and curled up to sleep. 貓把爪子縮回去，蜷起身子睡著了。
The retractibility of the blade makes the tool safer. 刀片的可收回性讓工具更安全。
Doctors considered the retractibility of the implant during planning. 醫師在規劃時考慮了植入物的可收回性。
The older spelling, retractible, still appears in some manuals. 舊拼法 retractible 仍會出現在一些手冊裡。
Its retractible cord keeps the desk neat. 它那條可收回的電線讓桌面保持整潔。
Some animals have retractile claws for climbing. 有些動物有可縮回的爪子，方便攀爬。
The toy's retractile antennae bent back into place. 那個玩具可收縮的天線又彈回原位。
The retractility of the mechanism impressed the engineers. 那個機構的可收縮性讓工程師印象深刻。
Scientists studied the retractility of the animal's skin. 科學家研究了那種動物皮膚的可縮回性。
The newspaper printed a retraction on the front page. 那家報紙在頭版刊出了撤回聲明。
Muscle retraction can happen when the body is under stress. 身體承受壓力時，肌肉可能會發生收縮。
The retractive design keeps the cable from tangling. 這種可收回的設計能避免電線打結。
A retractive motion helped the latch snap shut. 一個收縮動作讓扣件啪地合上了。

meaning: 以收縮方式；以縮回的方式
sentences: The cover slid retractively into the frame. 蓋板以收縮的方式滑回框架裡。

meaning: 經過重新加工的；改修的
sentences: The reworked draft reads much more smoothly. 這份重新修訂過的草稿讀起來順多了。
She wore a reworked jacket with new lining and buttons. 她穿著一件重新改造過的外套，裡面換了新襯裡和鈕扣。
I rewound the tape and listened again. 我把錄音帶倒回去，又聽了一次。
He rewound the scene to catch the exact moment of the mistake. 他把那一幕倒回去，想抓住出錯的精確時刻。
She rewove the torn basket handle with fresh reeds. 她用新的蘆葦把破掉的籃把重新編織起來。
The artisan rewove the cloth to strengthen the edge. 那位工匠把布料重新編織，讓邊緣更牢固。
The rewoven scarf felt softer than the original. 那條重新編織過的圍巾摸起來比原本更柔軟。
Only a rewoven section was needed after the rip. 破口之後只需要補上一小段重新編織的部分。
Please rewrap the gift after checking the tag. 確認標籤後，請把禮物重新包好。
The nurse had to rewrap the bandage before the patient left. 護士在病人離開前，得先把繃帶重新包紮好。

meaning: 重新寫，換一種方式；修改；修改。
sentences: The editor asked me to rewrite my article for a non-technical audience. 編輯要求我為非技術讀者重寫我的文章。
To rewrite means to write again, differently; to modify; to revise. 重寫意味著以不同的方式再次書寫；修改；進行修改。
The rewriter polished the article for a younger audience. 那位改寫者把文章潤飾成更適合年輕讀者的版本。
This code rewriter helps turn old scripts into cleaner drafts. 這個程式重寫工具能把舊腳本整理成更乾淨的草稿。
Rex barked whenever the mail arrived. 雷克斯每次聽到郵件送達就會吠叫。
We adopted a puppy and named him Rex. 我們領養了一隻小狗，給牠取名雷克斯。
Several dinosaur names include rex at the end. 許多恐龍名稱會把這個詞放在詞尾。
In Latin, rex means king. 在拉丁語裡，這個詞表示國王。
The rexen banner made the hall feel ceremonial. 那面王族風格的旗幟讓大廳顯得很有儀典氣氛。
He chose a rexen pose for the portrait, straight-backed and formal. 他拍肖像時擺出王者般的姿態，背脊挺直又正式。
Even after more pressure, the firm refused to reyield. 即使壓力更大，那家公司仍拒絕再次讓步。
The soil seemed to reyield moisture after the evening rain. 傍晚下雨後，土壤似乎又再次釋放出水分。
Reynard is a classic fox figure in European tales. 雷納德是歐洲故事中的經典狐狸角色。
The children laughed when Reynard tricked the hunters. 當雷納德戲弄獵人時，孩子們都笑了。
Reynold signed the form before lunch. 雷諾德在午餐前簽了表格。
My grandfather was named Reynold after his uncle. 我祖父是以他叔叔的名字 Reynold 命名的。
The farmer had to reyoke the oxen after the cart slipped. 牛車滑開後，農夫只好再把牛重新套上軛。
Some traditions try to reyoke people to old rules. 有些傳統試圖把人們重新束縛回舊規矩。
Moving to the coast gave her a feeling of reyouth. 搬到海邊讓她有一種重返青春的感覺。
The novel treats travel as a kind of reyouth. 這部小說把旅行寫成一種第二青春。

meaning: 雷茲班英石，一種稀有礦物
sentences: The geologist identified the dark crystal as rezbanyite. 地質學家把那顆深色晶體辨認為雷茲班英石。
Rezbanyite is rare enough that most collectors only see it in catalogs. 雷茲班英石非常稀有，多數收藏家只在目錄裡見過。
The microscope showed tiny rhabdite structures in the sample. 顯微鏡下可看到樣本裡細小的桿狀體。
In some invertebrates, rhabdite helps form a protective layer. 在某些無脊椎動物中，rhabdite 有助於形成保護層。
The larva is rhabditiform at this stage of development. 這個幼體在發育的這個階段呈桿狀。
Researchers noted the rhabditiform shape under the microscope. 研究人員在顯微鏡下記錄到那種桿狀形態。
Rhabditis is often found in moist soil. 桿線蟲屬常見於潮濕土壤。
Researchers observed Rhabditis under the microscope. 研究人員在顯微鏡下觀察桿線蟲屬。
The specimen included a visible rhabdium near the edge. 樣本邊緣可見一個明顯的桿狀構造。
Scientists used the rhabdium as a clue to identify the organism. 科學家把這個桿狀構造當作辨認生物的線索。
Rhabdocarpum is mentioned in a few old botanical manuals. 這個植物屬只在少數古老植物手冊中被提到。
The specimen card was filed under Rhabdocarpum. 那張標本卡被歸在這個植物屬名下。
Rhabdocoela are tiny flatworms that live in water and damp soil. 索形蟲類是生活在水中與潮濕土壤中的微小扁形蟲。
The class included several free-living Rhabdocoela. 這一類群包含許多自由生活的索形蟲。

meaning: 索形蟲類生物；索形蟲類的
sentences: The researcher found a rhabdocoelan in the sediment. 研究人員在沉積物裡發現了一隻索形蟲類生物。
As an adjective, rhabdocoelan describes members of that group. 作為形容詞時，rhabdocoelan 用來描述那一類生物。
A rhabdocoele slid across the wet glass slide. 一隻索形蟲在潮濕的玻片上滑過。
The guide explained how a rhabdocoele differs from other flatworms. 解說員說明了索形蟲和其他扁形蟲有什麼不同。
Rhabdocoelida includes many small free-living flatworms. 索形蟲目包含許多小型自由生活的扁形蟲。
The guide compared Rhabdocoelida with other worm groups. 這本指南把索形蟲目和其他蠕蟲類群作了比較。

meaning: 索形蟲目生物；索形蟲目的
sentences: The marine survey recorded a rhabdocoelidan among the samples. 海洋調查在樣本中記錄到一隻索形蟲目生物。
Some rhabdocoelidan features are easier to spot in preserved specimens. 有些索形蟲目的特徵在保存標本中更容易看出來。
The book uses rhabdocoelous as a technical adjective for that lineage. 那本書把 rhabdocoelous 當作那一支系的專門形容詞。
Because the organism is rhabdocoelous, it belongs to a narrow taxonomic group. 因為那種生物屬於索形蟲類，所以它歸在很狹窄的分類群中。
The cells looked rhabdoid under the slide. 這些細胞在玻片下看起來呈桿狀。
Doctors sometimes use rhabdoid to describe a particular cell pattern. 醫師有時會用 rhabdoid 來描述某種特定的細胞型態。
The lesion had a rhabdoidal appearance on imaging. 影像檢查顯示那個病灶呈桿狀外觀。
We noted a rhabdoidal texture in the crystal cluster. 我們注意到那簇水晶帶有桿狀的質地。
The ocean sample contained a rhabdolith from a tiny plankton species. 海洋樣本中含有來自微小浮游生物的桿石。
Under high magnification, the rhabdolith gleamed like a narrow needle. 在高倍放大下，那顆桿石閃得像一根細針。
The insect's eye uses a rhabdom to collect light. 昆蟲的眼睛利用感桿來收集光線。
Researchers examined the rhabdom after comparing several species. 研究人員在比較幾個物種後，檢視了那個視桿。
The rhabdomal region responded quickly to the flash. 視桿區域對閃光反應很快。
Scientists measured rhabdomal activity in the insect eye. 科學家測量了昆蟲眼中的感桿活動。
The rhabdomancer searched for water with a forked stick. 那位占卜者拿著叉枝棍尋找水源。
In old tales, a rhabdomancer could read hidden paths in the earth. 在古老傳說裡，占卜者能讀出大地中隱藏的路徑。
The villagers trusted rhabdomancy to help locate a spring. 村民相信杖卜能幫忙找到泉水。
Modern readers treat rhabdomancy as part folklore, part ritual. 現代讀者把杖卜看作一半民間傳說、一半儀式。
The manuscript describes a rhabdomantic rite performed at dusk. 那份手稿描述了一場黃昏舉行的杖卜儀式。
He spoke in a rhabdomantic tone, as if every sign mattered. 他說話帶著占卜般的語氣，好像每個徵兆都很重要。
The rhabdomantist claimed the stream ran beneath the hill. 那位杖卜者聲稱溪流就在山丘下方。
People still invited a rhabdomantist when wells ran dry. 井水乾涸時，人們還是會請杖卜者來幫忙。
Rhabdomonas is studied in microbiology labs. 原生生物屬常在微生物實驗室中被研究。
Scientists noted Rhabdomonas in the sample from the pond. 科學家在池塘樣本中記錄到這種原生生物屬。
The surgeon explained that the mass was a rhabdomyoma. 外科醫師解釋說，那個腫塊是橫紋肌瘤。
Rhabdomyoma can occur in muscle tissue and needs careful evaluation. 橫紋肌瘤可能出現在肌肉組織中，因此需要仔細評估。
The biopsy confirmed rhabdomyosarcoma, so treatment started quickly. 切片檢查證實是橫紋肌肉瘤，因此治療很快就開始了。
Doctors discussed surgery and chemotherapy for the rhabdomyosarcoma. 醫師討論了針對橫紋肌肉瘤的手術與化療。

meaning: 橫紋肌肉瘤的異體拼法
sentences: The report used rhabdomysarcoma, an older spelling of the same disease. 那份報告用了 rhabdomysarcoma，這是同一疾病的舊拼法。
Even with the variant spelling, the diagnosis remained rhabdomyosarcoma. 即使拼法不同，診斷仍然是橫紋肌肉瘤。
Rhabdophane can form tiny crystals in rare deposits. 這種稀土磷酸鹽礦物可在稀有礦床中形成微小晶體。
The geologist identified rhabdophane in the rock sample. 地質學家在岩石樣本中辨認出這種礦物。
Rhabdophanite was described from a very small specimen. 這種稀有礦物最初是根據一小塊標本描述的。
Collectors value rhabdophanite because it is so uncommon. 收藏家珍視這種礦物，因為它非常罕見。
Rhabdophora appears in many older paleontology books. 這個已滅絕的筆石類群常見於較早期的古生物學書籍。
The shale layer preserved traces of Rhabdophora. 那層頁岩保存了這個類群的痕跡。

meaning: 筆石類的；屬於 Rhabdophora 的
sentences: The rhabdophoran specimen was carefully mounted for display. 那件筆石類標本被仔細裝裱起來展出。
Its rhabdophoran shape helped researchers identify the fossil group. 它的筆石類外形幫助研究人員辨認出化石類群。
Rhabdopleura lives in small tube-like colonies on the seafloor. 管觸手類動物屬生活在海底的小型管狀群體中。
Biologists study Rhabdopleura to learn about early animal evolution. 生物學家研究這個屬，以了解早期動物演化。
The cell extended a rhabdopod toward the food particle. 細胞朝食物顆粒伸出一個棒狀偽足。
Under the microscope, the rhabdopod looked like a narrow rod. 在顯微鏡下，這個桿狀突起看起來像一根細長棒。
The diagram marked the central rhabdos as the main support. 圖中把中央的棒狀體標為主要支撐。
In the fossil, the rhabdos was still clearly visible. 在化石裡，這根棒狀體仍然清楚可見。

meaning: 筆石群體；棒狀群體結構
sentences: A graptolite rhabdosome may preserve delicate branches. 筆石的群體結構可能保存細緻分枝。
The curator showed us a fossil rhabdosome with clear symmetry. 館員向我們展示了一件具有清楚對稱性的化石群體結構。
Rhabdosophy is a niche topic in historical paleontology. 筆石研究是古生物學史中的冷門主題。
Her thesis touched on rhabdosophy and fossil classification. 她的論文涉及筆石研究與化石分類。
The structure formed a rhabdosphere rather than a straight rod. 這個結構形成的是近球形棒狀體，而不是筆直的桿。
Researchers described the rhabdosphere as compact and rounded. 研究人員把這種近球形棒狀體描述為緊密而圓潤。
The rhabdus of the organism was visible at high magnification. 這種生物的桿狀體在高倍放大下可見。
A thin rhabdus often appears in microscope drawings. 顯微鏡圖中常會出現細長的桿狀體。
Rhacianectes is an older genus name for the gray whale. 這是灰鯨的舊屬名。
The museum card listed Rhacianectes beside related genera. 博物館卡片把它列在相關屬名旁邊。
Rhacomitrium often grows on exposed rocks in cool places. 這類苔蘚常生長在涼爽地區裸露的岩石上。
We found a soft patch of Rhacomitrium after the rain. 雨後我們在岩面上找到一片柔軟的苔蘚。
Rhacophorus frogs can glide between trees in some forests. 這類樹蛙在某些森林裡可以在樹間滑行。
The guide pointed out a bright Rhacophorus resting on a leaf. 導覽員指著一隻停在葉片上的鮮豔樹蛙。

meaning: 公正嚴明的；冷峻不可動搖的
sentences: Her Rhadamanthine judgment left no room for excuses. 她那種公正嚴明的判斷幾乎不給任何藉口空間。
The old king was remembered for his Rhadamanthine fairness. 那位古老的國王因公正無私而被記住。

meaning: 拉達曼堤斯；希臘神話中的公正判官
sentences: Rhadamanthus appears in myths as a stern judge of souls. 這位神話人物在傳說中是嚴峻的靈魂判官。
The poet invoked Rhadamanthus when speaking about justice. 那位詩人在談論正義時提到了這位神話人物。

meaning: 拉達曼堤斯的另一種古典拼法
sentences: Rhadamanthys is another classical form of the same mythic name. 這是同一個神話名字的另一種古典拼法。
Classical readers may recognize Rhadamanthys from epic poetry. 熟悉古典文學的人可能會從史詩詩作中認出這個名字。

meaning: 萊提階的；三疊紀晚期的
sentences: The Rhaetian rocks were laid down near the end of the Triassic. 這些岩層形成於三疊紀接近尾聲的時期。
Fossils from the Rhaetian period can reveal ancient ecosystems. 來自該時期的化石能揭示古老的生態系統。
Rhaetic layers often mark a major change in earth history. 這些地層常標誌著地球歷史上的重大轉變。
The textbook used Rhaetic as a term for the late Triassic. 那本教科書把這個詞用來指稱三疊紀晚期。
Rhagades may form when skin becomes very dry or inflamed. 當皮膚非常乾燥或發炎時，這些裂口可能會形成。
The doctor treated the rhagades gently to reduce pain. 醫師小心處理這些裂口，以減輕疼痛。
The rhagadiform crack spread along the old bark. 那道裂隙狀裂痕沿著老樹皮延伸開來。
A rhagadiform pattern can look jagged under close inspection. 裂隙狀的紋理在近看時會顯得參差不齊。
Rhagiocrin is the kind of name that appears in fossil catalogues. 這是常見於化石目錄中的名稱。
The researcher compared Rhagiocrin with other ancient marine forms. 研究人員將它與其他古老海洋生物作比較。
A rhagionid flew slowly over the shaded stream bank. 一隻雜角蠅科昆蟲緩緩飛過陰影中的溪岸。
Entomologists sometimes note rhagionid larvae in moist soil. 昆蟲學家有時會在潮濕土壤中記錄這類幼蟲。
Rhagionidae are slender flies found in many habitats. 雜角蠅科是分布廣泛的細長蠅類。
The field guide included a short note on Rhagionidae identification. 那本野外圖鑑附上了辨認這一科的簡短說明。
Rhagite was mentioned in an old mineral list from the region. 它曾出現在該地區的一份舊礦物清單中。
The specimen looked like a dark rhagite fragment in the tray. 那件樣本在托盤裡看起來像一小塊深色碎片。
Rhagodia shrubs can tolerate salty coastal winds. 這類灌木能耐受帶鹽分的海風。
We saw Rhagodia growing low and dense beside the path. 我們看到這個屬低矮而茂密地長在小路旁。
In the lab diagram, the rhagon was shown as a rounded chamber. 在實驗室圖解中，這種囊狀構造被畫成一個圓形腔室。
The term rhagon helps describe an early simple body plan. 這個術語有助於描述早期簡單的身體構造。

meaning: 呈囊狀的；具囊狀結構的
sentences: The rhagonate form was easier to recognize in the sketch. 這種囊狀形態在草圖中更容易辨認。
Scientists used rhagonate to describe the organism's rounded body. 科學家用這個詞來描述該生物的圓潤身形。
The rhagose surface had fine cracks across it. 那個有裂紋的表面布滿細小裂痕。
A rhagose seed pod can split unevenly as it dries. 乾燥時，有裂紋的蒴果可能會不規則裂開。
Rhamn was used in an older text as a short form for buckthorn. 它在舊文獻中曾作為鼠李的簡稱。
The herbarium sheet labeled rhamn showed narrow leaves and berries. 標有這個名稱的植物標本上有細葉和漿果。
Rhamnaceae includes many shrubs and small trees. 鼠李科包含許多灌木與小喬木。
Botany students often learn Rhamnaceae by comparing leaf shapes. 學習植物學的學生常透過比較葉形來認識這一科。

meaning: 鼠李科的；屬於鼠李科的
sentences: The rhamnaceous shrub had small leaves and tiny fruits. 那株鼠李科植物有小葉和小果實。
A rhamnaceous plant can look modest but be ecologically important. 鼠李科植物看起來樸素，卻可能在生態上很重要。
Rhamnal is mentioned in some discussions of sugar chemistry. 鼠李糖醛會出現在某些糖化學的討論中。
The chemist isolated a trace of rhamnal from the sample. 化學家從樣品中分離出微量這種化合物。
Rhamnales was once used as a botanical order name. 鼠李目曾被用作植物目的名稱。
Older floras grouped these shrubs under Rhamnales. 較早期的植物誌把這些灌木歸在這一目之下。
Rhamnetin is a flavonoid found in some plants. 鼠李素是某些植物中含有的黃酮類化合物。
Researchers examined rhamnetin for its natural antioxidant activity. 研究人員檢視它的天然抗氧化活性。
Rhamninase helps break down certain plant glycosides. 鼠李糖苷酶有助於分解某些植物糖苷。
The enzyme assay showed clear rhamninase activity. 酵素測定顯示出明顯的酵素活性。
Rhamninose is a sugar that appears in a few natural compounds. 鼠李三糖會出現在少數天然化合物中。
Chemists tracked how rhamninose behaved during hydrolysis. 化學家追蹤了它在水解時的表現。
Rhamnite is a name that can appear in chemical or mineral contexts. 鼠李糖醇這個名稱可能出現在化學或礦物學語境中。
The report listed rhamnite among the less familiar components. 報告把它列為較不熟悉的成分之一。
Rhamnitol is a rare sugar alcohol. 它是一種稀有糖醇。
The sample contained a small amount of rhamnitol after processing. 加工後，那份樣品只含有少量這種物質。
Rhamnohexite belongs to the family of sugar alcohols. 它屬於糖醇這一類化合物。
The name rhamnohexite appears in older chemistry references. 這個名稱常見於較早的化學參考書。
Rhamnohexitol is closely related to other rare sugar alcohols. 它與其他稀有糖醇密切相關。
The chemist compared rhamnohexitol with similar molecules. 那位化學家把它與相似分子作比較。
Rhamnohexose is a rare sugar discussed in carbohydrate chemistry. 它是碳水化合物化學中討論的一種稀有糖。
Researchers identified the rhamnohexose after careful analysis. 研究人員經過仔細分析後辨認出這種糖。

meaning: 鼠李糖酸的；與 rhamnonic acid 有關的
sentences: The rhamnonic derivative was more stable than the original sugar. 那個鼠李糖酸衍生物比原始糖類更穩定。
A rhamnonic compound may form during oxidation. 氧化過程中可能形成一種 rhamnonic 化合物。
Rhamnose occurs in the cell walls of some plants and bacteria. 它存在於某些植物與細菌的細胞壁中。

The professor used Rhodymeniales as an example of a marine plant order. 教授把紅葉藻目當作海洋植物目的一個例子。

The old botanical guide grouped poppies within Rhoeadales. 那本老植物指南把罌粟類植物歸在罌粟目中。
Rhoecus appeared in the story as a name from ancient myth. 這個名字在故事裡出自古代神話。
The historian paused over Rhoecus because the reference was so old. 由於那筆記載太古老，歷史學家特地在這個名字上停了下來。

The tile pattern repeated the same rhomb again and again. 磁磚圖案一再重複同樣的菱形。
A clean rhomb can make a simple design look surprisingly elegant. 一個俐落的菱形能讓簡單設計看起來意外優雅。
The rhombencephalon helps control balance and basic body functions. 菱腦有助於控制平衡與基本的身體功能。
In biology class, we traced the rhombencephalon back to early brain development. 在生物課上，我們追溯了菱腦在早期腦部發育中的位置。
The rock sample was identified as rhombenporphyr by the geology lab. 地質實驗室把那塊岩石標定為菱斑斑岩。
Its rhombenporphyr crystals flashed under the microscope lamp. 它的菱斑斑岩晶體在顯微鏡燈下閃著光。
The rhombic pattern repeated across the fabric in neat rows. 這種菱形圖案整齊地重複在布料上。
A rhombic crystal can look simple until the light hits it. 菱形晶體在光線照到之前，往往看起來很普通。
The architect chose a rhombical window to soften the facade. 那位建築師選了一扇菱狀窗戶，讓立面不那麼生硬。
Her notebook was full of rhombical sketches from the museum. 她的筆記本裡畫滿了在博物館速寫的菱形圖樣。
The rhombiform leaves gave the plant a geometric look. 這種菱形的葉片讓那株植物看起來很有幾何感。
He noticed a rhombiform shadow moving across the wall. 他注意到牆上有一道菱形的影子掠過。
The curator placed the rhomboclase beside other sulfate minerals. 策展人把菱鐵礬和其他硫酸鹽礦物放在一起展示。
Rhomboclase often forms in tiny crystals that are easy to miss. 菱鐵礬常形成很細小的晶體，很容易被忽略。
The fossil was described as a rhomboganoid from an ancient lake bed. 那塊化石被描述為來自古湖床的菱鱗魚類。
Museum visitors paused to read about the rhomboganoid exhibit. 博物館參觀者都停下來閱讀菱鱗魚類展區的說明。
Rhomboganoidei is a term that appears in older fish classifications. Rhomboganoidei 是較舊魚類分類裡會出現的術語。
The lecture mentioned Rhomboganoidei when discussing ancient bony fishes. 那場講座在談到古代硬骨魚時提到了菱鱗魚亞綱。

meaning: 菱形形成的；產生菱形的
sentences: The rhombogene growth pattern gave the crystal a repeated shape. 這種菱形形成的生長模式讓晶體出現重複的形狀。

sentences: The teacher pointed out the rhombogenic tendency in the crystal model. 老師指出那個晶體模型有形成菱形的傾向。
Under pressure, the material showed a rhombogenic response. 在壓力之下，那種材料呈現出菱形生成的反應。
The rhombogenous fibers arranged themselves into a tight lattice. 這些產生菱形的纖維自行排列成緊密的晶格。
Her sketch highlighted the rhombogenous outline of the stone. 她的速寫突出了那塊石頭菱形狀的輪廓。
The display case held several small rhombohedra from the same mine. 展示櫃裡放著幾個來自同一座礦坑的小菱面體。
Rhombohedra can appear in crystals that look almost perfect. 菱面體可能出現在外觀看起來幾乎完美的晶體裡。
The rhombohedral crystals stood out sharply against the dark rock. 那些菱面體晶體在深色岩石上顯得格外明顯。
We traced the rhombohedral shape with our fingers in the diagram. 我們在圖解上用手指沿著菱面體的形狀描了一遍。

meaning: 以菱面體方式；呈菱面體地
sentences: The crystals were arranged rhombohedrally in the sample tray. 那些晶體在樣本托盤裡以菱面體方式排列著。
Light reflected rhombohedrally across the polished surface. 光線以菱面體般的方式在拋光表面上反射。
The rhombohedric habit of the mineral made it easy to classify. 那種礦物的菱面體狀外形讓分類變得容易。
The geologist noted a rhombohedric fracture in the specimen. 地質學家在標本上記錄到一處菱面體狀斷口。
The model was cut into a clean rhombohedron for the lesson. 那個模型被切成一個俐落的菱面體來上課。
A rhombohedron has faces that lean instead of standing upright. 菱面體的各個面是傾斜的，不是垂直立起來的。
The designer used a rhomboid to break up the square layout. 設計師用一個類菱形圖形來打破方正的版面。
Each rhomboid on the page helped guide the reader's eye. 頁面上的每個類菱形都幫助引導讀者的視線。
The rhomboidal leaves made the plant look almost ornamental. 那些菱形葉片讓這株植物看起來幾乎像觀賞植物。
Her earrings had a rhomboidal shape that caught the light. 她的耳環是菱形的，會把光線折射得很漂亮。
The pieces were stacked rhomboidally to save space in the box. 那些零件以菱形方式堆疊在盒子裡，以節省空間。
The pattern spread rhomboidally across the ceramic tile. 那個圖案以菱形的方式延展在陶瓷磚面上。
The therapist explained that the rhomboideus helps steady the shoulder blade. 治療師解釋說，菱形肌有助於穩定肩胛骨。
After practice, he felt a dull ache in his rhomboideus muscles. 練習結束後，他感到菱形肌有些鈍鈍的痠痛。
The tiles were laid rhomboidly along the foyer wall. 玄關牆邊的磁磚以菱形方式鋪設。
She folded the note rhomboidly so the corners met neatly. 她把紙條折成菱形，讓四角整齊對齊。
The jeweler sketched a rhomboquadratic frame for the pendant. 那位珠寶師替吊墜畫了一個菱方形的框架。
The old emblem looked rhomboquadratic under the museum lights. 在博物館燈光下，那個古老徽記看起來是菱方形的。
The window had a rhomborectangular outline that caught everyone's eye. 那扇窗有著菱矩形的輪廓，讓人一眼就注意到。
Design students traced a rhomborectangular panel in charcoal. 設計系學生用炭筆描出一塊菱矩形面板。
The quilt was covered with blue rhombos and tiny stars. 那條被子上布滿藍色菱形圖案和小星星。
He drew a row of rhombos to test the pattern on paper. 他在紙上畫了一排菱形來測試圖案。
The seed is rhombovate, broad in the middle and tapered at both ends. 這顆種子是菱卵形的，中間較寬、兩端略尖。
A rhombovate leaf can look odd until you hold it beside a normal oval one. 菱卵形的葉子若不和一般橢圓葉並排，看起來會有點奇特。
The lecture noted that Rhombozoa are tiny parasites with unusual body plans. 課堂上提到，這類生物是體型微小、構造很特殊的寄生動物。
Students paused when the professor wrote Rhombozoa across the board. 教授把這個名稱寫在黑板上時，學生們都停下來看。
The teacher drew a rhombus on the board and marked its diagonals. 老師在黑板上畫了一個菱形，並標出它的對角線。
Every side of a rhombus has the same length. 菱形的每一條邊都一樣長。
The doctor heard a rhonchal sound in the patient's chest. 醫生在病人的胸腔聽到一種鼾聲樣的雜音。
A rhonchal murmur can signal that the airway is irritated. 鼾聲樣的雜音可能表示呼吸道受到刺激。
She studied the rhonchial notes recorded during the night shift. 她研究夜班期間記錄下來的喘鳴音筆記。
The chart included a rhonchial description of the patient's breathing. 那張圖表包含了病人呼吸的喘鳴音描述。
The nurse wrote that a rhonchus was audible on the left side. 護理師寫下左側可以聽到喘鳴音。
A persistent rhonchus can make a simple exam feel urgent. 持續的喘鳴音會讓原本簡單的檢查變得緊迫。
Rhonda called before dinner and asked if we were home. 朗達在晚餐前打電話來，問我們是否在家。
Everyone in the office remembered Rhonda because she solved problems quickly. 辦公室裡每個人都記得朗達，因為她解決問題很快。

meaning: 漸長式的；每個後續單位更長的
sentences: The poet built a rhopalic line by adding one syllable at a time. 詩人用每次多加一個音節的方式寫出一行漸長式詩句。
Her teacher explained that rhopalic verse grows longer as it moves forward. 她的老師解釋，漸長式詩句會隨著前進而越來越長。
The anthology includes an example of rhopalism that begins almost playfully. 那本文選裡收錄了一個一開始幾乎像遊戲的漸長式詩句例子。
He enjoyed rhopalism because the form turns counting into a musical game. 他喜歡漸長式詩句，因為這種形式把計數變成了有音樂感的遊戲。

meaning: 水母邊緣感覺器；傘緣感覺體
sentences: A rhopalium helps the jellyfish sense light and balance. 傘緣感覺器能幫助水母感知光線與平衡。
Researchers placed the specimen under a microscope to study each rhopalium. 研究人員把標本放到顯微鏡下，逐一觀察每個傘緣感覺器。

Collectors often separate Rhopalocera from moths by the shape of the antennae. 收藏家常靠觸角形狀來把蝴蝶和蛾類區分開。
The museum label described the wings as rhopaloceral. 博物館標籤把那些翅膀描述為蝶類的。
A rhopaloceral specimen usually has the bright colors visitors expect. 蝶類標本通常具有參觀者所期待的鮮豔色彩。
The artist gave the costume a rhopalocerous shimmer. 藝術家讓這套服裝帶有蝴蝶般的光澤。

Under the slide, Rhopalura looked simpler than the textbooks had suggested. 在載玻片下，它看起來比課本說明的還要簡單。
The speech therapist listened for signs of rhotacism. 語言治療師留意是否有捲舌音化的跡象。
In historical linguistics, rhotacism can explain why old sounds changed shape. 在歷史語言學中，r 音化可以解釋古老音值為何會改變。
The grammar book used rhotacismus as an older technical label. 那本語法書把它當成較舊的專門術語。
She found rhotacismus in a footnote and followed the reference trail. 她在註腳裡看到這個術語，便一路追著參考文獻查下去。

meaning: r 音化的；捲舌音化的
sentences: The pronunciation guide marked the dialect as rhotacistic. 那本發音指南把這種方言標示為 r 音化的。

sentences: Teachers warned students not to rhotacize every final consonant. 老師提醒學生不要把每個詞尾輔音都 r 音化。
The dialect began to rhotacize certain sounds over several generations. 這種方言在好幾代人之間逐漸讓某些音變成 r 音。

meaning: 道路或高速公路旁的溝渠。
sentences: Driving home yesterday, I almost hit the rhubarb. 昨天開車回家，我差點撞到大黃。
The term rhubarb refers to A ditch alongside a road or highway. 大黃一詞指的是道路或高速公路旁的溝渠。
The pie had a rhubarby tang that lingered after each bite. 那個派帶著大黃般的酸香，每一口後都會留在嘴裡。

The captain plotted a rhumb across the chart to keep a steady bearing. 船長在海圖上畫出一條航向線，好維持固定方位。
A rhumb line looks straight on a Mercator map, even though the earth is curved. 在墨卡托投影圖上，航向線看起來是直的，儘管地球是彎曲的。

meaning: 速調管中的束聚器或收集器
sentences: The engineer replaced the rhumbatron before the test run. 工程師在測試前更換了速調管裡的束聚器。
Inside the klystron, the rhumbatron helped shape the electron beam. 在速調管內，rhumbatron 幫助塑造電子束。
Rhus species often show up in field guides to shrubs and small trees. 這一屬的植物常見於灌木與小喬木的野外圖鑑。
The botanist compared two Rhus leaves before labeling the sample. 植物學家在標記標本前先比對了兩片葉子。
The rock cabinet included a pale chunk of rhyacolite. 那個岩石櫃裡放著一塊淡色的正長石。
Geology students learned that rhyacolite is another name for sanidine. 地質系學生學到 rhyacolite 是正長石的另一個名稱。
Many nursery rhymes are used to help children learn new words and sounds. 許多童謠被用來幫助孩子學習新的單字和發音。
Can you think of a word that rhymes with 'orange'? No, it's famous for having no rhyme. 你能想到一個與「orange」押韻的單字嗎？不，它以沒有押韻詞而聞名。

The local rhymemaker could turn any headline into a joke. 當地那位作詩者總能把任何標題變成笑話。
As a rhymemaker, he cared more about sound than elegance. 身為押韻者，他更在意聲音而不是典雅。
Her notebook was full of rhymemaking experiments and half-finished lines. 她的筆記本裡塞滿了作詩實驗和半截詩句。
Rhymemaking became less daunting once he started reading aloud. 一旦他開始朗讀，押韻創作就不再那麼令人卻步。

meaning: 不易押韻的；難以押韻的
sentences: Orange is the classic rhymeproof word that frustrates poets. orange 是經典的不易押韻詞，總讓詩人頭痛。

meaning: 以押韻的方式；就押韻而言
sentences: The verse was arranged rhymewise so the chorus landed smoothly. 那首詩以押韻的方式編排，讓副歌順順落下。
Rhymewise, the second stanza echoed the first without copying it. 就押韻而言，第二段呼應了第一段，卻沒有照抄。
The poet preferred a rhymic ending that sounded almost like a drumbeat. 那位詩人偏好一種帶押韻感的收尾，聽起來幾乎像鼓點。

The rhymist revised every line until the ending rang clear. 那位作詩者把每一行都修到結尾清晰為止。
At the fair, a rhymist sold handwritten verses beside the pastry stall. 在市集上，一位作詩者在糕點攤旁賣手寫詩句。
The child's rhymy chant bounced through the hallway. 孩子那段有韻的念詞在走廊裡迴盪。
Her rhymy notes were simple, but they made the melody stick. 她那些押韻的筆記很簡單，卻讓旋律更容易記住。

meaning: 吻蛭類；具可伸縮吻的水蛭類群
sentences: The naturalist grouped the specimen with the Rhynchobdellae. 那位自然學家把這個標本歸入吻蛭類。
Students learned that Rhynchobdellae have a protrusible proboscis instead of jaws. 學生們學到，Rhynchobdellae 具有可伸縮的吻，而不是顎。
The field note listed the leech under Rhynchobdellida. 野外記錄把這條水蛭列在吻蛭目之下。
In Rhynchobdellida, the feeding apparatus is more like a tube than a set of teeth. 在吻蛭目中，攝食構造更像管子，而不是一排牙齒。
The fossil was cataloged among the Rhynchocephala. 那件化石被編入喙頭類。
Rhynchocephala once included many lizardlike reptiles, not just modern tuataras. 喙頭類曾包含許多類蜥蜴爬蟲，不只是現代的楔齒蜥。
Museum drawers labeled Rhynchocephali often hold fragmentary bones. 博物館抽屜上標著這一類名稱的，常常裝著零碎骨骼。
The curator explained that Rhynchocephali are known mostly from fossils. 館長解釋說，這一類生物多半只透過化石得知。
The lecture traced Rhynchocephalia from the Triassic to the present. 那堂課追溯了喙頭目從三疊紀一路到現代。
Only the tuatara survives today as a living member of Rhynchocephalia. 現今只有楔齒蜥還是喙頭目的現生成員。

meaning: 喙頭目爬蟲；喙頭類動物
sentences: The guide identified the skeleton as a rhynchocephalian. 指南把那具骨架辨認為喙頭目爬蟲。
A rhynchocephalian may look lizardlike, but its ancestry is distinct. 喙頭類動物看起來像蜥蜴，但血緣其實不同。
The skull showed rhynchocephalic traits that narrowed the identification. 那個頭骨呈現喙頭類特徵，讓鑑定範圍縮小。
Its rhynchocephalic jaw structure helped the paleontologist classify it. 它那喙頭類的下顎構造幫助古生物學家分類。
The report described the fossil as rhynchocephalous rather than truly lizardlike. 報告把這塊化石描述為喙頭目的，而不是真正像蜥蜴的。
A rhynchocephalous skull can be subtle unless you know what to compare it with. 若不知道拿什麼來比，喙頭樣的頭骨很難一眼看出來。
Old textbooks sometimes used Rhynchocoela for ribbon worms. 舊教材有時會用這個名稱來稱呼紐蟲類。
The class note reminded us that Rhynchocoela is an older taxonomic name. 課堂筆記提醒我們，這是較舊的分類名稱。
The rhynchocoelan body cavity protects the worm's proboscis. 紐蟲類的體腔保護著這條蟲的吻。
A rhynchocoelan anatomy lesson is easier once you picture a ribbon worm. 一旦你能想像紐蟲，講解 rhynchocoelan 解剖就容易多了。

meaning: 紐蟲類的；與吻腔有關的
sentences: The rhynchocoelic chamber stores the proboscis until it is needed. 吻腔把吻收納起來，直到需要時才伸出。

meaning: 有吻腔的；與吻腔相關的
sentences: The worm was described as rhynchocoelous in the lab notes. 實驗筆記把這條蟲描述成有吻腔的。

The rhyncholite looked like the tip of an ancient beak. 那塊化石看起來像古老喙端的碎片。
The curator labeled the fossil as Rhynchonella. 館員把那件化石標成這一屬。
Rhynchonella shells are sharply beaked and easy to spot. 這一屬的殼有明顯的尖喙，很容易辨認。
Our textbook placed the fossil brachiopods in Rhynchonellacea. 我們的課本把這些腕足類歸入這一總科。
The shell shape made Rhynchonellacea a useful classification clue. 殼形讓這一總科成了很實用的分類線索。
Rhynchonellidae includes many fossil brachiopods. 這一科包含許多化石腕足動物。
A single Rhynchonellidae shell can reveal a lot about the seabed. 一枚這一科的殼就能透露很多海床線索。

meaning: 類似 Rhynchonella 的；鈍喙貝狀的
sentences: The fossil had a rhynchonelloid outline and a sharp fold. 那塊化石有 Rhynchonella 風格的外形和尖銳褶脊。
Its rhynchonelloid form suggested a close brachiopod relative. 它那種鈍喙貝狀的外型顯示它可能是近緣腕足類。

meaning: 象鼻蟲；象鼻蟲類的個體
sentences: A rhynchophoran chewed neat holes in the leaves. 一隻象鼻蟲在葉片上咬出整齊的小洞。
The museum drawer held a rhynchophoran with a long curved snout. 博物館抽屜裡放著一隻長著彎曲長吻的象鼻蟲。

Under the lens, the rhynchophore looked like a tiny beak stand. 在放大鏡下，這個構造看起來像一個小小的喙座。
The rhynchophorous beetle drilled into the seed. 那隻有喙的甲蟲把種子鑽了個洞。

A flock of Rhynchopinae skimmed the river at dusk. 傍晚時，一群這些鳥掠過河面。

Rhynchosia climbed over the fence and brightened the trellis. 這種藤本攀上了圍欄，讓棚架看起來更有生氣。
The gardener planted Rhynchosia for its yellow flowers. 園丁種了它，看中的是它的黃花。
Rhynchospora prefers wet, sunny ground. 這一屬偏好潮濕又有陽光的地面。
The field guide showed how to tell Rhynchospora apart from other sedges. 野外圖鑑示範了如何把這一屬與其他莎草分開。
Older books still use Rhynchota for true bugs. 舊書仍用這個名稱指真正的半翅目昆蟲。
The label Rhynchota appears on a faded museum tray. 這個標籤出現在一個褪色的博物館標盤上。

meaning: 半翅目的；與 Rhynchota 有關的
sentences: The specimen had a rhynchotal mouthpart suited for piercing. 這件標本有適合刺吸的 rhynchotal 口器。

The tray held a rhynchote with a piercing beak. 托盤裡放著一隻具有刺吸式喙的昆蟲。
A rhynchote was pinned beside the true bug display. 這隻昆蟲被針別在真正的半翅目展區旁。
The rhynchotous mouthparts looked built for piercing. 這種 rhynchotous 口器看起來就是為了刺入而生。
A rhynchotous insect can leave tiny punctures on a leaf. 有喙的半翅目昆蟲會在葉片上留下細小穿孔。
A rhynconellid turned up in the limestone layer. 石灰岩層裡出現了一枚鈍喙貝化石。
The rhynconellid shell was ridged and sharply beaked. 這枚鈍喙貝殼有稜脊，喙端很尖。
Some old classification charts place carnivores and pangolins in Rhyncostomi. 一些舊的分類圖表把食肉類和鱗甲類放進這個支系。
The term Rhyncostomi feels historical, not modern. 這個名稱帶有歷史感，不算現代用語。

meaning: 瑞尼亞屬；早期維管植物屬
sentences: Rhynia grew in a prehistoric wetland. 瑞尼亞曾生長在史前濕地。
The fossil slab showed several delicate Rhynia stems. 那塊化石板上可見幾株纖細的瑞尼亞植物。

Rhyodacite sits between rhyolite and dacite in composition. 它的成分介於流紋岩和英安岩之間。
The hill was built from pale rhyolite. 那座小丘由淺色流紋岩構成。
A band of rhyolite can make a landscape look almost painted. 一層流紋岩會讓地景看起來像被畫過一樣。
The rhyolitic lava cooled into a rough crust. 那股流紋岩質熔岩冷卻後形成粗糙外殼。
Rhyolitic rocks are often light-colored and silica-rich. 流紋岩質的岩石通常顏色較淺，且富含二氧化矽。
The thin section showed a rhyotaxitic banding pattern. 薄片顯示出一種流紋定向的條帶構造。
Rhyotaxitic texture usually forms when lava keeps moving as it cools. 這種構造通常在熔岩冷卻時仍持續流動而形成。
The gallery joked that the rhyparographer had no taste for grand heroes. 畫廊開玩笑說，那位畫家對宏大英雄題材毫無興趣。

The sketch had a rhyparographic charm that felt oddly intimate. 那幅素描帶著俗物畫式的魅力，意外地親切。
Her rhyparographic scenes focused on clutter, food, and daily life. 她的作品聚焦在雜物、食物和日常生活。
The rhyparographist made beauty out of kitchen scraps. 那位畫家把廚房廢料也畫出了美感。
Collectors now value the rhyparographist for his attention to everyday things. 收藏家現在很重視他對日常事物的關注。
The chapter on rhyparography compared food markets and still life. 關於這種畫法的章節把菜市場和靜物畫放在一起比較。

The old catalog listed the work under rhypography. 舊目錄把這件作品列在這個詞條之下。
Rhypography is another name for genre painting of humble scenes. 這是另一種指描繪卑微日常場景的風俗畫的說法。
The old apothecary sold a rhyptic remedy for stubborn constipation. 那位老藥劑師賣了一種可治頑固便秘的療方。
A rhyptic wash was once used as a cleansing medicine. 從前這種洗劑曾被當作清潔藥使用。
The label promised a rhyptical herb tea. 標籤上宣稱那是有通便效果的草本茶。

The engineer checked the rhysimeter before the river trial. 工程師在河流測試前先檢查了這台儀器。

Rhyssa was hovering near the log pile. 這個姬蜂屬的成蟲在木頭堆附近盤旋。
The guide said Rhyssa was a parasite of wood-boring larvae. 導覽員說這個姬蜂屬會寄生在蛀木幼蟲身上。
The dancers moved in perfect rhythm with the upbeat music. 舞者們伴隨著輕快的音樂，以完美的節奏律動。
I love the slow and steady rhythm of the waves crashing against the shore. 我喜歡海浪拍打岸邊那緩慢而穩定的節奏。

Drums and footsteps created a rhythmal background in the hall. 鼓聲和腳步聲在大廳裡形成了有節奏的背景。

meaning: 屬於節奏的或與節奏有關的。
sentences: Something described as rhythmic is of or relating to rhythm. 被描述為有節奏的事物屬於節奏或與節奏有關。

sentences: The march felt like a rhythmization of ordinary walking. 這場行軍像是把一般走路節律化了。

sentences: His ribaldish humor made the room laugh without crossing the line. 他略帶粗俗的幽默讓全場發笑，卻沒有越界。

meaning: 十九世紀愛爾蘭秘密結社運動
sentences: Ribandism was another name for Ribbonism in nineteenth-century Ireland. 十九世紀愛爾蘭曾用這個名稱指那場秘密結社運動。

sentences: The topics were arranged rubrically on the page. 這些主題在頁面上以標題方式排列。

meaning: to mark or arrange with rubrics; to write in red

meaning: the act of rubricating or adding red headings

meaning: a specialist in rubrics or formal headings

meaning: one who writes or works with rubrics

meaning: the quality of being rubric-like or formally headed

meaning: to arrange or mark with rubrics

meaning: a healthy red color; redness of complexion
